n-m-h2-explog-07.title: Ọ bụrụ na anyị maara ụkpụrụ nke otu logarithm, anyị pụrụ ichọta log₆12?
n-m-h2-explog-07.goal: Nyochaa ozi ọ dị mkpa iji chọta logarithm a chọrọ, ma chọta n'onwe gị okwu n'ihe gbasara otu ụkpụrụ p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.material: Eunseo chọrọ ichọta log_6 12 n'enweghị calculator. Ọ bụrụ na e gwa ya naanị otu n'ụkpụrụ ndị dị n'okpuru, ọ chọrọ ilele ma ọ pụrụ ikwu log_6 12 n'ihe gbasara ụkpụrụ ahụ site n'iji naanị ihe onwunwe nke logarithms na ọrụ mgbakọ anọ. (log_6 12 bụ logarithm nke 12 nwere base 6.)
n-m-h2-explog-07.thinking.1: Ibelata ruo otu ụkpụrụ site n'ịgbanwe base
n-m-h2-explog-07.prereq.2: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti reciprocals na logarithms
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ụkpụrụ niile nke ịmara naanị otu ụkpụrụ ahụ na-ekwe ka ị kwuo log_6 12 n'ihe gbasara ya site n'iji naanị ihe onwunwe nke logarithms na ọrụ mgbakọ anọ.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.0: Nwaa ịgbanwe base nke log_6 12 ka ọ bụrụ 2 ma ọ bụ 3, ma ọ bụ ide 12 na 6 dị ka ngwaahịa nke 2 na 3, ka ịhụ nke otu logarithm nwere ike ikwu ya.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee otu n'otu ma nhọrọ ọ bụla nwere otu ozi ahụ dị ka otu logarithm ahụ (ma enwere ike ịgbanwe ya ka ọ bụrụ ya site n'usoro).
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.a: Site na log_10 2 naanị, ị nweghị ike ịmata log_10 3, ya mere ị nweghị ike ikwu ma 12 ma 6.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.b: Ị hapụrụ ozi na-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ otu logarithm, dị ka log_2 6=1+log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.c: Ị hapụrụ na iji log_6 3=1−log_6 2 na-ekwe ka ị kwuo log_6 12.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọ nweghị njikọ na 2 na 3, ya mere ọ naghị enyere aka.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.e: Ị hapụrụ na log_3 2 bụ reciprocal nke log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.r.f: Ị hapụrụ na ịgbanwe log_6 12 ka ọ bụrụ base 2 na-ahapụ naanị log_2 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s1.explain: log_6 12=log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+log_2 3)/(1+log_2 3); ya mere p=log_2 3 naanị ezuola. A pụkwara ịgbanwe log_2 6=1+p, log_3 2=1/p, log_6 2=1/(1+p) ka ọ banye na p ma ọ bụ wepụta ha na p. log_10 2 anaghị arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụrụ na ị maghị log_10 3; log_5 7 enweghịkwa njikọ na 2 na 3.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.prompt: Ka p=log_2 3. Dee log_6 12 dịka okwu p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.0: Gbanwee ntọala ka ọ bụrụ 2, dee numerator na denominator dịka uru log_2 nke ọ bụla.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.hint.1: Dee log_2 12 na log_2 6 dịka ngwaahịa 2 na 3, jiri iwu logarithm gosi ha site na p.
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: N’okwu gị nwere p, i debere numerator na denominator n’usoro ziri ezi?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I tinyere p=1.585, lelee na log_6 12≈1.387?
n-m-h2-explog-07.s.s2.model.1: Ịgbanwe ntọala ka ọ bụrụ 2 na-enye log_2 12/log_2 6=(2+p)/(1+p).

n-m-h2-explog-09.title: Ikpebi symmetry n’etiti eserese ọrụ exponential na logarithmic
n-m-h2-explog-09.goal: Jiri usoro ngụkọ lelee nkwupụta symmetry n’etiti ọtụtụ eserese, kpebie eziokwu na ụgha ha, jiri otu usoro gosi ihe kpatara otu nkwupụta.
n-m-h2-explog-09.material: Seungwoo chịkọtara mmekọrịta symmetry dị n’etiti eserese ọrụ exponential na logarithmic nwere ntọala 2 na 1/2. A na-ede logarithm ntọala 1/2 ka log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.1: Ịgbanwe mmekọrịta eserese ka ọ bụrụ usoro
n-m-h2-explog-09.thinking.2: Ịchọta symmetry ziri ezi maka nkwupụta na-ezighị ezi
n-m-h2-explog-09.prereq.1: Inverse function na symmetry n’ahịrị y=x
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi niile n’ihe Seungwoo chịkọtara.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ụzọ eserese nke ọ bụla, họrọ otu isi, chọta nhazi ya, lelee etu a ga-esi bugharịa isi ahụ ka ọ daba n’eserese nke ọzọ.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ dee etu symmetry n’akụkụ y-axis na n’akụkụ ahịrị y=x si agbanwe nhazi isi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.a: Eserese y=2^x na y=(1/2)^x nwere symmetry n’akụkụ y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.a: Ebe (1/2)^x=2^(−x), ọ bụ eserese e gbanwere akara x. I chefuru nkwupụta ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.b: Eserese y=log_2 x na y=log_{1/2} x nwere symmetry n’akụkụ y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.b: A kọwara log naanị maka x>0, ya mere ha enweghị ike inwe symmetry n’akụkụ y-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.c: Eserese y=2^x na y=log_2 x nwere symmetry n’ahịrị y=x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.c: Ha bụ inverse function nke ibe ha, ya mere ha nwere symmetry n’akụkụ y=x. I chefuru nkwupụta ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.o.d: Eserese y=2^x na y=log_{1/2}x nwere symmetry n’ahịrị y=x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.r.d: Inverse nke 2^x bụ log_2 x, ọ bụghị log_{1/2}x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s1.explain: Ebe (1/2)^x=2^(−x), y=2^x na y=(1/2)^x nwere symmetry n’akụkụ y-axis. y=2^x na y=log_2 x bụ inverse function, ha nwere symmetry n’akụkụ y=x. Ngalaba log_{1/2}x bụ x>0, ya mere enweghị symmetry y-axis, ọ bụghịkwa inverse nke 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.prompt: Dee ahịrị eserese y=log_2x na y=log_{1/2}x nwere symmetry na ya, gosi ihe kpatara ya site n’usoro.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.0: Degharịa log_{1/2}x dịka logarithm nwere ntọala 2. Tụnyere uru y nke usoro abụọ ahụ n’otu x.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.hint.1: Lee mmekọrịta dị n’etiti uru y, kwuo n’akụkụ axis nke ụzọ ahụ si bugharịa isi.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nwetara log_{1/2}x=−log_2x site n’ịgbanwe ntọala?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Jiri nhazi isi kọwaa na n’otu x, uru y abụọ ahụ dị iche naanị na akara ha?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I kwuru etu symmetry n’akụkụ x-axis si ebugharị isi?
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.0: log_{1/2}x=log_2x/log_2(1/2)=−log_2x. N’otu x, uru y dị iche naanị na akara; ya mere eserese ahụ nwere symmetry n’akụkụ x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.1: Ha nwere symmetry n’akụkụ x-axis. Ịgbanwe ntọala na-eme log_{1/2}x ka ọ bụrụ −log_2x; isi (x,y) aghọọ (x,−y).
n-m-h2-explog-09.s.s2.model.2: Ha nwere symmetry n’akụkụ x-axis. y=log_{1/2}x bụ otu ihe na y=−log_2x; ya mere uru y nke eserese abụọ ahụ nwere akara na-emegide.

n-m-h2-explog-05.title: Ịkọwara enyi ihe mere anyị ji tụfuo t=−1
n-m-h2-explog-05.goal: Mgbe ị na-edozi exponential equation site n'nnọchi, jiri oke nke mkpụrụedemede nnọchi tinye ihe mere e ji tụfuo ngwọta n'okwu enyi pụrụ ịghọta.
n-m-h2-explog-05.material: Ndị a bụ ndetu Jiho na-edozi 4^x−3·2^x−4=0. "Ka 2^x=t. Mgbe ahụ t²−3t−4=0, (t−4)(t+1)=0, ya mere t=4 ma ọ bụ t=−1. t=−1 adịghị mma, ya mere anyị na-atụfu ya, ma site n'2^x=4, x=2." Sora hụrụ ndetu ndị a wee jụọ, "Gịnị mere ị na-atụfu t=−1 naanị? Echere m na e nwere ike inwe x nke 2^x=−1."
n-m-h2-explog-05.thinking.1: Ịgbanwe ahịrịokwu ngwọta siri ike ka ọ bụrụ okwu dị mfe
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe ị kwere ka 2^x=t, họrọ oke ụkpụrụ ziri ezi nke t nwere ike iwere.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye ọnụọgụ zuru ezu, ọnụọgụ adịghị mma, na 0 n'x ma dee ụfọdụ n'ụkpụrụ 2^x na-ewere.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee oke ụkpụrụ ị dere dara n'ime ya, ma chee echiche ma e nwere x nke na-enye 0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.a: Ị chere na 0 kwere omume kwa. Chee echiche ma e nwere x nke 2^x=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.b: Ị maara na 2^x na-ewere naanị ụkpụrụ ndị karịrị 0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.c: Ị hapụrụ ikpe ndị ebe 2^x pere mpe karịa 1 mgbe x adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.r.d: Ị hapụrụ na exponential function enweghị ike iwere ụkpụrụ adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s1.explain: Maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie x ọ bụla, 2^x na-ewere naanị ụkpụrụ ndị karịrị 0. Mgbe x na-aghọ pere mpe nke ukwuu, 2^x na-abịaru 0 nso mana ọ naghị aghọ 0. Ya mere oke nke t=2^x bụ t>0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.prompt: Dee nzaghachi nye Sora. Gbanwee "t=−1 adịghị mma, ya mere anyị na-atụfu ya" ka Sora nwee ike ịghọta ya, ma kọwaa ihe mere e nweghị x nke 2^x=−1. (Ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 3)
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.0: Malite site n'okwu Sora maara. Gịnị mere na ị gaghị enye ihe atụ nke ụkpụrụ ị na-enweta mgbe ị tinye ụkpụrụ x ole na ole n'2^x?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kama okwu "adịghị mma," tinye n'ahịrịokwu gị oke ụkpụrụ 2^x nwere ike iwere.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ jiri okwu Sora maara (dịka ọmụmaatụ, ụkpụrụ ị na-enweta mgbe ị tinye ụkpụrụ x ole na ole n'2^x)?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ nyere ihe kpatara doro anya kama okwu "adịghị mma"?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwukwara ihe mere t=4 ji pụọ ịdị n'ọrụ?
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.0: Sora, ọ bụrụ na ị tinye x=1, 0, −3 n'2^x, ị na-enweta 2, 1, 1/8, ha niile karịrị 0. N'agbanyeghị otú ị si gbanwee x, 2^x anaghị aghọ adịghị mma, ya mere enweghị x nke 2^x=−1. Ya mere anyị na-atụfu t=−1 ma jiri naanị t=4.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.1: N'agbanyeghị ugboro ole ị mụbara ma ọ bụ kewaa 2, ị na-enweta ọnụọgụ dị mma mgbe niile. 2^x na-ewere naanị ụkpụrụ karịrị 0, ya mere 2^x=−1 enweghị ike ịdị. t=4 dị mma, ya mere ọ na-enye x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s2.model.2: t=2^x dị mma mgbe niile. Ya mere ọ bụrụ na ị nweta ọnụọgụ adịghị mma dị ka t=−1, enweghị x dị otú ahụ. Nke ahụ abụghị njehie n'idozi, ọ bụ n'ihi àgwà nke 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ ọnụọgụ ngwọta n'ezie nke equation 9^x−2·3^x−3=0.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.0: Ka 3^x=t, dozie equation n't, ma chọta ụkpụrụ niile nke t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.hint.1: Maka ụkpụrụ ọ bụla nke t ị chọtara, lelee ma e nwere x na-emezu 3^x=t.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.a: Ị jikọtara ụkpụrụ abụọ nke t na x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.b: Ị hapụrụ ikpe ebe t dị mma. Lelee ụkpụrụ t ị chọtara otu n'otu.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.c: Ị chọpụtara na t=−1 anaghị enye ngwọta ma naanị t=3 ka a na-eji.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.r.d: Gụọ ọzọ mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọnụọgụ ngwọta maka t na ọnụọgụ ngwọta maka x.
n-m-h2-explog-05.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na anyị kwere ka 3^x=t, mgbe ahụ t²−2t−3=(t−3)(t+1)=0. t=3 na-enye x=1 site n'3^x=3, ma t=−1 anaghị enye ngwọta n'ihi 3^x>0. Ya mere e nwere naanị otu ngwọta n'ezie, x=1.

n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu mpempe n'otu oge. Na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ mkpebi dabere naanị n'ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h2-diff-04.title: Kedu ka a na-esi ekpebi ọnụọgụ real roots?
n-m-h2-diff-04.topic: Udi nke eserese cubic function na real roots nke nha
n-m-h2-diff-04.goal: Mgbe ọ bụla a gbakwunyere ozi, gbanwee ikpe gị banyere ọnụọgụ real roots dị iche nke cubic equation, kọwaakwa oke ebe ihe ịrịba ama na ọnụọgụ nke uru oke na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-04.material: Tụlee ọnụọgụ real roots dị iche nke cubic equation x³−3x²+k=0 (k bụ constant). Ka f(x)=x³−3x²+k, ma kpee ikpe mgbe ọ bụla a kpughere otu ozi.
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.1: Ịgụ ọnụọgụ real roots site n'udi eserese
n-m-h2-diff-04.thinking.2: Inyocha n'iche uru oke ebe ọnụọgụ na-agbanwe
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.0: Local maximum na minimum nke cubic function na udi eserese ya
n-m-h2-diff-04.prereq.1: Real roots nke nha na ebe eserese na-ezute axis x
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, tụlee ma ikpe gị chọrọ ịgbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.hint.1: Seta ugboro ole eserese na-agafe axis x n'ihe gbasara ihe ịrịba ama nke local maximum na local minimum.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.info: f(x)=x³−3x²+k bụ cubic function nke leading coefficient ya bụ positive, uru k amakwaghị.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Real roots dị iche ole ka nha f(x)=0 nwere?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Njedebe abụọ nke eserese cubic edoziri, otu na-arị elu otu na-agbadakwa, ya mere ọ na-ezute axis x opekata mpe otu ugboro. Ma ugboro ole ọ na-ezute dabere n'ebe local maximum na local minimum dị.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mgbe niile 3, ma k bụ ihe ọ bụla
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ọ gwakọtara eziokwu algebra na cubic equation nwere roots 3 na ọnụọgụ real roots dị iche.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ọ nwere ike ịbụ 1, 2, ma ọ bụ 3 dabere n'k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ọ hụrụ na ọnụọgụ ugboro eserese na-ezute axis x nwere ike ịdị iche site na k.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mgbe niile 1, ma k bụ ihe ọ bụla
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ọ kwuru na eserese na-agafe axis x naanị otu ugboro.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Anyị enweghị ike ikwu ihe ọ bụla n'ihi na anyị amaghị k
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ọ kwughị ọbụlagodi oke ọnụọgụ nwere ike ịbụ. E nwere ihe a pụrụ ịmata site n'udi cubic function.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.info: f'(x)=3x(x−2), ya mere e nwere local maximum na x=0 na local minimum na x=2. Local maximum value bụ f(0)=k, local minimum value bụkwa f(2)=k−4.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mgbe k=1, e nwere ọnụ dị iche real kedu ole?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ọ bụrụ na k=1, local maximum value bụ 1 (positive), local minimum value bụkwa −3 (negative). Eserese ahụ na-arị elu site n'ọnụ aka ekpe, na-agafe axis x, na-eru local maximum, na-agbada, na-agafe axis x, na-eru local minimum, ma na-arịkwa elu ọzọ iji gafee axis x, ya mere e nwere ọnụ dị iche real 3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ọ hụrụ naanị na local maximum value 1 bụ positive ma chee na eserese ahụ na-ezute axis otu ugboro.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ọ na-eche banyere ikpe ebe eserese ahụ na-emetụ axis x. Nke ahụ na-emetụta naanị mgbe uru oke bụ kpọmkwem 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ọ hụrụ na local maximum bụ positive na local minimum bụ negative, ya mere eserese ahụ na-agafe axis x ugboro atọ.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: A chọrọ ozi ọzọ iji mara
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Mgbe k=1, local maximum value na local minimum value abụọ ka akọwapụtara.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ịgbanwe k na-ebuga eserese ahụ elu ma ọ bụ ala, ya mere ihe ịrịba ama nke local maximum value k na local minimum value k−4 na-adabere na k, e nwekwara oge otu n'ime ha na-aghọ 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Maka uru k kedu ka e nwere kpọmkwem ọnụ dị iche real 2?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ọ bụrụ na k=0, f(x)=x²(x−3), ya mere ọnụ bụ x=0 (ebe mmetụ) na x=3; ọ bụrụ na k=4, f(x)=(x+1)(x−2)², ya mere ọnụ bụ x=−1 na x=2 (ebe mmetụ). N'ikpe abụọ ahụ e nwere ọnụ dị iche real 2. Eserese ahụ na-emetụ axis x kpọmkwem mgbe uru oke bụ 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ọ lere naanị ikpe ebe local maximum value bụ 0. E nwekwara ikpe ebe local minimum value bụ 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ọ lere naanị ikpe ebe local minimum value bụ 0. E nwekwara ikpe ebe local maximum value bụ 0.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Oke a bụ ebe uru oke nwere ihe ịrịba ama megidere ibe ha, ya mere e nwere ọnụ real 3.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Mgbe k=0 ma ọ bụ k=4
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ, n'ihi na anyị amaghị k, naanị ihe anyị maara bụ na ọnụọgụ ọnụ real nwere ike ịdị iche. Mgbe anyị chọtara uru oke, anyị nwere ike ikpebi ọnụọgụ maka k=1, anyị hụkwara oke ebe ọnụọgụ ahụ na-agbanwe site na 3 ruo 2 n'oge uru oke ghọrọ 0. Enwere ike ikpebi ọnụọgụ ọnụ real nke nha site n'eserese na ihe ịrịba ama nke uru oke.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.prompt: Dee oke k ga-anọ n'ime ya ka e nwee ọnụ dị iche real atọ, kọwaakwa ihe mere uru oke k=0 na k=4 adịghị agụnye.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ihe ịrịba ama local maximum value na local minimum value nke ọ bụla ga-enwe ka eserese ahụ gafee axis x ugboro atọ.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mee factor nke f(x) mgbe k=0 na mgbe k=4, chọtakwa ọnụ ozugbo.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere ọnọdụ ihe ịrịba ama maka local maximum value na maka local minimum value?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ lelere ozugbo ọnụ ole dị n'ezie na uru oke?
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.0: Local maximum value k ga-abụ positive, local minimum value k−4 ga-abụkwa negative, ya mere 0<k<4. Ọ bụrụ na k=0 ma ọ bụ k=4, uru oke bụ 0, ya mere eserese ahụ na-emetụ axis x e nwekwara naanị ọnụ dị iche real 2.
n-m-h2-diff-04.s.s2.model.1: 0<k<4. Local maximum ga-anọ n'elu axis x, local minimum ga-anọkwa n'okpuru ya ka eserese ahụ gafee ugboro atọ. N'uru nsọtụ 0 na 4, ọnụ okpukpu abụọ na-apụta e nwekwara naanị ọnụ dị iche abụọ, ya mere a hapụrụ ha.

n-m-h2-limit-03.title: Mmekọrịta dị n’etiti akara uru nsọtụ na mgbọrọgwụ n’ime interval
n-m-h2-limit-03.topic: Oke na ịga n’ihu nke ọrụ: ntụgharị Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-03.goal: Kewaa ihe Intermediate Value Theorem na-enye (ọnọdụ zuru ezu) na ihe ọ naghị enye, mepụta ma lelee ihe atụ ebe ntụgharị theorem ahụ adịghị adị.
n-m-h2-limit-03.material: Maka ọrụ f na-aga n’ihu, Intermediate Value Theorem na-ekwu, “Ọ bụrụ f(0)f(4)<0, mgbe ahụ e nwere x n’ime (0, 4) ebe f(x)=0.” Doyun na-ekwu, “Mgbe f(0)f(4)>0, mgbọrọgwụ agaghị adị n’ime (0, 4).”
n-m-h2-limit-03.thinking.0: Ikpebi ọdịdị ihe atụ na-emegide ya
n-m-h2-limit-03.thinking.1: Iwulite ọtụtụ ihe atụ na-agbaso ọnọdụ
n-m-h2-limit-03.thinking.2: Ikwu ntụziaka theorem ahụ (ọnọdụ zuru ezu)
n-m-h2-limit-03.prereq.0: Intermediate Value Theorem maka ọrụ na-aga n’ihu
n-m-h2-limit-03.prereq.1: Eserese ọrụ quadratic na ebe mgbọrọgwụ dị
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.prompt: Iji gosi na nkwupụta Doyun ezighị ezi, ụdị ọrụ na-aga n’ihu dị aṅaa ka ị ga-achọ?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa nkwupụta Doyun dịka “echiche e chere → nkwubi okwu.”
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ihe echiche e chere na nkwubi okwu kwesịrị ịbụ ka nkwupụta ahụ wee bụrụ ụgha.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.a: Ọrụ na-aga n’ihu nwere f(0)f(4)<0 ma enweghị mgbọrọgwụ n’ime (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.a: N’ihi Intermediate Value Theorem, ọrụ dị otú ahụ enweghị ike ịdị. Ọ bụrụ na theorem ahụ ziri ezi, ị gaghị achọta otu.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.b: Ọrụ na-aga n’ihu nwere f(0)f(4)>0 ma enweghị mgbọrọgwụ n’ime (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.b: Ihe atụ a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta Doyun, ya mere ọ naghị emebi ya.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.c: Ọrụ na-aga n’ihu nwere f(0)f(4)<0 ma nwee mgbọrọgwụ n’ime (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ọnọdụ theorem ahụ na-ekwe nkwa, ya mere o nweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.o.d: Ọrụ na-aga n’ihu nwere f(0)f(4)>0 ma nwee mgbọrọgwụ n’ime (0, 4).
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s1.explain: Iji gosi na nkwupụta ụdị “ọ bụrụ ..., mgbe ahụ ...” bụ ụgha, ịchọrọ ihe atụ na-agbaso echiche e chere ma na-emebi nkwubi okwu, ya bụ mgbọrọgwụ dị n’ime (0, 4) n’agbanyeghị na f(0)f(4)>0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.prompt: Ka f(x)=(x−a)(x−b). Tinye ụzọ abụọ (a, b) dị iche nke na-eme f(0)f(4)>0 ma f(x)=0 nwee mgbọrọgwụ n’ezie abụọ dị iche n’ime (0, 4). (a<b)
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dee f(0) na f(4) site na a na b, chọpụta ebe mgbọrọgwụ ga-adị ka uru abụọ ahụ nwee otu akara.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ otu mgbọrọgwụ n’ime interval (0, 4), ọnụọgụ zuru ezu ma ọ bụ desimali, họrọ nke ọzọ n’etiti ya na nsọtụ interval, jiri mgbakọ ozugbo lelee ya.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.explain: f(0)=ab, f(4)=(4−a)(4−b); ọ bụrụ na mgbọrọgwụ abụọ ahụ dị n’etiti 0 na 4, ha abụọ dị mma. Ya mere ọbụna mgbe f(0)f(4)>0, mgbọrọgwụ abụọ dị n’ime (0, 4). Eserese ahụ na-adaba n’okpuru x-axis wee laghachi elu.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Ọbụna na ihe atụ dị otú ahụ, Intermediate Value Theorem ezighị ezi? Kọwaa ihe kpatara ya n’ahịrịokwu otu ma ọ bụ abụọ.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Degharịa ntụziaka theorem ahụ: ihe na-egosi ihe.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chee ma ahịrịokwu ntụziaka a tụgharịrị pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị ji okwu kọwaa ntụziaka theorem ahụ nke ọma?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị gosiri na ihe atụ ahụ anaghị emegide theorem?
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Intermediate Value Theorem na-ekwu naanị na ọ bụrụ na akara dị iche, mgbọrọgwụ dị. Ọ naghị ekwu na mgbọrọgwụ adịghị ma akara hà nhata; ya mere eserese gafere x-axis ugboro abụọ anaghị emegide theorem.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.1: A naghị ekwe nkwa ntụgharị theorem ahụ. Ọbụna ma uru nsọtụ nwere otu akara, eserese nwere ike ịgafe x-axis n’etiti wee laghachi, ya mere mgbọrọgwụ nwere ike ịdị.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.2: Theorem ahụ na-ekwu naanị “ọ bụrụ akara dị iche, mgbọrọgwụ dị.” Ọ naghị ekwu “ọ bụrụ mgbọrọgwụ dị, akara ga-adị iche.”
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s2.because.model.3: Ihe theorem ahụ na-ekwu ruru naanị “ọ bụrụ akara dị iche, mgbọrọgwụ dị.” Nke a apụtaghị na nke a bụ naanị ọnọdụ mgbọrọgwụ ga-adị.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ ọrụ niile Intermediate Value Theorem naanị ya na-eme ka i jide n’aka na e nwere x n’ime (0, 4) ebe f(x)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.0: Maka ọrụ nke ọ bụla, lelee ma akara f(0) na f(4) na ma e nwere oghere ọ bụla n’ime [0, 4].
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.hint.1: Dee ihe abụọ theorem chọrọ iji kwe nkwa mgbọrọgwụ, tụnyere nhọrọ nke ọ bụla na ha.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.a: f(0)=4 na f(4)=4 nwere otu akara, ya mere echiche theorem ahụ emezughị. Ọbụna ma x=2 bụ mgbọrọgwụ, theorem a ekwekwaghị nkwa ya.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.r.c: Akara f(0) na f(4) dị iche, ma f anaghị aga n’ihu na x=2, ya mere a pụghị iji theorem ahụ. N’ezie, mgbọrọgwụ adịghịkwa.
n-m-h2-limit-03.s.s3.explain: Maka b, f(0)=−1 na f(4)=3, ọ bụ ọrụ polynomial, ya mere ọ na-aga n’ihu, theorem ahụ na-ekwekwa nkwa mgbọrọgwụ. Otu ihe ahụ dịkwa maka d, ebe f(0)=−3 na f(4)=5, f na-agakwa n’ihu. Maka a, f(0)=4 na f(4)=4 nwere otu akara, ya mere a pụghị iji theorem ahụ (mgbọrọgwụ x=2 dị, ma theorem ahụ ekwekwaghị nkwa). Maka c, akara dị iche ma f na-agbaji na x=2, ọ naghị aga n’ihu, ya mere a pụghị iji theorem ahụ.

n-m-h2-trig-10.title: Nha akụkụ na nha oke trigonometric n’ime triangle
n-m-h2-trig-10.goal: N’okpuru ọnọdụ na A, B, C bụ akụkụ ime triangle, kpebie ntụziaka ntụnyere nha akụkụ si aga n’iji sin, cos, tan tụnyere, nye ihe kpatara ya site n’iwu sine na akụkụ obtuse.
n-m-h2-trig-10.material: Ụmụ akwụkwọ anọ kwuru ihe ndị a banyere akụkụ ime A, B, C nke triangle ABC. Tụlee naanị ọnọdụ ebe uru oke trigonometric akọwara.
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.0: Kpebie ma nkwupụta ziri ezi ka ọ bụ ụgha n’okpuru ọnọdụ ya
n-m-h2-trig-10.thinking.1: Jikọta akụkụ na akụkụ ahịrị site n’iwu sine
n-m-h2-trig-10.prereq.1: Njirimara na akụkụ ahịrị na-emegide akụkụ ka ukwuu na-adị ogologo
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta niile ziri ezi mgbe niile na triangle ABC.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye akụkụ kpọmkwem (30°, 100° wdg.) maka A na B n’ime nkwupụta nke ọ bụla.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.hint.1: Jiri iwu sine gbanwee sinA na sinB ka ha bụrụ ogologo akụkụ, dee ihe ntụnyere nha na-egosi.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-ekwu na akụkụ ka ukwuu nwere uru sine ka ukwuu. Ị nwere ike iji iwu sine tụnyere ogologo akụkụ dị n’ihu akụkụ abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.o.b: Ọ bụrụ cosA>cosB, mgbe ahụ A>B
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-ekwu na cosine ka ukwuu pụtara akụkụ ka ukwuu. Lee otú cosine si agbanwe ka akụkụ na-abawanye site na 0° ruo 180°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.c: Ị gbanwere nha sine ka ọ bụrụ ogologo akụkụ iji tụnyere ha, jiri eziokwu na akụkụ ka ukwuu dị n’ihu akụkụ ka ukwuu.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.r.d: Ị chefuru na akụkụ triangle nwere ike ịbụ obtuse. Tụnyere uru tan abụọ mgbe A=30° na B=100°.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s1.explain: Site n’iwu sine, a=2R·sinA na b=2R·sinB, ya mere sinA>sinB kwekọrọ na a>b; ebe akụkụ ahịrị ka ukwuu dị n’ihu akụkụ ka ukwuu, ọ kwekọrọkwa na A>B. Ya mere a na c ziri ezi. Ọ bụrụ cosA>cosB, A<B, ya mere b tụgharịrị azụ; tan adịghị mma maka akụkụ obtuse, yabụ mgbe A=30° na B=100°, tanA>tanB ma A<B, nke na-eme d bụrụ ụgha.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere “ọ bụrụ sinA>sinB, mgbe ahụ A>B” ji dị n’eziokwu n’ime triangle (c), nye otu ihe atụ na-emegide nke na-egosi na (d) adịghị arụ ọrụ.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.0: Jiri iwu sine degharịa sinA na sinB dịka ogologo akụkụ.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.hint.1: Were otu n’ime A na B bụrụ obtuse, tụlee akara uru tan.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.placeholder: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, site n’iwu sine ... Ihe atụ na-emegide: A=..., B=...
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị gbanwere ntụnyere uru sine ka ọ bụrụ ntụnyere ogologo akụkụ?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị tụlere uru tan A na tan B n’ezie?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị gosiri n’ihe atụ gị na A<B ma tanA>tanB?
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.0: Site n’iwu sine, a=2R sinA na b=2R sinB, ya mere ọ bụrụ sinA>sinB, a>b. Akụkụ ahịrị ka ukwuu dị n’ihu akụkụ ka ukwuu, ya mere A>B. Ihe atụ megide ya: A=30°, B=100°. tan30° dị mma, tan100° adịghị mma, ya mere tanA>tanB ma A<B.
n-m-h2-trig-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ sinA>sinB, iwu sine na-egosi na akụkụ ahịrị a dị ogologo karịa b, mgbe ahụ A ka B. tan adịghị mma maka akụkụ obtuse; dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ A=45° na B=120°, tanA=1>tanB=−√3 ma A<B.

n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'ime ngwọta Jiho.
n-m-h2-diff-01.title: Ịlele ngwọta chọtara tangent line kwụ ọtọ na ahịrị ọzọ
n-m-h2-diff-01.topic: Nhata tangent line: mkpọda ahịrị kwụ ọtọ
n-m-h2-diff-01.goal: N’ngwọta na-achọta tangent nke curve nke kwụ ọtọ na ahịrị e nyere, chọta ahịrị mbụ ezighi ezi, dozie ya, jiri ngwaahịa mkpọda lelee.
n-m-h2-diff-01.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta Jiho maka ịchọta, n’etiti tangent ndị a dọtara n’isi curve y=x²−4x+5, nke kwụ ọtọ na ahịrị y=x/2+1. (x² pụtara x squared; x/2 pụtara x kewara na 2.)
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.0: Soro ahịrị ngwọta otu otu ka ị chọta ahịrị mbụ ezighi ezi.
n-m-h2-diff-01.thinking.1: Ịtụgharị ọnọdụ perpendicular ka ọ bụrụ mmekọrịta n'etiti slopes
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.0: Na uru derivative bụ slope nke tangent line
n-m-h2-diff-01.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta n'etiti slopes mgbe ahịrị abụọ bụ perpendicular
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee otu otu otu ahịrị ọ bụla si n'ahịrị tupu ya bịa.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta otu e si tụgharịa okwu "perpendicular" ka ọ bụrụ mmekọrịta n'nha ndị ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.0: Ebe f(x)=x²−4x+5, f'(x)=2x−4. (A na-agụ f' dịka "f prime.")
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.1: Ebe ọ bụ perpendicular n'ahịrị y=x/2+1, slope nke tangent line bụ −1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.line.3: Ebe mmetụ bụ (7/4, 17/16), tangent line bụkwa y=−(1/2)(x−7/4)+17/16.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ nke mbụ na-ezighị ezi. Mgbe ahịrị abụọ bụ perpendicular, ngwaahịa slopes ha bụ −1. Slope nke ahịrị perpendicular n'ahịrị nwere slope 1/2 abụghị −1/2, nke na-agbanwe naanị ihe ịrịba ama, kama ọ bụ ọnụọgụ ngwaahịa ya na 1/2 bụ −1. Mgbakọ n'ahịrị 3 na 4 na-eso ahịrị 2, ya mere mgbakọ n'onwe ya ziri ezi, ma nsonaazụ na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.prompt: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighị ezi ma chọta x-coordinate nke ebe mmetụ na nha nke tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.0: Seta ahịrị perpendicular n'ahịrị nwere slope 1/2, mgbe ahụ họrọ ọnụọgụ ole na ole nwere ike ịbụ slope ahụ ma nwalee ha site n'ịgbakọ na 1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tọọ slope ọhụrụ hà f'(x) ma chọta x, mgbe ahụ chọta y-coordinate nke ebe ahụ site na f(x).
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere ọnọdụ perpendicular dịka ngwaahịa nke slopes?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ chọtara y-coordinate nke ebe mmetụ site n'nha nke curve?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ tinyere nha nke tangent line n'udi y=…?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ perpendicular, ngwaahịa nke slopes bụ −1, ya mere (1/2)×m=−1 na m=−2. Site na 2x−4=−2, x=1, na f(1)=2, ya mere ebe mmetụ bụ (1, 2) tangent line bụkwa y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrị perpendicular n'ahịrị nwere slope 1/2 nwere slope −2. X nwere f'(x)=−2 bụ 1, ebe mmetụ bụkwa (1,2). Ime y−2=−2(x−1) ka ọ dị mfe na-enye y=−2x+4.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.prompt: N'ngwọta Jiho, kedu nlele ga-ejide njehie a n'ọsọ kacha?
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chetụ nha na-ejide n'etiti slopes nke ahịrị perpendicular abụọ.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tinye nhọrọ ọ bụla ozugbo n'slopes abụọ Jiho, 1/2 na −1/2.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.a: Gbakwunye slopes abụọ ahụ ma lelee ma ha na-eme 0
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.a: Ịgbakwunye ruo 0 bụ mmekọrịta ebe slopes nwere naanị ihe ịrịba ama megidere. Ọ dị nso na ntụgharị n'ofe axis x karịa perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.b: Lelee naanị ma slopes abụọ ahụ nwere ihe ịrịba ama megidere
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.b: Ihe ịrịba ama megidere dị mkpa ma ọ bụghị zuru ezu. Nha nke slopes ga-ekwekọrịkwa ka ahịrị bụrụ perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.c: Mụbaa slopes abụọ ahụ ma lelee ma ha na-eme −1
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.c: Nke a na-anwale ozugbo ihe perpendicular pụtara site n'iji ịmụba.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.o.d: Lelee ma y-coordinate nke ebe mmetụ dị na curve
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.r.d: Ọbụlagodi na ebe mmetụ dị na curve, nlele a enweghị ike ịgwa ma slope na-emezu ọnọdụ perpendicular.
n-m-h2-diff-01.s.s3.explain: (1/2)×(−1/2)=−1/4, nke abụghị −1. Ilele ma ngwaahịa bụ −1 na-ekpughe njehie n'ahịrị 2 ozugbo.

n-m-h2-diff-02.title: Ọ bụrụ na average rate of change bụ positive, function ọ̀ na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye n'oge ahụ?
n-m-h2-diff-02.topic: Average rate of change na functions na-abawanye na na-ebelata
n-m-h2-diff-02.goal: Kwenyesie ike, site na quadratic function ị wuru n'onwe gị, na ọbụlagodi average rate of change n'oge bụ positive, akụkụ nke function n'ime oge ahụ nwere ike na-ebelata.
n-m-h2-diff-02.material: Youngwoo na-ekwu, "Ọ bụrụ na average rate of change nke function f n'oge [0, 4] bụ positive, mgbe ahụ f na-abawanye n'oge a." Ị chọrọ ịnwale nke a site na functions nke udi f(x)=x²−bx (b bụ constant).
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.0: Ịkewa nkwupụta ahụ n'echiche na mmechi
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.1: Idee ọnọdụ nke ihe atụ megidere dịka nha
n-m-h2-diff-02.thinking.2: Ịkewa ịtụnyere njedebe abụọ na mgbanwe n'ime oge
n-m-h2-diff-02.prereq.0: Ihe average rate of change pụtara na mgbakọ ya
n-m-h2-diff-02.prereq.1: Ihe ịrịba ama nke derivative na ịbawanye/ibelata
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.prompt: Iji gosi na nkwupụta Youngwoo bụ ụgha, kedu ụdị function ka anyị kwesịrị ịchọ?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa nkwupụta Youngwoo n'udi "ọ bụrụ na echiche, mgbe ahụ mmechi" ma dee ya.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ihe echiche na mmechi nke ọ bụla ga-abụ ka nkwupụta ahụ bụrụ ụgha.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.a: Function nke average rate of change ya bụ negative ma na-abawanye n'oge niile
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.a: Function dị otú ahụ enweghị ike ịdị. Ọ nweghịkwa mmekọrịta na nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.b: Function nke average rate of change ya bụ positive ma nwere akụkụ na-ebelata n'ime oge ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.c: Function nke average rate of change ya bụ positive ma na-abawanye n'oge niile
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ ọmụmaatụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ, ya mere ọ pụghị imebi nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.o.d: Function nke average rate of change ya bụ 0 ma bụ constant n'oge niile
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.r.d: Average rate of change abụghị positive, ya mere ọ naghị emezu echiche nke nkwupụta ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s1.explain: Iji gosi na nkwupụta nke udi "ọ bụrụ na ~, mgbe ahụ ~" bụ ụgha, ị chọrọ ọmụmaatụ na-emezu echiche (average rate of change bụ positive) ma na-emezughị mmechi (na-abawanye n'oge ahụ).
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.prompt: Maka f(x)=x²−bx, tinye b na p ka average rate of change n'[0, 4] bụrụ positive, ma n'ebe ụfọdụ p n'ime (0, 4) f'(p)<0 (f na-ebelata n'akụkụ ebe ahụ). Mee ọmụmaatụ 3 nwere uru b dị iche.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kwuo f(0) na f(4) n'okwu b, ma chọta oke b nke average rate of change bụ positive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.hint.1: Họrọ otu uru b ma chọpụta ebe n'ime oge ahụ f'(x)=2x−b bụ negative.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Average rate of change (f(4)−f(0))/4 bụ positive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Average rate of change (f(4)−f(0))/4 abụghị positive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.fail.c2: p ga-abụ nke karịrị 0 ma dị ala karịa 4.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.ok.c3: f'(p)=2p−b bụ negative, ya mere f na-ebelata n'akụkụ p.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.explain: f(4)−f(0)=16−4b, ya mere average rate of change bụ 4−b. Ka nke a bụrụ positive, b<4, ka f'(x)=2x−b bụrụ negative n'ebe ụfọdụ n'oge ahụ, a chọrọ b>0. Ya mere b ọ bụla nwere 0<b<4 na-enye ihe atụ megidere. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ na b=2, mgbe ahụ f(x)=x²−2x na-ebelata n'[0, 1] ma na-abawanye n'[1, 4].
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Ọbụlagodi na ọmụmaatụ dị otú ahụ dị, eziokwu na average rate of change bụ positive abụghị ozi ụgha. Kọwaa n'otu ahịrịokwu ma ọ bụ abụọ ihe ị nwere ike ịmata na ihe ị pụghị ịmata site n'average rate of change positive.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Lelee ọzọ nke n'ebe nke oge uru a na-eji mgbe a na-agbakọ average rate of change.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tụnyere uru f(1), f(0), na f(4), ma seta otu eserese si gaa.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru na naanị uru average rate of change na-eji bụ njedebe abụọ?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kewara mgbanwe n'ime oge na ntụnyere njedebe?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Average rate of change sitere n'itụnyere naanị uru n'njedebe abụọ, ya mere ọ na-agwa anyị naanị na f(4)>f(0). Ọbụlagodi eserese na-agbada n'ebe ụfọdụ n'etiti, ọ bụ positive ma ọ bụrụ na ọ rịgoro karịa ná njedebe.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na average rate of change bụ positive, ị nwere ike ịmata na uru n'njedebe karịrị uru mmalite, ma ị pụghị ịmata ma ọ na-ebelata nwa oge n'etiti oge ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na naanị ihe ị maara bụ na average rate of change nke f n'[0, 4] bụ positive, kedu ihe a pụrụ ikwu na ọ bụ eziokwu n'ụzọ dị mkpa?
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dee usoro maka average rate of change ma tụlee ihe ịrịba ama nke denominator.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.hint.1: Nwalee ma nhọrọ ọ bụla bụ eziokwu ma ọ bụ ụgha site n'itinye ya n'ọmụmaatụ ndị ị mere n's2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.a: f'(x)>0 maka x ọ bụla n'oge ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.a: Ọbụlagodi mgbe average rate of change bụ positive, f' nwere ike ịbụ negative n'ebe ụfọdụ n'oge ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.b: E nwere ike inwe akụkụ na-ebelata, dịka n'ọmụmaatụ ị mere n'ime s2.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.o.c: f(x)>0 maka x ọ bụla n'oge ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.r.c: Average rate of change na-egosi ọnụọgụ mgbanwe, ọ bụghị ihe ịrịba ama nke uru function.
n-m-h2-diff-02.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na average rate of change (f(4)−f(0))/(4−0) bụ positive, denominator bụ positive, ya mere f(4)−f(0) bụ positive. Naanị ihe ị nwere ike ịmata bụ ntụnyere njedebe.

n-m-h2-diff-03.title: Ihe ọ pụtara ka curves abụọ bụrụ tangent n'otu ebe
n-m-h2-diff-03.topic: Ọnọdụ ka curves abụọ bụrụ tangent
n-m-h2-diff-03.goal: Chọpụta nha ole ọnọdụ "curves abụọ bụ tangent n'otu ebe" na-enye, ma kewaa mgbe ọnọdụ ndị ahụ adịghị zuru ezu na mgbe ha zuru ezu.
n-m-h2-diff-03.material: Curve y=f(x)=x³ na curve y=g(x)=x²+ax+b (a na b bụ constants) bụ tangent n'ebe (1, 1). (Nke a pụtara na curves abụọ ahụ na-agafe otu ebe ma nwee otu tangent line n'ebe ahụ.) Ị chọrọ ịchọta a na b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.0: Ịtụgharị ọnọdụ ndị e nyere ka ha bụrụ nha
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.1: Ịkewa ọnọdụ dị mkpa na ndị na-adịghị zuru ezu
n-m-h2-diff-03.thinking.2: Ịtụnyere ọnụọgụ nke amaghị na ọnụọgụ nha
n-m-h2-diff-03.prereq.0: Uru derivative na slope nke tangent line
n-m-h2-diff-03.prereq.1: Ihe ebe dị na curve pụtara
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.prompt: Nha g kedu ka ị kwesịrị itọ iji kpebie a na b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dee dịka nha eziokwu abụọ (ọnọdụ, slope) achọrọ ka curves abụọ bụrụ tangent n'otu ebe.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tinye x=1 n'f(x)=x³ iji chọta y-coordinate nke ebe ahụ na slope nke tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.a: Ọnọdụ ịgafe ebe (1, 1) ziri ezi, ma g(0)=0 bụ ọnọdụ nke na-adịghị n'nsogbu ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.b: Ọnọdụ ịgafe (1, 1) ziri ezi, ma a ga-elele slope n'ebe mmetụ x=1, ọ bụghị x=0.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.r.d: Ọ gbanwere uru f(1) na f'(1). Ị ga-ekewa y-coordinate nke ebe na slope nke tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s1.explain: Curve g ga-agafe ebe (1, 1), ya mere g(1)=1, ka tangent lines bụrụ otu, slopes n'x=1 ga-ahàkwa nhata, ya mere g'(1)=f'(1)=3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.prompt: Chọta uru a na b, ma dee n'otu ahịrị otu ị siri lelee na uru ị chọtara na-emezu nha abụọ e tọrọ n's1.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta g'(x), mgbe ahụ tọọ uru ya n'x=1 hà 3.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye a ị chọtara n'nha maka ịgafe ebe iji chọta b.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere ọnọdụ slope na ọnọdụ ebe nke ọ bụla dịka nha?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ tinyeghachiri a na b ị chọtara n'nha abụọ ahụ?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.0: g'(x)=2x+a, ya mere g'(1)=2+a=3 na-enye a=1. Itinye a=1 n'g(1)=1+a+b=1 na-enye b=−1. Mgbe e lelere, g(1)=1 na g'(1)=3, ya mere ọ ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s2.model.1: Site n'ọnọdụ slope 2+a=3, a=1, na site n'ọnọdụ ịgafe ebe, 1+1+b=1, ya mere b=−1. Elele m site n'itinyeghachi n'nha abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.prompt: Oge a ị maghị ebe mmetụ, ị maara naanị na curves y=x³ na y=x²+ax+b bụ "tangent n'otu ebe." N'ikpe a, a kpebiri a na b?
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ka t bụrụ x-coordinate nke ebe mmetụ ma dee nha abụọ maka tangency.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.hint.1: Gụọ ọnụọgụ nke amaghị na ọnụọgụ nha ma tụnyere ha.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.a: Akpebighị. X-coordinate t nke ebe mmetụ bụkwa amaghị, ya mere e nwere amaghị 3 ma naanị nha 2
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.b: Akpebiri. Ọnọdụ tangency na-enye nha abụọ, ya mere enwere ike ịchọta a na b
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.b: Ị hapụrụ na, ebe amaghị ebe mmetụ, x-coordinate ya na-aghọkwa amaghị ọhụrụ.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.c: Akpebighị. Ọnọdụ tangency na-enye naanị otu nha
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.c: Ọnọdụ tangency na-enye ọnọdụ na slope, ya bụ, nha abụọ. Ị gụrụ nha n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.o.d: Akpebiri. Maka tangency b ga-abụ 0, mgbe ahụ a kpebikwara naanị otu
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.r.d: Enweghị ntọala n'nsogbu ahụ maka b ịbụ 0. Ọ bụrụ na amaghị ebe mmetụ, b nwere ike ịgbanwe kwa.
n-m-h2-diff-03.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na x-coordinate nke ebe mmetụ bụ t, mgbe ahụ t³=t²+at+b na 3t²=2t+a, ya mere e nwere nha abụọ na amaghị atọ, a, b, na t. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, t=1 na-enye (a, b)=(1, −1) na t=2 na-enye (a, b)=(8, −12); oge ọ bụla t gbanwere, (a, b) dị iche na-apụta.

n-m-h2-diff-05.title: Tangent line ọ̀ na-ezute akụkụ ahụ naanị n'ebe mmetụ?
n-m-h2-diff-05.topic: Ebe nzute nke tangent line na akụkụ
n-m-h2-diff-05.goal: Nwalee nkwupụta "Tangent line na-ezute akụkụ ahụ naanị n'ebe mmetụ" site na akụkụ y=x³, ma megharịa ihe tangent line pụtara dịka ahịrị nke slope ya bụ uru derivative.
n-m-h2-diff-05.material: Hajun na-ekwu, "Tangent line bụ ahịrị na-ezute akụkụ ahụ naanị n'ebe mmetụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị seta tangent line ma ọ na-ezutekwa akụkụ ahụ n'ebe ọzọ, ị setaghị tangent ahụ nke ọma." Ị chọrọ ịnwale nkwupụta a site na akụkụ y=x³. (x³ pụtara x cubed.)
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.0: Ịhọrọ ọmụmaatụ nwere ike ịnwale nkwupụta ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.1: Ịchọta ebe nzute nke tangent line na akụkụ ahụ n'ọtụtụ ebe mmetụ
n-m-h2-diff-05.thinking.2: Imeghari ihe tangent line pụtara n'okwu
n-m-h2-diff-05.prereq.0: Uru derivative na nha nke tangent line
n-m-h2-diff-05.prereq.1: Ime factor nke nha cubic (ọnụ okpukpu abụọ)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ụzọ kacha kwesị iji nwalee nkwupụta Hajun?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.0: Kọwaa n'okwu ọmụmaatụ na-agbaji nkwupụta ahụ ga-adị.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị were ebe mmetụ dịka (a, a³), ị nwere ike ide nha tangent line n'okwu a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.a: Seta tangent line naanị n'origin (0, 0) ma lelee ebe ọ na-ezute akụkụ ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.a: Ịlele naanị otu ebe nwere ike igosi naanị ọmụmaatụ ndị kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ. Nnwale ga-elele ọmụmaatụ ebe nkwupụta ahụ nwere ike ịgbaji.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.b: Nyochaa tangent line naanị n'ebe slope ya bụ 0
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.b: Ebe slope bụ 0 bụ otu ebe pụrụ iche, ya mere ọ naghị anọchite anya ebe mmetụ n'ozuzu.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.c: Seta eserese ma jiri anya lelee ma tangent line na akụkụ ahụ dị ka e jikọtara ha
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.r.c: Udi e ji anya hụ naanị enweghị ike ịgwa ma ha na-ezutekwa ọzọ n'ebe dị anya.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.o.d: Chọta tangent lines n'ọtụtụ ebe mmetụ (a, a³) ma nyochaa ebe nzute ndị ọzọ
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha, ga-abụrịrị tangent line na-ezutekwa akụkụ ahụ n'ebe ọzọ karịa ebe mmetụ. Iji chọta otu, ị ga-eseta nha tangent line n'ọtụtụ ebe mmetụ, ọ bụghị otu ma ọ bụ abụọ, ma dozie ya na akụkụ ahụ ọnụ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.prompt: Chọta ma tinye ụzọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu 3 (a, b), nwere uru a dị iche, nke tangent line n'ebe mmetụ (a, a³) na-ezutekwa akụkụ y=x³ n'ebe (b, b³) nke abụghị ebe mmetụ. (a si na −5 ruo 5)
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dee slope na nha nke tangent line n'ebe mmetụ (a, a³) n'okwu a.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dee nha n'okwu b nke ga-adị ka ebe (b, b³) dị na tangent line ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.hint.2: Tinye otu uru ọnụọgụ zuru ezu a n'otu oge ma chọta b, ị ga-ahụkwa ụkpụrụ maka b.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.var.b: x-coordinate b nke ebe nzute ọzọ
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c1: a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c1: a ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −5 ruo 5, b ga-abụkwa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c2: b dị iche na ebe mmetụ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ọ bụrụ na b hà a, ọ bụ ebe mmetụ n'onwe ya.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.ok.c3: Ebe (b, b³) dị na tangent line.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Ebe (b, b³) adịghị na tangent line y=3a²x−2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s2.explain: Tangent line n'ebe mmetụ (a, a³) bụ y=3a²x−2a³. Ịdozi ya na akụkụ ahụ ọnụ na-enye x³−3a²x+2a³=(x−a)²(x+2a)=0, ya mere x=a (ebe mmetụ, ọnụ okpukpu abụọ) na x=−2a. Ọ bụrụ na a≠0, mgbe ahụ −2a dị iche na a, ya mere tangent line na-ezutekwa akụkụ ahụ n'ebe ọzọ karịa ebe mmetụ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.prompt: Zaa Hajun. Nkwupụta Hajun ọ̀ ziri ezi? Kọwaa site n'iji ọmụmaatụ dị n'elu dịka ihe akaebe, kwuokwa nke ọma ihe tangent line bụ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.0: Họrọ otu ọmụmaatụ ị mere na s2 ma dee ebe niile tangent line na-ezute akụkụ ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kwuo "tangent" n'okwu slope, ọ bụghị ọnụọgụ ebe nzute.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ nyere ọmụmaatụ doro anya (ebe mmetụ na ebe nzute dị iche)?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kọwara tangent line n'okwu slope?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ zere ịghọtahie nke a dịka ihe na-eme naanị n'akụkụ a?
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụ ihe na-ezighị ezi. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, n'y=x³, tangent line y=3x−2 na (1, 1) na-ezutekwa akụkụ ahụ na x=−2. Tangent line bụ ahịrị nke slope ya bụ uru derivative n'ebe mmetụ, ọ bụkwa tangent line ọbụlagodi na ọ na-ezutekwa akụkụ ahụ n'ebe ọzọ.
n-m-h2-diff-05.s.s3.model.1: Mba. Tangent line bụ ahịrị na-emetụ akụkụ ahụ ọdụ ebe mmetụ (slope ya bụ derivative n'ebe ahụ), ya mere ọ nwere ike ịgafekwa akụkụ ahụ ọzọ n'ebe dị anya. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, tangent line na (1, 1) na-agafekwa n'ebe (−2, −8).

n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c1: a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke.
n-m-h2-diff-06.title: Iwu cubic function nke uru oke abụọ ya na-eme na x>0
n-m-h2-diff-06.topic: Uru oke nke cubic function na ọnụ nke derivative ya
n-m-h2-diff-06.goal: Gbanwee ọnọdụ banyere ebe uru oke dị ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ banyere ọnụ nke derivative, ma jiri onwe gị wue cubic functions dị iche iche na-emezu ọnọdụ niile.
n-m-h2-diff-06.material: Ị chọrọ iwu function f(x)=x³+ax²+bx (a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu) nwere local maximum na local minimum, ebe uru x na-enye uru oke ndị ahụ abụọ bụ positive. (ax² pụtara a okpukpu x squared.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.0: Ịtụgharị ọnọdụ eserese ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ banyere ọnụ nke derivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.1: Ịchọta ihe mere ọnọdụ otu naanị adịghị zuru ezu
n-m-h2-diff-06.thinking.2: Iwu ọmụmaatụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.0: Local maximum/minimum na mgbanwe ihe ịrịba ama nke derivative
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.1: Discriminant nke nha quadratic na ihe ịrịba ama nke ọnụ ya
n-m-h2-diff-06.prereq.2: Cubic functions nwere coefficients ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ihe ọnọdụ a na-aghọ mgbe e kwuru ya dịka ọnọdụ banyere derivative f'(x)=3x²+2ax+b?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.0: Dee uru derivative na-ewere n'x ebe uru oke na-eme, na otu ihe ịrịba ama ya si eme tupu na mgbe ya.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.hint.1: Gụọ x ole dị otú ahụ dị mkpa ka e nwee local maximum na local minimum.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.a: Nha f'(x)=0 nwere ọnụ real positive dị iche abụọ
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.b: Nha f'(x)=0 nwere opekata mpe otu ọnụ real positive
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere naanị otu ọnụ real positive, e nwere naanị otu uru oke, ma ọ bụ ọnụ nke ọzọ nwere ike ọ bụghị positive.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.c: f'(x) bụ positive mgbe niile maka x positive
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.c: Mgbe ahụ f na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye n'oge positive ma enweghị uru oke.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.o.d: Nha f'(x)=0 nwere ọnụ okpukpu abụọ positive
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.r.d: Na ọnụ okpukpu abụọ, ihe ịrịba ama derivative anaghị agbanwe, ya mere uru oke anaghị apụta.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s1.explain: X na-enye uru oke bụ ọnụ nke f'(x)=0 ebe ihe ịrịba ama f' na-agbanwe tupu na mgbe ya. Iji nwee local maximum na local minimum abụọ, a chọrọ ọnụ real dị iche abụọ, ọnụ abụọ ahụ ga-abụkwa positive.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.prompt: Tinye ụzọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị iche 3 (a, b) ka maka f(x)=x³+ax²+bx, f'(x)=0 nwere ọnụ real positive dị iche abụọ. (Uru zuru ezu nke a na b bụ 20 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.)
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.0: Dee nchikota na ngwaahịa nke ọnụ abụọ nke nha quadratic 3x²+2ax+b=0 n'okwu a na b.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.1: Chee ma ihe ịrịba ama nke nchikota na ngwaahịa naanị zuru ezu ikwu na ọnụ ndị ahụ bụ real.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.hint.2: Buru ụzọ họrọ a negative, mgbe ahụ gbanwee b ma lelee ozugbo ma e nwere ọnụ.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c1: a na b ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nwere uru zuru ezu nke 20 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Ọnụ abụọ nke 3x²+2ax+b=0 bụ ọnụọgụ real dị iche.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c2: 3x²+2ax+b=0 enweghị ọnụ real dị iche abụọ.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Nchikota na ngwaahịa nke ọnụ abụọ ahụ abụọ bụ positive.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Nchikota (−2a/3) na ngwaahịa (b/3) nke ọnụ abụọ ahụ abụghị positive abụọ.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.explain: Ka ọnụ abụọ nke 3x²+2ax+b=0 bụrụ ọnụọgụ positive dị iche, discriminant ga-abụ positive (a²−3b>0), nchikota nke ọnụ −2a/3 ga-abụ positive (a<0), ngwaahịa nke ọnụ b/3 ga-abụkwa positive (b>0). Dịka ọmụmaatụ, (a, b)=(−3, 1), (−4, 2), (−6, 3).
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.prompt: (a, b)=(−1, 1) nwere a<0 na b>0 ma ọ naghị emezu ọnọdụ ahụ. Kọwaa ihe mere, site n'iji f'(x) na udi nke f.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Degharịa f'(x)=3x²−2x+1 n'udi completed-square, ma ọ bụ gbakọọ discriminant.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Lelee ma ihe ịrịba ama nke f'(x) na-agbanwe mgbe x na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ tụlere ma f'(x)=0 nwere ọnụ?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ jikọtara nke a na eziokwu na uru oke adịghị ma ọ bụrụ na ihe ịrịba ama f' anaghị agbanwe?
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.model.0: f'(x)=3x²−2x+1, discriminant bụkwa 4−12<0, ya mere f'(x)=0 enweghị ọnụ real. f'(x) bụ positive mgbe niile, ya mere f na-abawanye naanị ma enweghị uru oke.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na a<0 na b>0, discriminant (−2)²−4·3·1 bụ negative, ya mere f'=0 enweghị ọnụ real; ya mere ihe ịrịba ama f' anaghị agbanwe ma uru oke anaghị apụta.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ niile n'ime (a, b) ndị a nke f(x)=x³+ax²+bx nwere uru oke ya abụọ na x>0.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tinye (a, b) ọ bụla na 3x²+2ax+b=0 ma buru ụzọ lelee ihe ịrịba ama discriminant.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.hint.1: Naanị maka ndị nwere ọnụ real, tụlee ihe ịrịba ama nke nchikota na ngwaahịa nke ọnụ abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.r.a: a<0 na b>0, ma discriminant a²−3b=0, ya mere f'(x)=0 nwere ọnụ okpukpu abụọ. Uru oke anaghị apụta na ọnụ okpukpu abụọ.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na a>0, nchikota nke ọnụ abụọ ahụ bụ negative, ya mere ọnụ positive abụọ enweghị ike ịdị.
n-m-h2-diff-06.s.s3.explain: (−5, 2): discriminant 25−6>0, a<0, na b>0, ya mere ọ na-arụ ọrụ. (−2, 1): 4−3>0, ya mere site na 3x²−4x+1=(3x−1)(x−1)=0, x=1/3 na 1, abụọ bụ positive. (−3, 3) nwere ọnụ okpukpu abụọ, maka (3, 1) ọnụ abụọ bụ negative.

n-m-h2-diff-07.title: Olu igbe e mere site n'ịkpụ akụkụ
n-m-h2-diff-07.topic: Optimization: oke e kwere ka ọ dị na derivative
n-m-h2-diff-07.goal: N'ngwọta na-achọta ebe derivative bụ 0, chọta ahịrị hapụrụ oke e kwere ka ọ dị nke nsogbu ahụ tọrọ, ma chọta uru kacha ukwuu ọzọ n'ime oke ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-07.material: Site n'akụkụ anọ nke akwụkwọ square nwere akụkụ 12 cm, bipụ square nta nwere akụkụ x cm, ma kpoo ya ka ọ bụrụ igbe na-enweghị mkpuchi. Akwụkwọ ahụ gbara ọkpụrụkpụ, ya mere a pụrụ ịbipụ square nta naanị mgbe akụkụ ya bụ 1.5 cm ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị. Nke a bụ ngwọta Eunseo maka ịchọta mgbe olu igbe ahụ kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h2-diff-07.thinking.0: Ịtụnyere ọnọdụ nke nsogbu ahụ na oke e jiri n'ngwọta
n-m-h2-diff-07.thinking.2: Ịkọwa mgbe uru kacha ukwuu na-eme n'nsọtụ
n-m-h2-diff-07.prereq.0: Derivative nke cubic function na ịbawanye/ibelata
n-m-h2-diff-07.prereq.1: Uru kacha ukwuu na kacha nta n'oge mechiri (ma ọ bụ oge ọkara mechiri)
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Eunseo.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kaa akara ọnọdụ niile dị n'ederede nsogbu ahụ ma lelee ma ahịrị ọ bụla nke ngwọta ahụ jiri ha.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta ahịrị ebe oke nke x buru ụzọ pụta ma tụnyere ya na ọnọdụ nke nsogbu ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.0: Ntọala bụ square nwere akụkụ 12−2x, ịdị elu bụkwa x, ya mere olu bụ V(x)=x(12−2x)².
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.2: Site na V'(x)=0, x=2 ma ọ bụ x=6.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.3: Ka ntọala dị, 12−2x>0, ya mere 0<x<6, n'oke a naanị onye a na-atụ anya bụ x=2.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.4: Ebe ihe ịrịba ama V'(x) na-agbanwe site na positive ruo negative gburugburu x=2, V(2) bụ uru kacha ukwuu.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.line.5: Ya mere olu kacha ukwuu bụ V(2)=128 cm³.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 4 bụ nke mbụ na-agbaji. Nsogbu ahụ kwuru na a pụrụ ịbipụ square naanị mgbe x bụ 1.5 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị, ma ngwọta ahụ weere oke 0<x<6 site naanị n'ọnọdụ maka ntọala ịdị. Ahịrị 5 na 6 na-eso oke sitere n'ahịrị 4, ya mere nsonaazụ ahụ na-agbanwe. Nkwupụta na mgbakọ nke ahịrị 1 ruo 3 dị mma.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.prompt: N'oke ziri ezi nke x, kedu uru x na-eme ka V(x) kacha ukwuu?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dee oke ziri ezi nke x ma tụlee ihe ịrịba ama nke V'(x) n'oke ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na V na-abawanye, chee ebe uru kacha ukwuu n'ime oke ahụ ga-apụta.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.a: Ọ bụ ebe derivative bụ 0, ma ọ dị n'èzí oke nsogbu ahụ, yabụ enweghị ike ime ya n'ezie.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.b: Ọ bụ ebe dị n'ime oke, ma ọ bụghị ebe oke kacha elu na-apụta.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.r.d: O họrọ uru dị n'etiti oke ahụ. Ị ga-enyocha ịrị elu/ịda ala iji mata ebe oke kacha elu na-apụta.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s2.explain: Maka 0<x≤1.5, V'(x)=12(x−2)(x−6)>0, yabụ V na-aga n'ihu na-arị elu. Yabụ oke kacha elu dị na njedebe aka nri nke oke ahụ, x=1.5.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.prompt: Chọta oke olu kacha elu site n'azịza ziri ezi, ma n'otu ahịrịokwu ma ọ bụ abụọ dee ihe mere oke kacha elu ji apụta n'ebe ọzọ karịa ebe V'(x)=0.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tinye x=1.5 n'usoro ahụ ma gbakọọ olu.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee ma x nke V'(x)=0 dị n'oke e kwere.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị dere oke e kwere ka ọ bụrụ 0<x≤1.5?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị lelere ma V na-arị elu ma ọ bụ na-ada ala n'ime oke ahụ?
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.0: Maka 0<x≤1.5, V'(x)>0, yabụ V na-aga n'ihu na-arị elu, ma oke kacha elu dị na njedebe aka nri x=1.5. V(1.5)=1.5×81=121.5 cm³. x=2 dị n'èzí oke.
n-m-h2-diff-07.s.s3.model.1: Mgbe x=3/2, olu (3/2)×9²=243/2=121.5 cm³ bụ kacha elu. N'oke a V na-aga n'ihu na-arị elu, yabụ ebe V'(x)=0 anọghị n'oke ahụ.

n-m-h2-diff-08.title: N'oge ngwa ngwa bụ 0, ebe ahụ ọ na-agbanwe ntụzịaka?
n-m-h2-diff-08.topic: Ọsọ na ntụzịaka mmegharị: mgbanwe ọnọdụ na anya e njem
n-m-h2-diff-08.goal: Kewaa oge ntụzịaka mmegharị nke ebe na-aga n'ahịrị ọnụọgụ na-agbanwe na oge ngwa ngwa bụ 0, ma kpebie site n'mgbanwe akara nke ọsọ.
n-m-h2-diff-08.material: Ọnọdụ nke ebe P na-aga n'ahịrị ọnụọgụ n'oge t (0≤t≤4) bụ x(t)=t³−6t²+9t. Ọsọ bụ x'(t) ma ngwa ngwa bụ x''(t). Jimin na-ekwu, "Na t=2 ngwa ngwa bụ 0. N'oge ngwa ngwa bụ 0, P na-agbanwe ntụzịaka." (t³ pụtara t cubed.)
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.0: Ịhọrọ ihe ngosi (akara nke ọsọ) nke nwere ike inwale nkwupụta ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-08.thinking.1: Ịkewa oge ngwa ngwa bụ 0 na oge ntụzịaka na-agbanwe
