n-m-h2-diff-08.prereq.0: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọnọdụ, ọsọ, na ngwa ngwa (derivative nke ọnọdụ, derivative nke ọsọ)
n-m-h2-diff-08.prereq.1: Ịkewa okwu cubic ka ọ bụrụ ihe ndị na-amụba
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.prompt: Iji nwalee ma nkwupụta Jimin ziri ezi, gịnị ka ị kwesịrị inyocha mbụ?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.0: Chee otú akara ọsọ si dị iche mgbe ebe na-aga n'aka nri na mgbe ọ na-aga n'aka ekpe.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.hint.1: Mee derivative nke x(t) ka ị nweta ọsọ, ma tinye uru tupu na mgbe t=2.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.a: Lelee ma ọnụego mgbanwe nkezi n'oge [0, 4] dị mma
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.a: Ọnụego mgbanwe nkezi na-atụnyere naanị ọnọdụ abụọ ndị na-eru njedebe, yabụ ọ naghị agwa anyị ihe gbasara mmegharị dị n'etiti.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.b: Chọta ihe ọnọdụ x(2) bụ na t=2
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.b: Ịmara uru ọnọdụ anaghị agwa anyị ma ntụzịaka mmegharị na-agbanwe tupu na mgbe ya.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.c: Lee ma akara nke ọsọ v(t)=x'(t) tupu na mgbe t=2 dị iche
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.o.d: Gbakọọ ọzọ ma ngwa ngwa x''(2)=0 ziri ezi n'ezie
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.r.d: A nyela na ngwa ngwa bụ 0. Ihe a ga-anwale bụ ma nke ahụ pụtara mgbanwe ntụzịaka.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s1.explain: Ntụzịaka ebe na-aga bụ akara ọsọ na-ekpebi. Ka ntụzịaka gbanwee, akara ọsọ ga-adị iche tupu na mgbe, ma eziokwu na ngwa ngwa bụ 0 naanị anaghị agwa anyị nke ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ oge niile n'0≤t≤4 nke ntụzịaka mmegharị nke ebe P na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta ọsọ v(t)=x'(t) n'onwe gị ma gbakọọ akara ya na t=0, 2, na 4.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma akara na-agbanwe tupu na mgbe oge ọsọ bụ 0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.b: Na t=2 ngwa ngwa bụ 0, ma ọsọ bụ −3, yabụ ebe ahụ na-aga n'ihu n'aka ekpe. Ntụzịaka anaghị agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.r.d: Ọ bụ oge njedebe nke oge ahụ, ma ọsọ n'oge ahụ bụ 9, nke dị mma. Ọ bụghị oge ntụzịaka na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s2.explain: x'(t)=3t²−12t+9=3(t−1)(t−3), yabụ ọsọ bụ 0 na t=1 na 3, ma akara na-agbanwe tupu na mgbe oge ndị ahụ (dị mma gaa na adịghị mma gaa na dị mma). t=2 bụ naanị oge ngwa ngwa x''(t)=6t−12 hà nhata 0.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.prompt: Zaa Jimin. Jiri uru ọsọ kọwaa ihe mere P anaghị agbanwe ntụzịaka ọ bụ ezie na ngwa ngwa bụ 0 na t=2, ma kwuo oge ntụzịaka na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.0: Gbakọọ uru ọsọ v(2) na t=2 n'onwe gị.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.hint.1: Chọta oge ọsọ bụ 0 ma tụnyere otú akara ọsọ si dị iche tupu na mgbe ha.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị gbakọrọ ọsọ na t=2 n'onwe gị ma lelee akara ya?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kewara oge akara ọsọ na-agbanwe na oge ngwa ngwa bụ 0?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị jiri uru kọwaa ihe mere nkwupụta ahụ ji ezighi ezi?
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụ eziokwu na ngwa ngwa bụ 0 na t=2, ma ọsọ v(2)=3·4−12·2+9=−3 adịghị mma, yabụ P na-aga n'ihu n'aka ekpe. Ntụzịaka na-agbanwe mgbe akara ọsọ na-agbanwe, ma ebe v(t)=3(t−1)(t−3), ọ na-agbanwe na t=1 na t=3.
n-m-h2-diff-08.s.s3.model.1: Mgbe ngwa ngwa bụ 0, ọ bụ naanị oge ọsọ anaghị ebelata ma ọ bụ abawanye. Na t=2 ọsọ bụ −3, yabụ ntụzịaka anaghị agbanwe, ma ntụzịaka na-agbanwe na t=1 na t=3, ebe ọsọ na-abụ 0 ma akara ya na-agbanwe.

n-m-h2-diff-09.title: Oke a nke ọrụ na-arị elu mgbe niile
n-m-h2-diff-09.topic: Derivative na ịrị elu: oke ebe a gụnyere ịhà nhata
n-m-h2-diff-09.goal: Mgbe ị na-atụgharị ọnọdụ maka ọrụ ka ọ na-arị elu n'ọnụọgụ niile n'ezie ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ gbasara akara derivative, nwalee uru oke (ebe derivative bụ 0 n'otu ebe) n'iche, ma dee nsonaazụ dị ka ihe ndetu maka nwa akwụkwọ dị n'okpuru.
n-m-h2-diff-09.material: Nke a bụ azịza Soeun, nwa akwụkwọ dị n'okpuru, onye chọtara oke nke ihe kwụsiri ike a nke ọrụ f(x)=x³+ax²+3x na-arị elu n'ọnụọgụ niile n'ezie. Soeun jiri mpako gosi azịza a. (x³ pụtara x cubed ma ax² pụtara a ugboro x squared.)
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.0: Ichọta ahịrị ebe e jiri ọnọdụ ahụ ike nke ukwuu n'azịza ahụ
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.1: Ịnwale uru oke a=±3 site n'itinye ha
n-m-h2-diff-09.thinking.2: Idegharị ka nwa akwụkwọ dị n'okpuru nwee ike ịghọta
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.0: Akara derivative na ịrị elu/ịda ala nke ọrụ
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.1: Ọnọdụ (discriminant) ka inequality quadratic dị maka ọnụọgụ ezigbo niile
n-m-h2-diff-09.prereq.2: Ụdị cube zuru oke nke okwu cubic
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'azịza Soeun.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee otu otu n'ihe ntọala ahịrị ọ bụla sitere n'ahịrị tupu ya.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ma "na-arị elu" na "derivative dị mma" pụtara otu ihe.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.0: f'(x)=3x²+2ax+3. (A na-agụ f' dị ka "f prime.")
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.1: Ka f na-arị elu n'ọnụọgụ niile, f'(x)>0 ga-adịrị maka x niile.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.line.2: Ọ bụrụ na D bụ discriminant nke f'(x)=0, a chọrọ D/4=a²−9<0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ nke mbụ gbagoro. Ka ọrụ na-arị elu, f'(x)≥0 zuru ezu; ọ dịghị mkpa ịbụ f'(x)>0. Ọ bụrụ na f'(x) bụ 0 naanị n'otu ebe ma dị mma n'ebe ndị ọzọ, ọrụ ahụ ka na-arị elu site n'ebe ahụ. Ahịrị 3 na 4 sochiri ahịrị 2, yabụ oke ahụ tụfuru n'oke e nwetara.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.prompt: Ị chọrọ ịlele ma f na-arị elu n'ọnụọgụ niile mgbe a=3, nke dị n'oke. Kedu usoro kacha dabara adaba?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye a=3 n'f(x) ma kewaa ya n'ihe ndị na-amụba, ma ọ bụ dee ya n'ụdị square zuru oke ma ọ bụ cube zuru oke.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.hint.1: Dee ihe akara nke f' bụ tupu na mgbe ebe f'(x) bụ 0.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.a: Kpee na ọ naghị arị elu, n'ihi na na a=3 e nwere x nwere f'(x)=0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.a: Ọbụlagodi na derivative bụ 0 n'otu ebe, ọrụ ahụ na-arị elu ma akara ya anaghị agbanwe tupu na mgbe. Ị ga-elele tupu ị kpee ikpe.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.b: Chee na a chọghị nyocha iche, n'ihi na ọ bụ uru dị n'èzí −3<a<3
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.b: Ma ọ bụ uru oke bụ kpọmkwem ajụjụ ahụ, yabụ a chọrọ nyocha.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.c: Gbakọọ akara f' naanị na x=0
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.r.c: Akara n'otu ebe enweghị ike ikpebi ma f na-arị elu n'ọnụọgụ niile.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.o.d: Tinye a=3, mee f(x) dị mfe, ma lelee udi eserese
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na a=3, mgbe ahụ f(x)=x³+3x²+3x=(x+1)³−1. Eserese nke ụdị (x+1)³ nwere mkpọda 0 na x=−1 ma na-aga n'ihu na-arị elu. f'(x)=3(x+1)²≥0, ma naanị ebe ọ bụ 0 bụ x=−1.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.prompt: Dee ihe ndetu iziga Soeun. Kwuo otu ihe ọma gbasara ọrụ Soeun, ma kọwaa akụkụ ọ ga-edozi na otu, site n'iji ihe atụ a=3, ka e nye oke ziri ezi nke a.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta otu ihe Soeun mere nke ọma.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị dee n'ihe ndetu ahụ udi f'(x) na-enwe mgbe a=3, ọ ga-adịrị Soeun mfe ịghọta.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị kọwara n'ụzọ doro anya ihe e mere nke ọma?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị gosiri ahịrị na-ezighi ezi na ihe kpatara, site n'iji ihe atụ a=3?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị dere oke ziri ezi n'ụzọ ziri ezi?
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.0: Soeun, ọ dị mma na ị dere discriminant! Ma f'(x)≥0 zuru ezu, ọ bụghị f'(x)>0. Mgbe a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, yabụ f'(x)=0 naanị n'otu ebe, x=−1, ma ọrụ ahụ na-aga n'ihu na-arị elu. Yabụ −3≤a≤3.
n-m-h2-diff-09.s.s3.model.1: I dere azịza dị ka −3<a<3, nke ọ bụ? Lelee ma njedebe a=±3 na-arụkwa ọrụ. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye a=3, f(x)=(x+1)³−1, nke bụ ọrụ na-arị elu. Ọbụlagodi na f' bụ 0 n'otu ebe, ọrụ ahụ na-arị elu ma ọ bụrụ na akara anaghị agbanwe n'akụkụ abụọ ya, yabụ ị kwesịrị itinye akara ịhà nhata ma dee −3≤a≤3.

n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.2: Cubic functions nwere coefficients ọnụọgụ zuru ezu
n-m-h2-diff-10.title: Anyị pụrụ ichọta uru kacha elu nke mpaghara ma ọ bụrụ na anyị maara naanị derivative?
n-m-h2-diff-10.topic: Ihe anyị pụrụ na enweghị ike ịmụta site n'ozi derivative: ọrụ nke okwu kwụsiri ike
n-m-h2-diff-10.goal: Lelee na ịmara naanị derivative na-agwa gị udi ọrụ ahụ (ebe ọ na-arị elu ma ọ bụ na-ada ala na ebe uru kacha elu na kacha nta na-apụta) ma ọ bụghị ọnọdụ ya kwụ ọtọ (nha nke uru kacha elu na kacha nta), ma chọpụta ozi ọzọ achọrọ.
n-m-h2-diff-10.material: A maara derivative nke ọrụ cubic f(x) ka ọ bụrụ f'(x)=3x²−12. Anyị chọrọ ichọta uru kacha elu nke mpaghara nke f, ma anyị amaghị f(x) n'onwe ya. (3x² pụtara 3 ugboro x squared.)
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.0: Ịkewa ihe derivative na-agwa anyị na ihe ọ naghị agwa anyị
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.1: Ịkpe ka ozi ọzọ si baa uru
n-m-h2-diff-10.thinking.2: Iji ozi ahụ chọta uru kacha elu nke mpaghara
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.0: Akara derivative na uru kacha elu na kacha nta nke mpaghara
n-m-h2-diff-10.prereq.1: Integral na-enweghị oke nke ọrụ polynomial
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ozi niile nke, ọ bụrụ na ị maara otu n'ime ha tinyere, ị nwere ike ikpebi uru kacha elu nke mpaghara nke f.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.0: Site n'f'(x), dee ụdị f(x) na-enwe. E nwere akụkụ nke a kpebighị?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee, otu nhọrọ n'otu oge, ma ọ na-ekpebi akụkụ a kpebighị ahụ.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara otu uru ọrụ, a kpebiri okwu kwụsiri ike, yabụ a kpebiri f niile.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị maara otu uru ọrụ, a kpebiri okwu kwụsiri ike, yabụ a kpebiri f niile.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.b: Enwere ike ichọta uru a site n'itinye x=1 n'f'(x)=3x²−12, yabụ ọ bụghị ozi ọhụrụ.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.o.c: Uru kacha nta nke f'(x) bụ −12
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.r.c: Enwere ike ịchọta ozi a site n'f'(x)=3x²−12 naanị, yabụ ọ bụghị ozi ọhụrụ.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na f'(x)=3x²−12, mgbe ahụ f(x)=x³−12x+C (C bụ ihe kwụsiri ike). A kpebiri x-nhazi nke uru kacha elu na kacha nta (x=−2, 2), ma uru kacha elu f(−2)=16+C bụ nke a kpebiri naanị mgbe a kpebiri C. Iji kpebie C, ị chọrọ uru nke f (uru ọrụ). Ozi gbasara derivative bụ otu ihe anyị nwere ugbu a.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.prompt: E nyere gị ozi ọzọ na uru kacha nta nke mpaghara nke f bụ −10. Chọta uru kacha elu nke mpaghara nke f ma dee otú ị si chọta ya.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.0: Jiri akara derivative kpebie uru x ebe uru kacha nta na-apụta.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.hint.1: Dochie x ahụ n'usoro f(x) ma guzobe nha n'okwu kwụsiri ike C.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị buru ụzọ chọta uru x ebe uru kacha elu na kacha nta na-apụta?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị jiri uru kacha nta kpebie okwu kwụsiri ike?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.0: Anyị nwere ike ide f(x)=x³−12x+C (C bụ ihe kwụsiri ike). Uru kacha nta dị na x=2, ma f(2)=C−16=−10, yabụ C=6. Uru kacha elu dị na x=−2, ma f(−2)=16+C=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s2.model.1: Ijikọta f' anaghị ekpebi okwu kwụsiri ike, ma iji eziokwu na uru kacha nta bụ −10 na-ekpebi okwu kwụsiri ike ka ọ bụrụ 6. Uru kacha elu na-apụta na x=−2, ma f(−2)=−8+24+6=22.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.prompt: Ọrụ cubic abụọ f na g nwere otu derivative, ma f(0)−g(0)=6. Gịnị bụ uru kacha elu nke mpaghara nke f wepụrụ uru kacha elu nke mpaghara nke g?
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ na f'=g', dee ihe na-eme mgbe ị na-eme derivative nke f(x)−g(x).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.hint.1: Chee ma ọdịiche ahụ na-agbanwe na x ma ọ bụ na ọ bụ ihe kwụsiri ike.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.a: I chere na derivative hà nhata pụtara uru kacha elu hà nhata. Ọ bụrụ na okwu kwụsiri ike dị iche, nha nke uru kacha elu na kacha nta dịkwa iche.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.c: I gbakwunyere ọdịiche nke okwu kwụsiri ike ugboro abụọ. Na uru kacha elu, ọdịiche ka bụ 6.
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.r.d: Enwere ike ikpebi ya, n'ihi na e nyere uru f(0)−g(0).
n-m-h2-diff-10.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na f'=g', mgbe ahụ f(x)−g(x) bụ ihe kwụsiri ike, ma ebe f(0)−g(0)=6, f(x)−g(x)=6 maka x niile. Uru kacha elu na-apụta n'otu x maka abụọ, yabụ ọdịiche nke uru kacha elu bụkwa 6.

n-m-h2-diff-11.title: Ime inequality nke na-adị maka x>0
n-m-h2-diff-11.topic: Igosi inequality: ichedo oge na ọnọdụ maka ịhà nhata
n-m-h2-diff-11.goal: Chọta uru kacha nta site n'iji derivative iji wuo n'onwe gị inequality nke na-emezu ọnọdụ, ma kọwaa ihe mere ichedo domain ji agbanwe nsonaazụ.
n-m-h2-diff-11.material: a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma ma k bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu. Anyị chọrọ ịhọrọ a na k ka inequality x³+k≥3a²x na-adị mgbe niile maka x dị mma, ma ịhà nhata na-adị maka ụfọdụ x dị mma. (3a²x pụtara 3 ugboro a squared ugboro x.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.0: Ịtụgharị inequality ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ gbasara uru kacha nta nke otu ọrụ
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.1: Ime ikpe ebe ịhà nhata na-adị
n-m-h2-diff-11.thinking.2: Ịkọwa ihe na-agbanwe mgbe oge gbanwere
n-m-h2-diff-11.prereq.0: Uru kacha elu na kacha nta site n'iji derivative
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.prompt: Ọ bụrụ na anyị ahapụ h(x)=x³−3a²x+k, kedu àgwà nke h(x) na x>0 ka ọnọdụ a na-aghọ?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.0: Kwupụta ọzọ "inequality na-adị mgbe niile" dị ka nkwupụta gbasara uru kacha nta nke h(x).
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.hint.1: Gịnị ka "e nwere x ebe ịhà nhata na-adị" na-ekwu gbasara uru kacha nta ahụ?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na uru kacha elu bụ 0, mgbe ahụ h(x)≤0, yabụ inequality na-aga n'ụzọ ọzọ.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.o.b: Uru kacha nta dị nta karịa 0
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.b: Mgbe ahụ e nwere x nwere h(x)<0, yabụ inequality adaa.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.o.c: Uru kacha nta nke h'(x) bụ 0
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ na-elele àgwà nke h', ọ bụghị nke h. Inequality gbasara uru nke h.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s1.explain: Ka h(x)≥0 na-adị mgbe niile na x>0, uru kacha nta ga-abụ opekata mpe 0, ma ka e nwee x ebe ịhà nhata na-adị, uru kacha nta ga-abụ kpọmkwem 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.prompt: Tinye ụzọ (a, k) atọ nke na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ, na uru a atọ dị iche. (a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 10.)
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta x dị mma ebe h'(x)=0, ma lelee akara h' n'akụkụ abụọ ya.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.hint.1: Dee uru h na x ahụ n'okwu a na k, ma chọta k nke na-eme ya 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.var.a: Ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma a
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c1: a bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 10, k bụkwa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c1: a ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na 1 ruo 10, k ga-abụkwa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.ok.c2: Ụkpụrụ kacha nta nke h n'x>0 bụ 0 kpọmkwem.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.fail.c2: Ụkpụrụ kacha nta nke h(x) n'x>0 abụghị 0.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.explain: h'(x)=3x²−3a²=3(x−a)(x+a), n'x>0, h na-agbanwe site n'ibelata gaa n'ịbawanye n'x=a, ya mere o nwere ụkpụrụ kacha nta h(a)=k−2a³. Ọ bụrụ na ụkpụrụ a bụ 0, inequality na-adị mma mgbe niile ma hà nhata na-adị n'x=a. Ya mere k=2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.prompt: Kọwaa n'otu ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla ihe na-eme mgbe k pere mpe karịa 2a³ na mgbe k buru ibu karịa 2a³.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tụnyere ka ụkpụrụ h n'x=a si agbanwe na k, were k=2a³ dị ka ntụnyere.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.hint.1: Inequality ịdị mma mgbe niile na hà nhata ịdị bụ ihe dị iche.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kọwara ikpe pere mpe na nke buru ibu iche iche?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kewapụrụ "na-adị mma mgbe niile" na "hà nhata na-adị"?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na k pere mpe karịa 2a³, h adịghị mma n'x=a, ya mere inequality na-ada. Ọ bụrụ na k buru ibu karịa 2a³, ụkpụrụ kacha nta buru ibu karịa 0, ya mere inequality na-adị mma, mana enweghị x ebe hà nhata dị.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s2.because.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na k<2a³, ụkpụrụ kacha nta pere mpe karịa 0, ya mere e nwere x ebe inequality adịghị adị. Ọ bụrụ na k>2a³, ọ na-adị mma mgbe niile, mana ụkpụrụ kacha nta buru ibu karịa 0, ya mere enweghị x dị mma ebe hà nhata dị.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.prompt: E nwere pair (a, k) nke otu inequality x³+k≥3a²x na-adị mma ọ bụghị naanị maka x dị mma kamakwa maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie niile?
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.0: Tụọ ihe ngosi nke h(x) mgbe x bụ ọnụọgụ adịghị mma pere mpe nke ukwuu, dị ka −10 ma ọ bụ −100.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.hint.1: Chee echiche ma nsonaazụ e lere naanị maka ọnụọgụ dị mma na-agbatị n'onwe ya gaa n'ọnụọgụ adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.a: Mba. Mgbe x na-aghọ pere mpe nke ukwuu (adịghị mma), akụkụ aka ekpe na-aghọ pere mpe karịa 3a²x
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.b: Ee. Site na k=2a³ ị chọtara n'elu, ọ na-adị mma maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie niile
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.b: Ị lere naanị k=2a³ maka x>0 ma ị lebeghị ma ọ na-adị mma maka x<0. Ọ na-ada mgbe x bụ ọnụọgụ adịghị mma pere mpe nke ukwuu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.c: Ee. Ọ bụrụ na ị họrọ k buru ibu zuru ezu, ọ na-adị mma maka ọnụọgụ n'ezie niile
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.c: Mgbe x na-aghọ pere mpe nke ukwuu (adịghị mma), x³ na-ebelata ngwa ngwa karịa k, ya mere ọ na-ada n'agbanyeghị ka k buru ibu.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.o.d: Mba. Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye x=0, inequality na-ada ozugbo
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na x=0, anyị chọrọ k≥0, ebe k=2a³>0, ọ na-adị mma.
n-m-h2-diff-11.s.s3.explain: h(x)=x³−3a²x+k na-aga n'−∞ ka x na-aghọ adịghị mma karị. Ya mere n'agbanyeghị ka ị si họrọ k, e nwere x nwere h(x)<0. N'ihi na anyị machiri na x dị mma, pair (a, k) na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ dị.

n-m-h2-explog-01.title: Ilele ngwọta nke gbakọrọ square root site n'iji iwu nke exponents
n-m-h2-explog-01.goal: Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-agabiga ụzọ n'ngwọta site n'iji iwu nke exponents, ma nyochaa ọnọdụ ebe a pụrụ iji iwu ahụ chọta ụkpụrụ ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-explog-01.material: Hayun chọtara ụkpụrụ √((−3)²) site n'iji iwu nke exponents. ((−3)² bụ square nke −3, ịbuli n'ike 1/2 pụtakwa otu ihe ahụ dị ka iwere square root. Ka anyị kwenye na a kọwapụtara fractional exponent naanị mgbe base dị mma.)
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.0: Isoro ngwọta ruo ọgwụgwụ na ichọta ahịrị mbụ na-agabiga ụzọ
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.1: Ịtụnyere nsonaazụ na ụkpụrụ e gbakọrọ ozugbo
n-m-h2-explog-01.thinking.2: Inyocha ọnọdụ ebe iwu na-adị mma
n-m-h2-explog-01.prereq.0: Ihe powers na square roots pụtara
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.0: Malite n'ime brackets, gbakọọ ụkpụrụ ozugbo buru ụzọ, ma tụnyere ya na nsonaazụ ikpeazụ Hayun.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.hint.1: Gaa n'ahịrị otu n'otu ma lelee n'ahịrị ole ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ mbụ dị iche.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ nke mbụ na-agabiga ụzọ. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) nwere fractional exponent bụ iwu maka base dị mma, mana base −3 adịghị mma. N'ezie, ((−3)²)^(1/2)=9^(1/2)=3. Ahịrị 3 na 4 bụ ngụkọta nke na-esochi ahịrị 2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.prompt: Dee ụkpụrụ ziri ezi, ma jiri ihe ngosi nke base kọwaa ihe mere ahịrị ebe Hayun jiri iwu nke exponents enweghị ike iji ya.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gbakọọ (−3)² buru ụzọ, wee buli ụkpụrụ ahụ n'ike 1/2.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gụọ ọzọ nkwenye banyere udi ọnụọgụ base ga-abụ mgbe a na-eji iwu ahụ.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ buru ụzọ chọta (−3)²=9 wee nweta ụkpụrụ 3?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na a pụrụ iji iwu nke exponents naanị mgbe base dị mma?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ nwere ike ikwu ihe mere −3 Hayun enweghị ike ịbụ ụkpụrụ nke square root?
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.0: √((−3)²)=√9=3. (a^m)^n=a^(mn) maka fractional exponents nwere ike iji naanị mgbe base dị mma, mana n'ebe a base −3 adịghị mma, ya mere enweghị ike iji ya, iji ya ka ọ dị na-enye ụkpụrụ ezighị ezi −3.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.1: Nke mbụ, (−3)²=9, square root dị mma nke 9 bụ 3, ya mere ụkpụrụ bụ 3. Hayun tinyere iwu ahụ ọbụna ma base adịghị mma, ya mere ihe ngosi pụtara iche.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s2.model.2: Azịza: 3. Akara square root na-enye ụkpụrụ 0 ma ọ bụ karịa, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịbụ −3. Nsogbu bụ na e jiri iwu maka fractional exponents n'ọnụọgụ nwere base adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ (a, m, n) niile nke akụkụ abụọ nke (a^m)^n=a^(mn) kọwapụtara ma nwee otu ụkpụrụ.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.0: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, gbakọọ akụkụ aka ekpe na akụkụ aka nri iche iche, ma buru ụzọ lelee na abụọ nwere ụkpụrụ.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na abụọ nwere ụkpụrụ, tụnyere ma ha hà nhata. Tụlee iche ikpe mgbe exponent bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na mgbe ọ bụ fraction.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.a: Akụkụ aka ekpe ((−3)²)^(1/2) bụ 3, akụkụ aka nri (−3)^1 bụ −3. E nwere fractional exponent, ya mere iwu ahụ anaghị adị.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.b: Ị hapụrụ na ya exponents zuru ezu n'akụkụ abụọ, iwu na-adị ọbụna ma base adịghị mma. Akụkụ abụọ bụ 729.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.c: Ị hapụrụ na ọ bụrụ na base dị mma, iwu na-adị ọbụna na fractional exponents. Akụkụ abụọ bụ 25.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.d: Akụkụ aka ekpe (−4)^(1/2) akọwapụtaghị. Ị ga-ebu ụzọ lelee ma akụkụ abụọ kọwapụtara.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.r.e: Ị hapụrụ na negative exponent bụkwa integer exponent, ya mere iwu na-adị. Akụkụ abụọ bụ 1/64.
n-m-h2-explog-01.s.s3.explain: (−3, 2, 3) na-adị ebe 9³=729=(−3)⁶, (5, 1/2, 4) na-adị ebe (√5)⁴=25=5², ma (−2, 3, −2) na-adị ebe (−8)^(−2)=1/64=(−2)^(−6). Maka (−3, 2, 1/2), ụkpụrụ dị iche, 3 na −3, ma maka (−4, 1/2, 2), akụkụ aka ekpe akọwapụtaghị. Ọdịiche bụ isi bụ na integer exponents nwere ike iji mgbe base abụghị 0, fractional exponents nwere ike iji mgbe base dị mma.

n-m-h2-explog-02.title: Ụkpụrụ x nke logarithm nwere mkpụrụedemede n'base na argument ya akọwapụtara
n-m-h2-explog-02.goal: Chọta n'onwe gị ụkpụrụ x nke logarithm nwere x n'base ya na argument ya nwere nghọta, hazie ọnọdụ ndị ahụ otu n'otu ichọta oke nke x.
n-m-h2-explog-02.material: Logarithm log_a N nwere ụkpụrụ naanị mgbe base a na argument N na-emezu ọnọdụ ụfọdụ. Oge a, lelee okwu log_{x−1}(5−x), nke nwere x n'base na n'argument. (Base bụ x−1 ma argument bụ 5−x.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.0: Iwu ọtụtụ ihe atụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.1: Ịhazi ihe mere ụkpụrụ ndị dara anaghị anabata
n-m-h2-explog-02.thinking.2: Ijikọta ọnọdụ ndị ị chọtara n'otu oke
n-m-h2-explog-02.prereq.1: Ọnọdụ n'base na argument nke logarithm
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.prompt: Chọta ma tinye ụkpụrụ x atọ dị iche nke log_{x−1}(5−x) nwere ụkpụrụ. (Decimals dị mma.)
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tinye ụkpụrụ maka x ma dee ihe base x−1 na argument 5−x nke ọ bụla na-aghọ.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee na base na argument abụọ bụ ụkpụrụ nkọwa logarithm kwere. Ọ bụrụ na ị nweta ụkpụrụ a naghị anabata, dee nke kpatara ya.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c1: Base x−1 bụ 0 ma ọ bụ erughị.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c2: Base x−1 bụ 1. Base enweghị ike ịbụ 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.fail.c3: Argument 5−x bụ 0 ma ọ bụ erughị.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s1.explain: Dịka ọmụmaatụ, x=3 na-enye log_2 2, x=4 na-enye log_3 1, ma x=1.5 na-enye log_{0.5} 3.5; n'nke ọ bụla, base dị mma ma abụghị 1, argument dịkwa mma. A naghị anabata x=2 n'ihi na base bụ 1, x=0 n'ihi na base adịghị mma, ma x=5 n'ihi na argument bụ 0.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ ihe kpatara ziri ezi maka ihe mere log_{x−1}(5−x) enweghị ụkpụrụ mgbe x=2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tinye x=2 n'base x−1 na argument 5−x ma dee ụkpụrụ nke ọ bụla.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.hint.1: Depụta iche ụkpụrụ ndị enweghị ike ịbụ base na ndị enweghị ike ịbụ argument, ma tụnyere ha na ụkpụrụ ndị a.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.b: Mgbe x=2, x−1 abụghị adịghị mma. Tinye ụkpụrụ ahụ lee.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.c: Mgbe x=2, 5−x bụ 3. Tinye ụkpụrụ ahụ lee.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.r.d: Mgbe x=2, 5−x abụghị adịghị mma. Tinye ụkpụrụ ahụ lee.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s2.explain: Mgbe x=2, base bụ 1 ma argument bụ 3. 1 buliri n'ike ọ bụla bụ 1, ya mere ọ nweghị mgbe ọ ga-abụ 3, nke pụtara na log_1 3 enweghị ụkpụrụ. Ọ bụ ya mere base ekwesịghị ịbụ 1.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.prompt: Dee oke nke x nke log_{x−1}(5−x) nwere nghọta.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.0: Dee ọnọdụ abụọ nke base na otu ọnọdụ nke argument iche iche dị ka inequalities.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sere ọnọdụ atọ ahụ n'ahịrị ọnụọgụ, chọta ebe ha na-ekpuchi, wee lelee ikpeazụ na ọ nweghị ụkpụrụ na-efu n'ebe a na-ekpuchi.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere ọnọdụ abụọ nke base?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ chetara isi ntụ e wepụrụ n'ụzọ ị kọwara oke?
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.0: Site n'ọnọdụ base x−1>0 na x−1≠1, x>1 na x≠2. Site n'ọnọdụ argument 5−x>0, x<5. Ya mere 1<x<5 na x≠2.
n-m-h2-explog-02.s.s3.model.1: x ga-abụrịrị ihe karịrị 1 ma erughị 5, mana a ga-ahapụ 2. Nke a bụ n'ihi na itinye 2 na-eme ka base bụrụ 1.

n-m-h2-explog-03.title: Nkwupụta na 'log x²=2 log x' na-adị mma mgbe niile
n-m-h2-explog-03.goal: Nyochaa oke nke e nwere ihe onwunwe nke logarithms na-adị, chọta ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ, ma dozie okwu ahụ ma ọ bụ tinye ọnọdụ.
n-m-h2-explog-03.material: Mina kwuru nke a: "log x²=2 log x bụ ihe onwunwe nke logarithms, ya mere ọ na-adị maka x ọ bụla." (log bụ common logarithm.)
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.0: Ichọta ụkpụrụ bụ ihe atụ megidere
n-m-h2-explog-03.thinking.1: Ịtụnyere oke ebe akụkụ abụọ kọwapụtara
n-m-h2-explog-03.prereq.0: Ihe onwunwe nke logarithms log a^n=n log a
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ x n'ime ndị a nke na-egosi na nkwupụta Mina ezighị ezi.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.0: Maka x ọ bụla, gbakọọ akụkụ aka ekpe log x² na akụkụ aka nri 2 log x iche iche, ma buru ụzọ lelee na abụọ nwere ụkpụrụ.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ụkpụrụ abụọ dị, tụnyere ma ha hà nhata. Lelekwa ma otu akụkụ enweghị ụkpụrụ.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.a: log 100²=4 na 2 log 100=4, nke hà nhata, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe atụ megidere.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.b: Ị chọtara ikpe ebe akụkụ aka ekpe nwere ụkpụrụ mana akụkụ aka nri akọwapụtaghị n'ihi na argument ya adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụna mgbe x pere mpe karịa 1, log 0.01=−2 na 2 log 0.1=−2 hà nhata. Logarithm adịghị mma dị iche n'ịbụ nke akọwapụtaghị.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.r.d: Akụkụ abụọ hà nhata 0, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe atụ megidere.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na x=−10, akụkụ aka ekpe log (−10)²=log 100=2 nwere ụkpụrụ, mana akụkụ aka nri 2 log (−10) akọwapụtaghị n'ihi na argument ya adịghị mma. Ya mere anyị enweghị ike ikwu na okwu abụọ ahụ hà nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.prompt: Dozie okwu Mina, ma ọ bụ dee ya nwere ọnọdụ n'x nke ọ na-adị, ma dee ihe mere ị ji dozie ya otú ahụ.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tụnyere ihe ngosi nke arguments n'akụkụ aka ekpe na aka nri mgbe x dị mma na mgbe x adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ụkpụrụ argument aka ekpe x² na-ewere ọbụna mgbe x adịghị mma, ma chọta ọnụọgụ dị mma nke e nwere ike iji n'aka nri kama x.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ lelere ma akụkụ aka nri kọwapụtara mgbe x adịghị mma?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ jiri otu ụkpụrụ lelee na okwu gị a dozịrị na-adịkwa mma mgbe x adịghị mma?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ chere echiche banyere ọnọdụ x≠0?
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.0: Ọ ga-adozịrị ka ọ bụrụ log x²=2 log|x| (x≠0). Mgbe x adịghị mma, log x akọwapụtaghị, mana x² dị mma, ya mere log x² kọwapụtara.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.1: log x²=2 log x na-adị naanị mgbe x>0. Mgbe x adịghị mma, argument n'akụkụ aka nri adịghị mma, ya mere enweghị ụkpụrụ.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s2.model.2: Mgbe x abụghị 0, log x² = 2 log|x|. Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri absolute value, argument na-adị mma mgbe niile.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ oke nke x nke log (x−1)²=2 log (x−1) na-adị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.0: Chọta x nke akụkụ aka ekpe kọwapụtara na x nke akụkụ aka nri kọwapụtara.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.hint.1: N'etiti x nke abụọ kọwapụtara, chọta oke ebe okwu ndị ahụ n'ezie na-enye otu ụkpụrụ.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.a: Ọ na-ekpuchikwa oke ebe akụkụ aka nri kọwapụtara.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.b: Akụkụ aka ekpe kọwapụtara maka x≠1, mana akụkụ aka nri akọwapụtaghị maka x<1.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na x<1, argument x−1 n'akụkụ aka nri adịghị mma, ya mere akọwapụtaghị.
n-m-h2-explog-03.s.s3.explain: Akụkụ aka nri 2 log (x−1) kọwapụtara naanị mgbe x−1>0, ya bụ, x>1, ma n'ikpe ahụ ọ hà nhata akụkụ aka ekpe. Maka x<1 akụkụ aka nri adịghị, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ikwu na ha hà nhata.

n-m-h2-explog-04.title: Kedu nke buru ibu, log₂3 ma ọ bụ log₃4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.goal: Dozie ikpe gị gbasara nha nke logarithms ka ị na-enweta ozi ọzọ, ma tụnyere logarithms abụọ ahụ n'enweghị calculator site n'iji ntụnye etiti.
n-m-h2-explog-04.material: N'enweghị calculator, anyị chọrọ ịmata nke buru ibu, log_2 3 ma ọ bụ log_3 4. A na-ekpughe ozi otu ibe n'otu oge. (log_2 3 bụ logarithm nke 3 nwere base 2.)
n-m-h2-explog-04.thinking.1: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị dịka ozi ọhụrụ si dị
n-m-h2-explog-04.prereq.0: Ihe logarithm pụtara (ngwọta nke exponential equation)
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.prompt: N'ọkwa ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe dabere naanị n'ihe ị maara ugbu a.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.0: Oge ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, chee echiche ma ịdebe ikpe gị ma ọ bụ ịgbanwe ya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mgbe base na argument abụọ dị iche, chee echiche ma ọ dị mma ikpe site n'ilele naanị otu n'ime ha.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.info: log_2 3 bụ x na-emezu 2^x=3, ma log_3 4 bụ x na-emezu 3^x=4. Ebe 2<3<4, log_2 3 dị n'etiti 1 na 2, ma ebe 3<4<9, log_3 4 dịkwa n'etiti 1 na 2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kedu nke ị chere buru ibu karịa?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ịmara naanị na abụọ dị n'etiti 1 na 2 anaghị ekwe ka anyị kpebie usoro. Anyị chọrọ ntụnye etiti kpọmkwem karịa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: log_2 3: base pere mpe, ya mere ọ ga-achọ exponent buru ibu iji ruo 3
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ị jiri ọgụgụ isi na ka base pere mpe, ka exponent ga-adị ukwuu. Ọ bụ nzọụkwụ n'ihu, mana ekwenyeghị ya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: log_3 4: argument 4 buru ibu karịa 3, ya mere logarithm ga-abụ nke buru ibu karịa
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ị lere naanị argument. Ị hapụrụ na base na-agbanwekwa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Amaghị ka: anyị maara naanị na abụọ dị n'etiti 1 na 2
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Nke a bụ ikpe na-ekwu na a chọrọ ntụnye kpọmkwem karịa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ka anyị tụọ site n'ntụnye etiti 3/2. 2^(3/2)=√8≈2.83 pere mpe karịa 3, ya mere log_2 3 buru ibu karịa 3/2. 3^(3/2)=√27≈5.20 buru ibu karịa 4, ya mere log_3 4 pere mpe karịa 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ugbu a kedu nke ị kpebiri na ọ buru ibu karịa?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ebe log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4, log_2 3 buru ibu karịa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị kpebiri megidere ozi ọhụrụ. Lelee ọzọ nke buru ibu karịa 3/2.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ị kewapụrụ ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ site na 3/2 n'etiti ha.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ụkpụrụ abụọ ahụ dị n'akụkụ dị iche nke 3/2, ya mere ha enweghị ike ịhà nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Site n'ịtụ n'otu ụzọ, log_2 3≈1.585, log_3 4≈1.262, log_4 5≈1.161, na log_5 6≈1.113.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu ka log_n(n+1) si agbanwe ka n na-aghọ ukwuu?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ebe n+1>n, log_n(n+1) buru ibu karịa 1 mgbe niile, ụkpụrụ ya na-abụkwa nke pere mpe ma na-abịaru 1 nso.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ọ na-aga n'ihu na-abawanye: n'ihi na argument na-aghọ ukwuu
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ị lere naanị argument. Base na-aghọkwa ukwuu.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ọ na-aghọ pere mpe, mana ọ naghị ada n'okpuru 1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ị lere ntụziaka nke ụkpụrụ na eziokwu na argument buru ibu karịa base.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ọ na-aghọ pere mpe ma n'ikpeazụ ọ na-ada n'okpuru 1
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na argument buru ibu karịa base, logarithm buru ibu karịa 1 mgbe niile.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ anyị enweghị ike ikpebi n'ihi na abụọ dị n'etiti 1 na 2, mana mgbe anyị tinyere ntụnye etiti 3/2, a kpebiri usoro. Mgbe ọnụọgụ abụọ dị ka ndị dị iche ibe ha, chọta ọnụọgụ ntụnye nke a pụrụ itinye n'etiti ha ma tụnyere nke ọ bụla na ya.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.prompt: Gosi, site n'iji 3/2 n'enweghị calculator, na log_2 3>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ị pụrụ ikpe nha nke log_2 3 tụnyere 3/2 site n'ịtụnyere powers abụọ nke 2. Tinye 2^(3/2) na 3 n'otu exponent.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.hint.1: N'otu ụzọ ahụ, tụnyere log_3 4 na 3/2. Mee square akụkụ abụọ ma tụnyere ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gosiri ihe mere log_2 3 ji buru ibu karịa 3/2 site n'ịtụnyere ọnụọgụ zuru ezu?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ gosikwara ihe mere log_3 4 ji pere mpe karịa 3/2?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ jikọtara nsonaazụ abụọ ahụ wee kwubie log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4?
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.0: 2^(3/2)=√8 pere mpe karịa 3, ya mere log_2 3>3/2, ma 3^(3/2)=√27 buru ibu karịa 4, ya mere log_3 4<3/2. Ya mere log_2 3>3/2>log_3 4.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.1: Tụnyere site n'ime square akụkụ abụọ. Ebe 3^2=9>8=2^3, log_2 3>3/2, ma ebe 4^2=16<27=3^3, log_3 4<3/2. Ya mere log_2 3 buru ibu karịa.
n-m-h2-explog-04.s.s2.model.2: Ịtụnyere log_2 3 na 1.5: 2^3=8<9=3^2, ya mere ọ buru ibu karịa 1.5. Maka log_3 4, 3^3=27>16=4^2, ya mere ọ pere mpe karịa 1.5. Ya mere nke mbụ buru ibu karịa.

n-m-h2-explog-06.title: Ịmepụta exponential function y=aˣ+b ka ọ dabara n'ọnọdụ e nyere
n-m-h2-explog-06.goal: Mepụta n'onwe gị exponential function nke eserese ya na-agafe n'otu isi ntụ ma na-ezute x-axis, ma kpee ikpe ọnọdụ ndị ahụ site n'iji ọnọdụ asymptote na x-intercept.
n-m-h2-explog-06.material: Ka anyị mepụta eserese nke y=a^x+b (a bụ ọnụọgụ eke site na 2 ruo 10, b bụkwa ọnụọgụ zuru ezu). Anyị na-ekpe ikpe site n'iji naanị usoro na ọnọdụ, n'enweghị ise eserese.
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.0: Ime usoro na-emezu ọnọdụ n'onwe gị
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.1: Ichọta ihe atụ na-agafe n'isi ntụ mana na-agbaji ọnọdụ ọzọ
n-m-h2-explog-06.thinking.2: Ịhazi mmekọrịta dị n'etiti asymptote na x-intercept
n-m-h2-explog-06.prereq.0: Eserese na asymptote nke exponential function y=a^x
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.prompt: Tinye pairs (a, b) abụọ dị iche nke eserese y=a^x+b na-agafe n'isi ntụ (2, 7) ma na-ezute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.0: Dee ọnọdụ nke ịgafe n'isi ntụ (2, 7) dị ka equation ma chọta mmekọrịta dị n'etiti a na b.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.hint.1: Họrọ a, chọta b, wee lelee ma eserese ahụ na-ezute x-axis. Ọ bụrụ na ọ naghị ezute, gbanwee a.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c1: a bụ ọnụọgụ eke site na 2 ruo 10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c1: a ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ eke site na 2 ruo 10.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.ok.c4: Asymptote y=b dị n'okpuru x-axis, ya mere eserese ahụ na-ezute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.fail.c4: Eserese ahụ anaghị ezute x-axis. Lelee ọnọdụ asymptote y=b na eserese ahụ.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.explain: Site n'a²+b=7, b=7−a². Dịka ọmụmaatụ, a=3 na-enye b=−2 ma a=4 na-enye b=−9; mgbe b<0, asymptote y=b dị n'okpuru x-axis, ya mere eserese ahụ na-ezute x-axis. Na a=2, b=3, ya mere eserese ahụ na-agafe n'isi ntụ (2, 7) mana ọ dị naanị n'elu y=3.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.prompt: Eserese e mere site n'a=2, b=3 na-agafe n'isi ntụ (2, 7) mana ọ naghị emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ. Dee ihe kpatara.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.0: Lelee asymptote nke eserese a na ma eserese ahụ dị n'elu ma ọ bụ n'okpuru ya.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.hint.1: Chọta oke ụkpụrụ y=2^x+3 nwere ike iwere, malite site n'oke nke 2^x.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru na ụkpụrụ y karịrị 3 mgbe niile?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na, ya mere, y enweghị ike ịbụ 0?
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.0: 2^x dị mma mgbe niile, ya mere 2^x+3 karịrị 3 mgbe niile. Ya mere y enweghị ike ịbụ 0, eserese ahụ anaghịkwa ezute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.1: Asymptote nke eserese a bụ y=3, eserese ahụ dịkwa naanị n'elu ya. Ya mere ọ naghị ezute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s1.because.model.2: y=2^x+3 na-ewere ụkpụrụ karịrị 3 mgbe niile, ya mere ọ naghị eru x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.prompt: Maka a>1, họrọ ọnọdụ n'b ka eserese y=a^x+b zute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee oke nke a^x, wee chọta ihe oke nke y na-aghọ mgbe ị gbakwunyere b na ya.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.hint.1: Chee echiche ihe b ga-abụrịrị ka 0 dị n'ime oke ahụ.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na b=0, mgbe ahụ y=a^x, nke dị mma mgbe niile, ya mere ọ naghị ezute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.b: Ọ bụrụ na b dị mma, eserese ahụ dị n'elu b, ya mere ọ naghị ezute x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.c: Ọ gụnyekwara ikpe ebe b dị mma. Lelee ikpe ebe asymptote dị n'elu x-axis.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.r.d: Ị maara na ụkpụrụ nke y=a^x+b niile karịrị b, ya mere b ga-adịrị adịghị mma ka a gụnye 0.
n-m-h2-explog-06.s.s2.explain: Ụkpụrụ nke a^x bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie niile karịrị 0, ya mere ụkpụrụ nke a^x+b bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie niile karịrị b. Ka 0 dị n'oke a, a chọrọ b<0. Nke a pụtara na asymptote y=b dị n'okpuru x-axis.

n-m-h2-explog-08.title: Ịlele ngwọta gụrụ ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede site na common logarithm
n-m-h2-explog-08.goal: Chọta ahịrị ezighi ezi n’ngwọta jiri common logarithm chọta ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede, lelee otú ọnụọgụ ahụ si agbanwe n’ebe ókè.
n-m-h2-explog-08.material: Seoyeon jiri common logarithm chọta mkpụrụedemede ole 3^50 nwere. (log 3=0.4771, 3^50 bụ 3 n’ọkwa 50.)
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ ezighi ezi na ngwọta Seoyeon.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee site n’ọnụọgụ pere mpe. Mkpụrụedemede ole 10²=100 nwere? 10²=100 10^2
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere nsonaazụ ahụ n’akụkụ akụkụ integer nke logarithm, hụ ma nkwubi okwu nke anọ Seoyeon ziri ezi. 10²=100 has 3 digits. 4th
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.0: Iji chọta ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede nke 3^50, were common logarithm n’akụkụ abụọ.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.line.3: Ebe 10^23≤3^50<10^24, akụkụ integer 23 bụ ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 4 bụ nke mbụ ezighi ezi. 10^23 bụ 1 sochiri zero 23, nke nwere mkpụrụedemede 24. Ya mere N nwere 10^23≤N<10^24 nwere mkpụrụedemede 24; a ga-agbakwunye 1 na akụkụ integer 23 iji nweta ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede. Ahịrị 5 bụ nsonaazụ nke ahịrị 4.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede ziri ezi nke 3^50, kọwaa mkpebi Seoyeon a ga-edozi na etu a ga-esi dozie ya.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede nke 10^1,10^2,10^3, chọta ọdịiche dị n’etiti exponent na ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede. 10^1, 10^2, 10^3; exponent 1,2,3; digits 2,3,4.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye ụkpụrụ i chọtara n’ime N nwere log N=23.855.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I kwuru na a ga-agbakwunye 1 na akụkụ integer?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: I kwuru ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede N nwere ma N dịkarịa ala 10^23 ma dị ala karịa 10^24?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.0: Ebe log 3^50=23.855, 10^23≤3^50<10^24. 10^23 nwere mkpụrụedemede 24, ya mere 3^50 nwekwara 24. A ga-agbakwunye 1 na akụkụ integer 23.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.1: Ike 10^23 nwere mkpụrụedemede 24, ya mere 3^50 nwekwara 24. Seoyeon dere akụkụ integer ozugbo dịka ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede; ọ kwesịrị ịgbakwunye 1.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s2.model.2: Akụkụ integer bụ 23, ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede bụ 23+1=24.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.prompt: N’etiti ọnụọgụ dị mma N ndị e nyere common logarithm ha n’okpuru, họrọ ndị nwere mkpụrụedemede 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.0: Dee N nke ọ bụla dịka oke dị n’etiti ike 10. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọ bụrụ log N=7.2, n’etiti ike 10 abụọ ka ọ dị?
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.hint.1: Mgbe logarithm bụ integer, dee kpọmkwem ike 10 N bụ, gụọ mkpụrụedemede ya.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.a: I ma na mgbe logarithm bụ integer, N=10^7, nke nwere mkpụrụedemede 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.b: N=10^8 nwere mkpụrụedemede 9. Ọ bụrụ akụkụ integer bụ 8, ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede bụ 9.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.c: Nke a bụ mkpebi ịgbakwunye 1 na akụkụ integer 7 iji nweta mkpụrụedemede 8.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.r.d: 6.99 nwere akụkụ integer 6, ya mere mkpụrụedemede 7. Ịdị nso na 7 abụghị otu na ịdịkarịa ala 7.
n-m-h2-explog-08.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ akụkụ integer nke log N bụ n, N nwere mkpụrụedemede n+1. Ọ bụrụ log N=7.0, N=10^7 nwere mkpụrụedemede 8; ọ bụrụ 7.2, 10^7≤N<10^8, ya mere 8 mkpụrụedemede. 6.99 na-enye 7, 8.0 na-enye 9.

n-m-h2-explog-10.title: Ịchọta ụzọ ọnụọgụ dị mma nke log(a+b)=log a+log b bụ eziokwu
n-m-h2-explog-10.goal: Jiri ihe atụ i mepụtara lelee ma eziokwu izugbe “logarithm nke nchikọta abụghị nchikọta logarithm” nwere ihe ndị na-ewezuga ya; hazie ọnọdụ ahụ dịka usoro.
n-m-h2-explog-10.material: log(a+b)=log a+log b bụ nhata na-abụkarị ụgha. Ma n’etiti ọnụọgụ a na b dị mma, è nwere ụzọ na-eme ka ọ bụrụ eziokwu? (log bụ common logarithm.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.0: Mepụta ihe atụ ebe ọ bụ eziokwu n’onwe gị.
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.1: Ịgbanwe nchikọta logarithm ka ọ bụrụ logarithm ngwaahịa
n-m-h2-explog-10.thinking.2: Ịchọta ọnọdụ jikọrọ ọnụ nke ihe atụ
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.0: Iwu logarithm log a+log b=log ab
n-m-h2-explog-10.prereq.2: Ngụkọ na irighiri na ọnụọgụ ntụpọ
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.prompt: Tinye ụzọ ọnụọgụ dị mma 3 dị iche iche a,b nke log(a+b)=log a+log b bụ eziokwu. (A na-ewere ụzọ abụọ a gbanwere ọnọdụ dịka otu. A pụrụ iji ọnụọgụ ntụpọ.)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.0: Jikọta nchikọta logarithm dị n’aka nri ka ọ bụrụ otu logarithm, tụnyere ya na aka ekpe.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.hint.1: Dee ihe arguments ga-abụ ma logarithm abụọ hà nhata, họrọ a, chọta b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c1: a na b abụọ dị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c1: a na b ga-abụrịrị ndị dị mma.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.ok.c2: a+b na ab hà nhata; ya mere log(a+b)=log a+log b bụ eziokwu.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.fail.c2: a+b na ab dị iche; ya mere logarithm abụọ ahụ adịghị nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.explain: Ebe log a+log b=log ab, nhata ahụ bụ eziokwu mgbe log(a+b)=log ab, ya bụ a+b=ab. (2,2),(3,1.5),(5,1.25) niile na-arụ ọrụ. Anyị jiri eziokwu na logarithm abụọ hà nhata naanị ma arguments ha hà nhata. (2,2), (3,1.5), (5,1.25) (2, 2), (3, 1.5), (5, 1.25)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.prompt: Dee dịka usoro mmekọrịta dị n’etiti a na b nke dị n’ụzọ abụọ i chọtara, kọwaa ihe mere mmekọrịta ahụ ji eme ka okwu abụọ ahụ hà nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.0: Maka ụzọ abụọ nke ọ bụla, gbakọọ a+b na ab, dee ha n’akụkụ ibe ha.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.hint.1: Jikọta log a+log b ka ọ bụrụ otu logarithm, dee argument ya.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.0: Ị dere log a+log b=log ab?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.selfAssess.1: I kwuru na ọ bụrụ logarithm hà nhata, arguments ha hà nhata?
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.0: Ebe log a+log b=log ab, ka log(a+b)=log ab bụrụ eziokwu, a+b=ab ka achọrọ. Nke a bụ n’ihi na arguments logarithm hà nhata mgbe uru logarithm hà nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.1: Ngụkọta na ngwaahịa a na b ga-abụ otu (ab=a+b). Nke a bụ n’ihi na nchikọta logarithm hà nhata logarithm nke ngwaahịa arguments; uru logarithm hà nhata na-egosi na arguments ha hà nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s1.because.model.2: (a−1)(b−1)=1 ezuola. Ịgbasa na-enye ab−a−b+1=1, ya mere ab=a+b, log a+log b=log ab=log(a+b).
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi gbasara ọnụọgụ a,b dị mma nke log(a+b)=log a+log b bụ eziokwu.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ a≤1, were b dị mma, tụnyere nke ka ukwuu n’etiti ab na a+b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.hint.1: N’etiti ụzọ abụọ mezuru a+b=ab, tụnyere nha a na b.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.a: Otu n’ime a na b nwere ike ịdị ala karịa 1.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.a: Ọ bụrụ a≤1, ab≤b<a+b; ya mere a+b agaghị hà ab.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.b: I marala na ọ bụrụ a≤1 ma ọ bụ b≤1, ngwaahịa pere mpe karịa ngụkọta; ya mere ha enweghị ike ịdị nhata.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.c: a na b abụọ dị ala karịa 1.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.c: Ọ bụrụ ha abụọ dị ala karịa 1, ngwaahịa pere mpe nke ukwuu karịa ngụkọta.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.o.d: Otu n’ime a na b ga-abụrịrị 2.
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.r.d: Ụzọ abụọ nwere ike ịdị na-enweghị 2, dịka (3,1.5). (3,1.5) (3, 1.5)
n-m-h2-explog-10.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ a≤1, ab≤b<a+b, ya mere ngụkọta enweghị ike hà nhata ngwaahịa. Otu ihe ahụ dịkwa mgbe b≤1. Ya mere n’ụzọ na-arụ ọrụ, a na b abụọ karịrị 1. Ebe (a−1)(b−1)=1, mgbe otu na-abịaru 1 nso, nke ọzọ na-ebuwanye ibu.

n-m-h2-limit-01.title: Gịnị ka anyị chọrọ ịmata iji kwuo na function na-aga n'ihu (continuous)?
n-m-h2-limit-01.topic: Limits na continuity nke functions: ọnọdụ maka continuity
n-m-h2-limit-01.goal: Hazie ozi dị mkpa ma zuru ezu iji kwubie na function na-aga n'ihu (continuous) na x=a, kpebie n'onwe gị ma function na-aga n'ihu, ma hazie ụkpụrụ ahụ n'okwu nke gị.
n-m-h2-limit-01.material: Anyị chọrọ ịchọpụta ma function f na-aga n'ihu na x=1. Left-hand limit bụ uru f(x) na-abịaru nso mgbe x na-abịaru 1 nso site n'akụkụ ebe x dị ala karịa 1, right-hand limit bụkwa uru ọ na-abịaru nso site n'akụkụ ebe x karịrị 1. Chee ma anyị nwere ike ikwubi "ọ na-aga n'ihu" mgbe anyị maara naanị akụkụ nke ozi ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.0: Ịkewa ozi na-eme ka anyị kwubie na nke na-adịghị zuru ezu
n-m-h2-limit-01.thinking.1: Inyocha mmekọrịta dị n'etiti uru function, left-hand limit, na right-hand limit
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.0: Ihe left-hand na right-hand limits pụtara
n-m-h2-limit-01.prereq.1: Ahụmahụ ịkewa uru functions na uru limit
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ otu ozi, n'ime ndị a banyere f, nke na-eme ka ị doo anya na f na-aga n'ihu na x=1 mgbe ị maara naanị otu ozi ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ depụta ihe ị ga-elele iji kwuo na ọ na-aga n'ihu, mgbe ahụ kaa akara ma nhọrọ ọ bụla na-emezu ha niile.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kewaa "a kọwapụtara uru ahụ" na "uru ahụ hà uru limit" dịka ozi dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.a: f(1)=3, ma f(x) na-abịaru 3 nso mgbe x na-abịaru 1 nso site n'akụkụ buru ibu
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.a: Ị lere naanị otu one-sided limit. Anyị amabeghị uru mgbe ọ na-abịaru nso site n'akụkụ nke ọzọ.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.b: f(1)=3, ma left-hand na right-hand limits dị abụọ ma hà ibe ha
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.b: Ị maara na limit dị, ma ị pụghị ịmata ma uru limit ahụ hà f(1)=3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.c: f(1)=3, ma left-hand na right-hand limits abụọ bụ 3
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.o.d: Left-hand na right-hand limits abụọ bụ 3, a kọwapụtakwara f(1) dịka uru ụfọdụ
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.r.d: Ịmara naanị na a kọwapụtara f(1), ị pụghị ịmata ma uru ahụ bụ 3.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s1.explain: Maka continuity, a ga-akọwapụta f(1), limit dịka x→1 ga-adị, uru limit ahụ ga-ahàkwa f(1). Nhọrọ c na-emezu atọ niile. Nhọrọ a nwere naanị one-sided limit, b anaghị ejikọta limit na f(1), d amaghịkwa uru f(1), ya mere anyị pụghị ịmata ma ọ hà uru limit.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ niile n'ime functions anọ ndị a na-aga n'ihu na x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.0: Maka function ọ bụla, chọta n'usoro uru function na x=1, left-hand limit, na right-hand limit, ma hazie ha n'tebụl.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.hint.1: Maka nkwupụta fractional, mee ya ka ọ dị mfe maka x≠1, mgbe ahụ chọta uru ka x na-abịaru 1 nso.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.b: Ka x→1, (x²−1)/(x−1)=x+1 na-abịaru 2 nso, ma f₂(1)=1, ya mere uru limit na uru function dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na uru function adịghị na x=1, anyị enweghị ike ikpọ ya na-aga n'ihu ọbụlagodi na limit dị.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s2.explain: f₁ hà x+1 maka x≠1, ya mere limit ya bụ 2, f₁(1)=2 na-adakwa. Maka f₄, left-hand limit bụ 2, right-hand limit bụ 3·1−1=2, f₄(1)=2 bụkwa, ya mere ha niile hà nhata. Maka f₂, uru limit 2 na uru function 1 dị iche, f₃ enwekwaghị f₃(1).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.prompt: N's2, a wepụrụ functions ndị na-adịghị aga n'ihu n'ihi ihe kpatara dị iche. N'okwu nke gị, hazie ihe ị ga-elele iji kwuo na function na-aga n'ihu na x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dee ọzọ n'ihe ọ bụla ka a wepụrụ f₂ na f₃ nke ọ bụla.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ihe kpatara e ji jụ ha dị iche, gụọ ihe ole ị ga-elele iji wepụ ha niile.
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru ọnọdụ atọ ahụ niile n'ahapụghị ọ bụla?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ụkpụrụ gị ọ̀ gụnyere ihe kpatara e ji jụ f₂ na f₃?
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.0: f na-aga n'ihu na x=a ma ọ bụrụ na akọwapụtara f(a), limit dị n'ihi na left-hand na right-hand limits hà nhata ka x→a, ma limit ahụ hà f(a).
n-m-h2-limit-01.s.s3.model.1: Nke mbụ, uru function ga-adị. Nke abụọ, limit ga-adị, pụtara na limits site n'akụkụ abụọ hà nhata. Nke atọ, limit ahụ ga-ahà uru function.

n-m-h2-limit-02.title: Ịlele nkwupụta na ọnụ dị site n'iji Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.topic: Limits na continuity nke functions: Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.goal: Mgbe ị na-eji Intermediate Value Theorem, ejila anya lekwasị naanị ihe ịrịba ama: lelee na ọnọdụ nke theorem ahụ emezuru, ma jiri ihe atụ megidere gosi na nkwupụta ahụ bụ ụgha.
n-m-h2-limit-02.material: Seojin chọrọ ịchọpụta ma nha 1/x=0 nwere ọnụ real n'oge (−1, 2), ya mere ọ tọrọ f(x)=1/x ma rụọ ọrụ dị ka ndị a.
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.1: Ịchọta ahịrị ebe ọnọdụ nke theorem adịghị
n-m-h2-limit-02.thinking.2: Ịhọrọ ụzọ iji nye ọnọdụ na-adịghị
n-m-h2-limit-02.prereq.0: Continuous functions na nkwupụta nke Intermediate Value Theorem
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Seojin.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kewaa ahịrị ọ bụla n'"mgbakọ" ma ọ bụ "ikpe na-etinye theorem."
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ahịrị na-etinye theorem, tụnyere ọnọdụ theorem chọrọ na ihe a lelere, otu otu.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.0: Ka f(x)=1/x. Mgbe ahụ f(−1)=−1 na f(2)=1/2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.2: Site na Intermediate Value Theorem, e nwere c n’etiti −1 na 2 nke f(c)=0.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.line.3: Ya mere nha 1/x=0 nwere mgbọrọgwụ n’ezie n’ime interval (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 bụ njehie mbụ. A pụrụ iji Intermediate Value Theorem naanị mgbe f na-aga n’ihu n’ime interval mechiri emechi [−1, 2], ma f(x)=1/x akọwaghị na x=0, nke dị n’ime interval a. Mgbakọ ahịrị 1 na 2 ziri ezi, ahịrị 4 sokwa na nkwubi okwu na-ezighị ezi ahịrị 3.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.prompt: Gosi na nkwubi okwu Seojin ezighị ezi. Dee ọnọdụ ọrụ ga-agbaso tupu e jiri Intermediate Value Theorem, ihe mere f(x)=1/x anaghị agbaso ya, na ihe mgbọrọgwụ n’ezie nke 1/x=0 bụ.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.0: Dee theorem ahụ n’ụdị “ọ bụrụ ..., mgbe ahụ ...” gụọkwa ọnọdụ ole dị n’akụkụ “ọ bụrụ.”
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma ngalaba f(x)=1/x enweghị isi ọ bụla n’etiti −1 na 2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị buru ụzọ dee ọnọdụ theorem ahụ (ịga n’ihu)?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị gosiri na x=0 dị n’ime interval ahụ?
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.0: A pụrụ iji Intermediate Value Theorem naanị mgbe f na-aga n’ihu na [−1, 2]. Ma f(x)=1/x akọwaghị na x=0, ya mere ọ naghị aga n’ihu. N’ezie, ọ dịghị x na-eme ka 1/x=0, ya mere enweghị mgbọrọgwụ n’ezie.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s2.model.1: Iji theorem ahụ, ọrụ ga-aga n’ihu n’ime interval, ma 1/x na-agbaji na x=0, ya mere a pụghị iji ya. Ebe numerator bụ 1, ọ dịghị x nke 1/x bụ 0, ya mere nha a enweghị azịza.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.prompt: Hapụ f(−1)<0<f(2) otu ọ dị. Họrọ ọnọdụ a ga-agbakwunye iji jide n’aka na f(x)=0 nwere mgbọrọgwụ n’ime interval (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.0: Chee ma eserese na-awụ elu ma ọ bụ nwee oghere n’ime interval nwere ike gafere 0 n’enweghị ịgafe ya.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kpebie ma nhọrọ nke ọ bụla metụtara nsọtụ ma ọ bụ interval dum.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.a: f na-aga n’ihu na x=−1 na x=2.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.a: Ọbụna ma f na-aga n’ihu naanị na nsọtụ abụọ ahụ, oghere n’etiti interval nwere ike ime ka mgbọrọgwụ gbanahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.b: f(−1) na f(2) bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu abụọ.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.b: Ma uru ndị ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịdị adị mgbọrọgwụ.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.c: f na-aga n’ihu n’isi niile nke interval mechiri emechi [−1, 2].
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.o.d: f(x) abụghị 0 maka x niile dị n’ime interval (−1, 2).
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.r.d: Nke a pụtara na enweghị mgbọrọgwụ, ya mere ọ na-emegide nkwubi okwu ahụ n’ezie.
n-m-h2-limit-02.s.s3.explain: Intermediate Value Theorem chọrọ ka ọrụ gaa n’ihu n’ime interval mechiri emechi dum. N’okpuru ọnọdụ a, 0 ga-adị n’etiti uru nsọtụ nwere akara dị iche.

n-m-h2-limit-04.title: Oke Ọrụ Ngwakọta: Ịlele Nkwupụta Mina
n-m-h2-limit-04.topic: Oke na Ịga n’ihu nke Ọrụ: Oke Ọrụ Ngwakọta
n-m-h2-limit-04.goal: Jiri ihe atụ kwado na oke ọrụ ngwakọta na-agbanwe dabere n’akụkụ ọrụ ime si abịarute 0, kọwaa ma nkwupụta ahụ ziri ezi ka ọ bụ ụgha, nye ihe kpatara ya.
n-m-h2-limit-04.material: Kọwaa ọrụ f dịka f(t)=1 (t>0), f(0)=0, f(t)=−1 (t<0). Mgbe t→0, oke aka ekpe −1 na nke aka nri 1 dị iche, ya mere oke f adịghị. Were na ọrụ g na-abịaru 0 ka x→0. Mina kwuru, “Mgbe ahụ oke ọrụ ngwakọta f(g(x)) ka x→0 adịghịkwa.” (Tụlee naanị x ebe g(x)≠0.)
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.0: Ịhọrọ ihe atụ iji nwalee nkwupụta
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.1: Ịkọwa ọnọdụ ịbịaru nso site n’otu akụkụ
n-m-h2-limit-04.thinking.2: Ịkpebi ihe a ga-elele iji mara ma oke dị
n-m-h2-limit-04.prereq.0: Oke aka ekpe na oke aka nri
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ọrụ g(x) niile n’ime nhọrọ ndị a nke oke f(g(x)) ka x→0 dị.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dochie x na 0.1, −0.1, 0.01, −0.01, lelee akara g(x).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mgbe e kpebiri akara g(x), lelee ma uru f(g(x)) ọ̀ bụ otu uru kpọmkwem.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.b: Ọ bụrụ x>0, g>0; ọ bụrụ x<0, g<0, ya mere f(g(x)) na-agbanwe n’etiti 1 na −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.r.d: Akara g na-agbanwe dịka akara x si dị, ya mere f(g(x)) na-agbanwe n’etiti 1 na −1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s1.explain: g(x)=x² (x≠0) na-adị mma mgbe niile, ya mere f(g(x))=1, oke ya bụ 1. g(x)=−x⁴ (x≠0) na-adị njọ mgbe niile, ya mere f(g(x))=−1, oke ya bụ −1. x³ na 2x na-agbanwe akara, ya mere oke adịghị.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.prompt: Nkwupụta Mina ọ̀ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile? Kpebie ma ọ̀ bụ eziokwu, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya site n’ụzọ g(x) si abịaru 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.0: Debe g nke s1 nwere oke n’akụkụ g na-enweghị oke, tụnyere otú akara g(x) si dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.hint.1: Chee ma ọ bụ nha t ma ọ bụ ụfọdụ àgwà t na-ekpebi uru f(t).
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị jikọtara akụkụ ọ si abịaru 0 na uru f?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.0: Nkwupụta Mina abụghị eziokwu mgbe niile. Ọ bụrụ g(x)=x², g(x) na-abịaru 0 naanị site n’akụkụ dị mma, ya mere f(g(x)) na-anọgide 1, oke ya dị ma hà 1.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s2.model.1: Mba. Ọ bụrụ g(x) na-abịaru 0 naanị site n’akụkụ na-adịghị mma, f(g(x))=−1 na-anọ otu, ya mere oke dị; g(x)=−x⁴ bụ ihe atụ na-emegide ya.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.prompt: Iji mara ma oke f(g(x)) ka x→0 dị, gịnị ka ị ga-enyocha?
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ka x na-abịaru 0, dee uru ndị ntinye g(x) na-ewere nso 0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.hint.1: Kewaa uru ndị ahụ n’akụkụ oke aka ekpe f na nke oke aka nri.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.a: Ma oke aka ekpe na aka nri nke f(t) ka t→0 na-abịaru otu uru.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.a: Ilele naanị nke a na-eduga n’otu nkwubi okwu Mina. Ọ naghị ele akụkụ ọrụ ime si abịaru nso.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.b: Ma f(0) na g(0) hà, ma ha abụọ akọwara.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.b: A naghị eji uru x=0 achọta oke ka x→0.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.c: Otu g(x) si agbanwe ngwa ngwa ka x na-abịaru 0, na nha ya.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.r.c: Ọsọ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịdị adị oke.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.o.d: Akara uru g(x) na-ewere nso 0, na uru f maka akara ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-04.s.s3.explain: Uru f(g(x)) dabere n’akụkụ uru g(x) dị nso 0. Ọ bụrụ g(x) si n’otu akụkụ naanị abịaru, ịchọrọ oke akụkụ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ọ si n’akụkụ abụọ abịa, tụnyere oke aka ekpe na aka nri.

n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu mpempe n'otu oge. Na nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ mkpebi dabere naanị n'ihe ị maara ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h2-limit-05.title: Uru sin(π/x) ka x na-abịaru 0
n-m-h2-limit-05.topic: Oke na Ịga n’ihu nke Ọrụ: Ịdị adị Oke
n-m-h2-limit-05.goal: Ekwubi okwu banyere oke site n’ụfọdụ uru ole na ole dị na tebụl naanị. Gbanwee mkpebi gị oge ọ bụla uru ọhụrụ pụtara, kọwaa ihe mere oke ji adịghị.
n-m-h2-limit-05.material: Maka f(x)=sin(π/x) (x≠0), ịchọrọ ịmata uru f(x) na-abịaru ka x na-abịaru 0 n’enweghị ngwụcha. Tinye uru na tebụl otu otu, kpebie. (Jiri sin kπ=0, sin(π/2)=1, sin(3π/2)=−1.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.0: Ime mkpebi nwa oge site n’uru a hụrụ
n-m-h2-limit-05.thinking.1: Ịgbanwe mkpebi mgbe uru ọhụrụ pụtara
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.0: Oge ọ bụla uru ọhụrụ pụtara, tụnyere ma ọ na-abịaru otu uru ahụ dị ka ndị gara aga.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ma ụzọ i si họrọ x na-anọchi anya ụzọ niile isi bịaruo 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Mgbe x=1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/10, uru f(x) niile bụ 0. (x na-abịaru 0 nso.)
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Gịnị ka ị chere gbasara oke f(x) ka x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Maka x ụdị 1/n, sin(nπ)=0, ya mere uru bụ 0. Ma nke a nwere ike ịbụ nsonaazụ ịhọrọ x n’ụzọ pụrụ iche.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Echere m na ọ bụ 0: n’ihi na uru na-adị 0 mgbe niile.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nke a bụ mkpebi mbụ na-abata n’uche site n’uru ndị a hụrụ ugbu a naanị.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ọ bụ oge na-adịghị anya ikwubi tupu ịhụ uru x ndị ọzọ.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ị tụlere na i nwere naanị ụfọdụ uru.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Oke adịghị: n’ihi na uru niile bụ otu.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uru ịdị otu bụ ihe ngosi na oke nwere ike ịdị.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Oge a, mgbe x=2/5, 2/9, 2/13, 2/101, uru f(x) niile bụ 1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Gịnị bụ mkpebi gị ugbu a?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Ọbụna ka x na-abịaru 0 nso, f(x) na-abụ mgbe ụfọdụ 0, mgbe ụfọdụ 1. Ọ bụrụ na oke dị, f(x) ga-abịarịrị otu uru ka x na-abịaru 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ọ ka bụ 0: n’ihi na uru mbụ bụ 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị leghaara ozi ọhụrụ anya. Ọbụna x dị nso 0, isi nwere uru 1 apụtala.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ọ bụ 1: n’ihi na uru a hụrụ ugbu a bụ 1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ị gbasoro uru ikpeazụ naanị. Uru 0 a hụrụ na mbụ sikwa na x dị nso 0 pụta n’otu ụzọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: O siri ike ịsị na ọ bụ otu uru: n’ihi na 0 na 1 pụtara mgbe x dị nso 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ị tụlere na uru abụọ ahụ pụtara.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Mgbe x=2/3, 2/7, 2/11, 2/103, uru f(x) niile bụ −1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: N’ikpeazụ, gịnị ka ị ga-ekwu gbasara oke f(x) ka x→0?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Dabere n’otú e si họrọ x dị nso 0, f(x) na-ewere uru 0, 1, na −1, ya mere a pụghị ikwu na ọ na-abịaru otu uru. Oke adịghị.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Oke adịghị: n’ihi na 0, 1, na −1 na-apụta mgbe niile maka x dị nso 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ọ bụ 0: n’ihi na 0 pụtara mbụ.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ịbịa mbụ abụghị ihe kpatara ya.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ọ bụ −1: n’ihi na ọ bụ uru ikpeazụ a hụrụ.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ị họọrọ uru ikpeazụ a hụrụ.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ uru nọgidere bụrụ 0, ya mere o yiri ka oke bụ 0; ma mgbe m lere x ndị ọzọ na-abịaru 0 anya, mkpebi m gbanwere. E kwesịghị ikpebi oke site na “ụfọdụ uru x” kama ma f na-abịaru otu uru maka x niile na-abịaru 0.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.prompt: Dee ihe a ga-akpachara anya mgbe a na-eche oke site n’ụfọdụ uru dị na tebụl, na ihe kpatara ọrụ a enweghị oke.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tụnyere n'akụkụ ibe ha uru x ndị tebụl gosiri 0, 1, na −1.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.hint.1: Dee ihe ga-eme uru ndị ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke dị, n'agbanyeghị otu x si abịaru 0 nso.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị nyere uru x kpọmkwem na-egosi na uru dị iche dabere n'otu x si abịaru 0 nso?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị kọwara ihe mere uru ole na ole dị na tebụl ezughị ezu?
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe m họrọ x naanị n'udi 1/n, m na-enweta 0 mgbe niile, mana mgbe x na-abịaru 0 nso n'ụzọ ndị ọzọ, m na-enweta 1 ma ọ bụ −1. Dabere n'x na-abịaru 0 nso, f na-ewere uru dị iche, ya mere enweghị oke. Ị ekwesịghị ikpebi site n'uru ole na ole naanị.
n-m-h2-limit-05.s.s2.model.1: Ikpebi site n'uru ole na ole dị na tebụl nwere ike ime ka ị daa. Dabere n'ka a na-ahọrọ x nso 0, f(x) na-ewere uru dị iche 0, 1, na −1, ya mere ọ naghị abịaru otu uru nso ma enweghị oke.

n-m-h2-limit-06.title: Idee nkọwa nke "eserese gbajiri agbaji" maka Seoyun
n-m-h2-limit-06.topic: Oke na ịga n'ihu nke ọrụ: ịga n'ihu n'ime domain
n-m-h2-limit-06.goal: Hazie mgbe echiche na "eserese gbajiri agbaji pụtara na ọ naghị aga n'ihu" ziri ezi na mgbe ọ na-ezighị ezi, ma kọwaa ọzọ n'okwu dabara nwanne gị nke nọ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị, na-ejikọta ya na domain.
n-m-h2-limit-06.material: Nwanne gị nke nọ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị Seoyun kwuru, "Eserese nke f(x)=1/x gbajiri agbaji na x=0, ya mere ọ bụ ọrụ na-agaghị n'ihu. Ọrụ na-aga n'ihu bụ nke ị nwere ike ise n'enweghị ịrị elu mkpisi ihe." Ị chọrọ ikọwara Seoyun ebe nke a na-agbagwoju anya.
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.1: Ịghọta mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ịgbajiri n'eserese na domain
n-m-h2-limit-06.thinking.2: Ide nkọwa ọzọ ka ọ dabara onye na-ege ntị
n-m-h2-limit-06.prereq.0: Nkọwa nke ịga n'ihu (uru oke = uru ọrụ)
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ọrụ niile n'ime ndị a na-aga n'ihu n'isi ebe ọ bụla nke domain ha.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee domain, ma mgbe ahụ rụọ ọrụ n'usoro a: maka isi ebe ọ bụla dị n'ime domain, lelee ma uru oke hà nhata uru ọrụ.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwuo ma ebe eserese na-ele anya dị ka ọ gbajiri agbaji bụ isi ebe dị n'ime domain ma ọ bụ n'èzí ya.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.r.d: Na x=0 oke aka ekpe bụ 0, oke aka nri bụ 1, ma uru ọrụ bụ 1, ya mere ọrụ ahụ anaghị aga n'ihu na x=0, isi ebe dị n'ime domain.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s1.explain: N'isi ebe ọ bụla x≠0, okwu ọtụtụ dị nso n'isi ebe ahụ maka 1/x na x/|x| bụ okwu ọtụtụ dị mfe n'x (1/x, ma ọ bụ ndị na-agbanwe agbanwe 1 na −1), ya mere ha na-aga n'ihu n'isi ebe ọ bụla nke domain. |x| na-aga n'ihu n'ọnụọgụ n'ezie ọ bụla. k anaghị aga n'ihu na x=0, nke bụ akụkụ nke domain, n'ihi na oke aka ekpe na aka nri ya dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee nkọwa ị ga-ezigara Seoyun n'ahịrịokwu 3 ruo 4. Seoyun nọ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị ma ọ nwere ike ịnụ okwu dị ka "oke" na "domain" nke mbụ. Ọ ga-agụnyerịrị ihe mere ịgbajiri nke 1/x anaghị adị otu na ịbụ ọrụ na-agaghị n'ihu.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.0: Malite site n'ide, n'okwu Seoyun nwere ike ịghọta, ihe na-eme mgbe ị tinye x=0 n'1/x.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tụnyere ma "eserese gbajiri agbaji" na "uru na-awụlikwa ọsọ n'isi ebe nwere uru" pụtara otu ihe.
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị dere ya n'okwu nwa akwụkwọ sekọndrị nwere ike ịghọta?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị kọwapụtara ihe kpatara ịgbajiri ahụ nke ọma (n'èzí domain)?
n-m-h2-limit-06.s.s2.model.0: Seoyun, 1/x enweghị uru ọ bụla na x=0, ya mere eserese na-ele anya dị ka ọ gbajiri agbaji n'ebe ahụ. Ịga n'ihu na-ajụ, n'isi ebe ọ bụla nwere uru, ma uru ahụ na-agbaji nso n'isi ebe ahụ. N'ebe ọ bụla 1/x nwere uru ọ naghị agbaji, ya mere ọ bụ ọrụ na-aga n'ihu.

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.hint.0: Maka x<1, kagbu ma mee ka okwu ọtụtụ dị mfe, mgbe ahụ chọta uru ya ka x na-abịaru 1 nso. Jiri otu usoro ahụ maka x>1.

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s2.model.1: Oke aka nri bụ x+1→2 maka x karịrị 1, ma oke aka ekpe bụ −(x+1)→−2 maka x dị ala karịa 1. Uru abụọ ahụ dị iche, ya mere oke adịghị.

n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.0: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, buru ụzọ lelee ma okwu ọtụtụ dị n'ime uru zuru oke na-agbanwe akara nso x=1.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.hint.1: Chee echiche ma, ọ bụrụ na akara anaghị agbanwe, ị nwere ike iwepụ uru zuru oke n'ụzọ dị mfe.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.a: Nke a bụ okwu ọtụtụ sitere n'nsogbu a rụrụ. Oke aka ekpe na aka nri dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.c: Nso x=1, x+1 dị mma, ya mere |x²−1|=|x−1|(x+1), ma oke aka ekpe bụ −2 ma oke aka nri bụ 2, nke dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.r.d: Onye na-agụ na-abịaru 2 nso ma onye na-ekewa na-abịaru 0 nso, ya mere maka x>1 ọ na-eto n'enweghị njedebe ma maka x<1 ọ na-ebelata n'enweghị njedebe. Oke adịghị.
n-m-h2-limit-08.s.s3.explain: Nso x=1, x+1>0, ya mere |x+1|=x+1, na (x²−1)/|x+1|=x−1, ya mere oke bụ 0. Ihe dị mkpa bụ ma okwu ọtụtụ dị n'ime uru zuru oke na-agbanwe akara nso 1.
