n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.hint.1: Debe naanị mmekọrịta nke bụ eziokwu n'ihe atụ abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.b: N'ihe atụ megidere sitere n'ime s2, oke ndị ahụ hà nhata.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.c: Ọbụna ma f<g, oke nke f enweghị ike ịbụ nke ka ukwuu.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.r.d: N'ihe atụ megidere (0, x²), oke abụọ ahụ hà nhata.
n-m-h2-limit-09.s.s3.explain: Ọ bụrụ na f(x)<g(x), naanị ≤ ka a na-ekwe nkwa n'oke. E nwere ihe atụ ebe nhata na-adị, ya mere < abụghị eziokwu, ma > bụ ụgha n'ikpe niile.

n-m-h2-limit-10.title: Ịlele azịza maka ịchọta a nke g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) na-aga n'ihu
n-m-h2-limit-10.topic: Oke na ịga n'ihu nke ọrụ: ịga n'ihu nke ọrụ ngwaahịa
n-m-h2-limit-10.goal: Chọta ma dozie azịza nke na-ahapụ ikpe pụrụ iche ebe isi ebe ịgbajiri abụọ na-adabara, ma lelee ihe mere ọrụ ahụ ji na-aga n'ihu mgbe ha na-adabara.
n-m-h2-limit-10.material: Maka ọrụ f(x)=x+2 (x<0), f(x)=x−2 (x≥0), nsogbu ahụ bụ ịchọta uru niile nke ihe na-agbanwe agbanwe a nke g(x)=f(x)f(x−a) na-aga n'ihu n'ọnụọgụ n'ezie x ọ bụla. Lee azịza Eunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.thinking.0: Ịchọta ihe ngwọta were n'echiche na-ekwughị ya
n-m-h2-limit-10.thinking.1: Ilele ọnọdụ efu site n'ịgbakọ ozugbo
n-m-h2-limit-10.prereq.0: Oke aka ekpe na aka nri na nkwụsi ike
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'ime ngwọta Eunwoo.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.0: Maka ahịrị ọ bụla, chọta ihe ngwọta na-ewere dị ka ihe doro anya banyere ntụpọ abụọ 0 na a.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nwaa uru pụrụ iche nke a ma lelee ma nkwupụta ngwọta ka dị mma.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.0: f(x) adịghị aga n'ihu naanị na x=0, ma f(x−a) adịghị aga n'ihu naanị na x=a.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.1: Ka g gaa n'ihu na x=0, anyị chọrọ f(−a)=0, ya mere a=2 ma ọ bụ a=−2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.2: Ka g gaa n'ihu na x=a, anyị chọrọ f(a)=0, ya mere a=2 ma ọ bụ a=−2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.line.3: Ya mere uru a bụ −2 na 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ mmejọ mbụ. "Ka g gaa n'ihu na x=0, anyị chọrọ f(−a)=0" bụ eziokwu naanị mgbe f(x−a) na-aga n'ihu nso x=0. Ọ bụrụ na a=0, mgbe ahụ f(x−a)=f(x) adịghị aga n'ihu na x=0 kwa, ya mere nkwupụta a adịghị adị. Ahịrị 3 na-eweta otu echiche ahụ, ahịrị 4 bụkwa nsonaazụ.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.prompt: Chọta uru a nke efu n'ngwọta Eunwoo, ma lelee na g na-aga n'ihu n'ezie na uru ahụ site n'iji oke aka ekpe, oke aka nri na uru ọrụ. N'ikpeazụ, dee uru a niile.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.0: Gbajie echiche ahụ otu mpempe n'otu oge: dee nke a na-eme ka 0 na a bụrụ otu ntụpọ.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.hint.1: Maka a ahụ, dee g ọzọ dị ka okwu, ma mgbe ahụ chọta ma tụnyere oke aka ekpe ya, oke aka nri ya, na uru ọrụ ya na x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I dere g dị ka okwu kpọmkwem mgbe a=0?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I chọtara oke aka ekpe, oke aka nri, na uru ọrụ?
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na a=0, ebe abụọ a na-adịghị aga n'ihu na-adaba n'otu ntụpọ x=0, ma g(x)=f(x)·f(x). Na x=0 oke aka ekpe bụ 2²=4, oke aka nri bụ (−2)²=4, ma g(0)=4, ya mere g na-aga n'ihu. Ya mere azịza bụ a=−2, 0, 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s2.model.1: Ngwọta ahụ were na ebe ndị na-adịghị aga n'ihu 0 na a bụ ntụpọ dị iche. Ọ bụrụ na a=0, mgbe ahụ g bụ square nke f(x), ma oke aka ekpe 4, oke aka nri 4, na uru ọrụ 4 hà, ya mere g na-aga n'ihu. Ya mere a=−2, 0, 2.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ ihe kpatara kacha mma g(x)=f(x)f(x) ji aga n'ihu na x=0 mgbe a=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee oke aka ekpe, oke aka nri, na uru ọrụ nke f na x=0.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.hint.1: Gbakọọ ka uru atọ a si agbanwe mgbe ị mere square.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.a: N'ihi na oke aka ekpe na aka nri nke f dị iche naanị n'akara, ya mere ha na-aghọ otu mgbe e mere square
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.a: I ziri ezi na ha dị iche naanị n'akara.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.b: N'ihi na oke aka ekpe na aka nri nke f bụ otu uru
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.b: Na x=0, f nwere oke aka ekpe 2 na oke aka nri −2, ndị dị iche.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.o.d: N'ihi na ime ọrụ ọ bụla square na-eme ka ọ na-aga n'ihu mgbe niile
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.r.d: E nwere ọrụ ndị na-adịghị aga n'ihu mgbe e mere square. Ihe atụ: oke aka ekpe 2, oke aka nri 3.
n-m-h2-limit-10.s.s3.explain: Na x=0, oke aka ekpe nke f bụ 2, oke aka nri bụ −2, ma f(0)=−2. Ime square na-eme ka oke aka ekpe bụrụ 4, oke aka nri 4, na uru ọrụ 4, niile hà, ya mere ọ na-aga n'ihu. Ebe na-adịghị aga n'ihu na-apụ n'ime square naanị mgbe akụkụ abụọ dị iche naanị n'akara.

n-m-h2-limit-11.title: E nwere otu oge na otu ebe? Nsogbu ụzọ ugwu
n-m-h2-limit-11.topic: Oke na nkwụsi ike nke ọrụ: iji Theorem Uru Etiti
n-m-h2-limit-11.goal: Kọwaa n'onwe gị ọrụ ọhụrụ nke na-atụnyere ọnọdụ abụọ, jiri Theorem Uru Etiti gosi na ọ dị, ma lelee ọnọdụ theorem chọrọ (nkwụsi ike).
n-m-h2-limit-11.material: Otu onye na-amalite n'ala ugwu n'elekere 8 nke ụtụtụ ma ruo n'elu ugwu n'elekere 6 nke mgbede site n'otu ụzọ ahụ. Echi ya onye ahụ na-amalite n'elu ugwu n'elekere 8 nke ụtụtụ ma ruo n'ala ugwu n'elekere 6 nke mgbede site n'otu ụzọ ahụ. N'ụbọchị abụọ ahụ, onye ahụ nwere ike izu ike ma ọ bụ gbanwee ọsọ n'ụzọ, ma e nwere naanị otu ụzọ. Ka u(t) bụrụ ọnọdụ n'ụbọchị mbụ n'oge t ma d(t) bụrụ ọnọdụ n'ụbọchị nke abụọ, ebe ọnọdụ bụ ebe dị anya site n'ala ugwu (0 n'ala, D n'elu ugwu). Ọ ga-adị oge onye ahụ nọ n'otu ebe n'ụbọchị abụọ ahụ?
n-m-h2-limit-11.thinking.1: Ide arụmụka site na Theorem Uru Etiti
n-m-h2-limit-11.thinking.2: Ilele nkwubi okwu mgbe ọnọdụ gbajiri
n-m-h2-limit-11.prereq.1: Ahụmahụ nke ilele ọnọdụ dị ka ọrụ nke oge
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.prompt: Ị chọrọ ịtụgharị "otu ebe n'otu oge" ka ọ bụrụ nhata ma jiri Theorem Uru Etiti. Kedu n'ime ndị a bụ ọrụ ọhụrụ kwesịrị ekwesị?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.0: Dee ihe ị chọrọ ịchọta dị ka nhata "u(t) hà d(t)."
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta, n'ime nhọrọ ndị ahụ, ụzọ isi tụgharịa nhata ahụ n'ụdị "ọrụ ụfọdụ = 0."
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.a: Na t=8 na t=18 uru bụ D n'ọnọdụ abụọ, ya mere enweghị mgbanwe akara.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.c: h(t)=0 na-eme mgbe otu n'ime abụọ ahụ bụ 0, nke apụtaghị na ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ hà.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.r.d: E nwere oge d(t)=0, ya mere a kọwaghị ya, ma mgbe ha hà uru bụ naanị 1, ọ bụghị 0.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s1.explain: Otu ebe pụtara u(t)=d(t), ya bụ u(t)−d(t)=0. Ọ bụrụ na anyị tọọ h(t)=u(t)−d(t), mgbe ahụ h(8)=0−D<0 na h(18)=D−0>0, ya mere akara ndị ahụ megidere ibe ha.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.prompt: Jiri h, dee nkọwa ihe mere ọ ga-adị oge onye ahụ nọ n'otu ebe n'ụbọchị abụọ ahụ. Tinye uru h na ngwụcha abụọ nke oke oge, ihe mere h ji bụrụ nke a pụrụ iwere dị ka na-aga n'ihu, na theorem ị na-eji.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.0: Dee uru u na d n'oge mbido na oge ngwụcha, ma chọta uru h.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.hint.1: Iji theorem na h, kwuo n'okwu ka ọnọdụ ga-esi agbanwe n'oge.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: I dere uru ngwụcha abụọ ahụ nke ọma?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I jikọtara ihe kpatara nkwụsi ike na akụkọ ahụ?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.model.0: Ka h(t)=u(t)−d(t). Mgbe ahụ h(8)=0−D=−D<0 na h(18)=D−0=D>0. Onye adịghị agbapụ site n'ebe n'ebe, ya mere ọnọdụ na-agbanwe na-enweghị nkwụsị, u, d, na h na-aga n'ihu. Site na Theorem Uru Etiti e nwere c nke h(c)=0, ma mgbe ahụ u(c)=d(c).
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s2.model.1: Ịtọ h=u−d, ọ bụ uru adịghị mma −D na mbido ma uru dị mma D na ngwụcha. Ọnọdụ na-agbanwe n'oge na-enweghị nkwụsị, ya mere h bụ ọrụ na-aga n'ihu, ma site na Theorem Uru Etiti e nwere c n'etiti 8 na 18 nke h(c)=0, ya mere e nwere oge onye ahụ nọ n'otu ebe n'otu oge.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.prompt: Were ya na n'ụbọchị mbụ onye ahụ jiri ngwaọrụ nke na-agbapụ ya na mberede gaa n'ọnọdụ elu ugwu n'oge ụfọdụ (ya mere ọnọdụ na-agbanwe na nkwụsị). Anyị ka nwere ike ikwu na ọ ga-adị oge n'otu ebe n'otu oge?
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.hint.0: Chee ka eserese h(t) si adị ma ọ bụrụ na ọnọdụ na-awụlikwa.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.hint.1: Chee ma, ọ bụrụ na eserese na-awụlikwa, ọ nwere ike ịgafe 0 na-agafeghị na ya ọbụna mgbe akara ndị dị na ngwụcha abụọ megidere ibe ha.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.a: Ee: n'ihi na akara ndị megidere ibe ha nke h na ngwụcha abụọ ezuola mgbe niile
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.a: Akara naanị ezughị. Ọ bụrụ na nkwụsi ike gbajiri, enweghị ike iji theorem ahụ.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.b: Mba: n'ihi na n'ụbọchị agbapụ, onye ahụ enweghị ike iru otu ebe
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.b: Enweghị ntọala maka ikwu na ha enweghị ike iru otu ebe. Ha nwere ike izute.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.c: Enweghị ike ikwu na ọ ga-adị otu: n'ihi na ọ bụrụ na nkwụsi ike gbajiri, enweghị ike iji Theorem Uru Etiti
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.o.d: Ee: n'ihi na onye ahụ gara ije otu ogologo oge n'ụbọchị abụọ ahụ
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.r.d: Oge e were ịbụ otu enweghị njikọ kpọmkwem na ịdị adị nke otu ebe.
n-m-h2-limit-11.s.s3.explain: Ka theorem ahụ gbaa nkwa, h ga-aga n'ihu. Ọ bụrụ na ọnọdụ na-awụlikwa, h nwere ike ịgafe 0. Dịka ihe atụ, ọ bụrụ na n'ụbọchị mbụ ọnọdụ na-awụli site na 0 gaa D ma n'ụbọchị nke abụọ ọ na-awụli site na D gaa 0 n'otu oge, ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ nwere ike ghara ịhà ma ọlị.

n-m-h2-trig-06.title: Iwu triangle nwere akụkụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na otu akụkụ 60°
n-m-h2-trig-06.goal: Jiri cos60°=1/2 n'iwu nke cosines kwado mmekọrịta n'etiti akụkụ nke triangle nwere akụkụ 60°, wuo triangles ndị na-adịghị otu udi nke ogologo akụkụ ha niile bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu.
n-m-h2-trig-06.material: N'triangle ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB na ∠C=60°. Ị chọrọ iwu triangle nke ogologo akụkụ atọ ya niile bụ ọnụọgụ eke.
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.0: Ịkwado mmekọrịta site n'iwu nke cosines
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.1: Iwu ihe atụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ n'onwe gị
n-m-h2-trig-06.thinking.2: Ịchọpụta ihe atụ dị mfe na ndị yiri ibe ha
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ mmekọrịta ziri ezi n'etiti a, b, c mgbe ∠C=60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee iwu nke cosines dị ka ọ dị, wee tinye ụkpụrụ cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tinye a=b=c=1 (equilateral triangle) n'ntụnyere ọ bụla iji nwalee nke ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.a: N'−2ab cosC nke iwu nke cosines, ị were cos60° dị ka 1. Lelee ọzọ ụkpụrụ cos60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.b: Ede ihe ngosi n'ụzọ megidere. Chee echiche akụkụ ole na-enye ihe ngosi a.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.c: Ị tinyere cos60°=1/2 n'−2ab cosC ma gbakọọ.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.r.d: Ị dere mmekọrịta maka right triangle. Lelee ma ∠C bụ right angle.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s1.explain: Iwu nke cosines bụ c²=a²+b²−2ab cosC na cos60°=1/2, ya mere c²=a²+b²−ab. Ọ bụrụ na ihe ngosi bụ +ab, mgbe ahụ ∠C=120°, ma ọ bụrụ na c²=a²+b², mgbe ahụ ∠C=90°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.prompt: Mee triangles 2 na-adịghị otu udi nwere ∠C=60° na akụkụ atọ niile bụ ọnụọgụ eke (ihe na-adịghị karịa 40), ma tinye a, b, c. (Wepụ equilateral triangle, a na b ga-enweghị ihe nkesa ọnụ ọzọ ma e wezụga 1, ma triangles nke dị iche naanị site n'ịgbanwe a na b ka a na-ewere dị ka otu triangle.)
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu a ma gbanwee b ka ọ bụrụ 1, 2, 3, ... ka ị na-agbakọ a²+b²−ab.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma nsonaazụ ahụ bụ square nke ọnụọgụ eke ụfọdụ.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ atọ ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ eke na-adịghị karịa 40.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Ọnụọgụ atọ ahụ ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ eke site na 1 ruo 40.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c2: c² adịghị hà nhata a²+b²−ab, ya mere ∠C abụghị 60°.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Ọ bụrụ na a=b, triangle bụ equilateral. A na-ewepụ equilateral triangles.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.ok.c4: Naanị ihe nkesa ọnụ nke a na b bụ 1.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.fail.c4: a na b nwere ihe nkesa ọnụ karịrị 1, ya mere nke a bụ triangle yiri ibe ya nke e mere ka ọ bụrụ nke buru ibu site na nke pere mpe.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Dee n'ahịrịokwu otu ma ọ bụ abụọ ka ị chọtara triangle ahụ.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dozie otu ụkpụrụ nke a, wee chee echiche ụkpụrụ ị gbakọrọ ka ị na-agbanwe b.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Kwuo ọnụọgụ ụkpụrụ ahụ ga-abụrịrị iji bụrụ c².
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbakọrọ mgbe ị na-agbanwe a na b?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ lelere ma ụkpụrụ e gbakọrọ bụ perfect square?
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Edoziri m a=3 ma gbakọọ a²+b²−ab ka m na-agbanwe b. Mgbe b=8, ọ bụ 49, ọnụọgụ square. Ya mere c=7.
n-m-h2-trig-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Etinyere m a na b n'usoro n'mmekọrịta c²=a²+b²−ab wee chọọ ikpe ebe nsonaazụ bụ perfect square.

n-m-h2-trig-08.title: Ịdị elu nke ụlọ elu a hụrụ site n'isi ntụ abụọ
n-m-h2-trig-08.goal: Ghọta na inwe akụkụ na anya apụtaghị na e nwere naanị otu ụkpụrụ: rụpụta ntụkwasị abụọ kwere omume site n'ngụkọta, wee dee ọzọ nsogbu ahụ nwere ọnọdụ nke na-edozi naanị otu.
n-m-h2-trig-08.material: Otu ụlọ elu guzoro n'ala dị larịị. Isi ụlọ elu P na isi ntụ A na B dị n'otu ahịrị, ma AB=20 m. Akụkụ nrị elu ruo n'elu ụlọ elu bụ 30° site n'A na 45° site n'B. Leghara ịdị elu anya. Seoyun kwuru, "Anyị nwere akụkụ ndị ahụ na anya, ya mere ịdị elu nke ụlọ elu kpebiri n'otu ụzọ," ma Hajun kwuru, "Enwere ike iche ya n'ụzọ dị iche."
n-m-h2-trig-08.thinking.0: Ikpe azịza ole ozi e nyere na-ekpebi
n-m-h2-trig-08.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ịdị elu na anya n'right triangle
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ikpe ziri ezi banyere nke okwu ya ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sere ntụkwasị niile kwere omume mgbe A, B, na P dị n'otu ahịrị.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.hint.1: N'ntụkwasị ọ bụla, lelee ma ị pụrụ ikwu anya site na P ruo A na site na P ruo B n'ihe gbasara ịdị elu h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.a: Seoyun: E nwere akụkụ nrị elu abụọ na otu anya, ya mere ịdị elu kpebiri n'otu ụzọ n'ezie
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma ọ dị ka e nwere ọtụtụ ozi, ị ga-elele iche ma eserese kpebiri n'otu ụzọ.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.b: Hajun: Anyị amaghị anya ruo isi ụlọ elu, ya mere ịdị elu adịghị akpebi n'ikpe ọ bụla
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.b: Nke a na-agabiga oke na ọ bụghị ihe kpebiri. Gbakọọ ma akụkụ ndị ahụ na-ekwe ka ị belata ya n'otu anya.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.c: Hajun: Ịdị elu dị iche dabere na ma isi ntụ abụọ ahụ dị n'otu akụkụ ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ ndị megidere nke isi ụlọ elu
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.c: Ị chọpụtara na nkwupụta e nyere anaghị ekpebi ntụkwasị n'otu ụzọ.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.o.d: Seoyun: Akụkụ nrị elu abụọ dị iche, ya mere A na B dị n'akụkụ ndị megidere nke isi ụlọ elu n'ezie
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.r.d: Ị kwubiri ọnọdụ site n'eziokwu na akụkụ dị iche. Chee echiche ma, ọbụna n'otu akụkụ, isi ntụ dị nso na-ahụ elu n'akụkụ buru ibu.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ha dị n'otu akụkụ, akụkụ nrị elu site n'isi ntụ dị nso B (45°) buru ibu, ma ọbụna ma ha dị n'akụkụ ndị megidere, a pụrụ inye akụkụ dị ka 30° na 45°. Eserese abụọ kwere omume ma ịdị elu dịkwa iche (agbakọrọ n'ọkwa ọzọ), ya mere nsogbu ga-akọwapụta otu ntụkwasị. Nke ahụ apụtaghị na ngụkọta agaghị ekwe omume. Ozugbo e doziri ntụkwasị, ịdị elu kpebiri.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.prompt: Ka ịdị elu bụrụ h. Chọta ① ịdị elu h1 mgbe A na B dị n'otu akụkụ nke isi P, na ② ịdị elu h2 mgbe P dị n'etiti A na B (akụkụ ndị megidere), ma tinye nke ọ bụla ruo ebe decimal abụọ. (n'm)
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ịdị elu dị ka h ma kwuo PA na PB n'ihe gbasara h site n'iji right triangles.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri eziokwu na ọdịiche nke anya abụọ bụ 20 mgbe ha dị n'otu akụkụ, na nchikota bụ 20 mgbe ha dị n'akụkụ ndị megidere.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.var.h1: Ịdị elu h1 mgbe n'otu akụkụ
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.var.h2: Ịdị elu h2 mgbe n'akụkụ ndị megidere
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c2: N'otu akụkụ, PA−PB=20. Tụọ ntụnyere site na PA=√3·h na PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.fail.c3: N'akụkụ ndị megidere, PA+PB=20. Tụọ ntụnyere site na PA=√3·h na PB=h.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na akụkụ site n'A bụ 30°, PA=h÷tan30°=√3·h, ma ọ bụrụ na akụkụ site n'B bụ 45°, PB=h. N'otu akụkụ, PA−PB=20, ya mere h=20÷(√3−1)=10(√3+1)≈27.32. N'akụkụ ndị megidere, PA+PB=20, ya mere h=20÷(√3+1)=10(√3−1)≈7.32.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.prompt: Dee ọzọ nsogbu a site n'itinye naanị otu ahịrịokwu ka ịdị elu kpebie n'otu ụzọ.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.0: Chetaa ọzọ ntụkwasị kwere omume ole dị.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.hint.1: Dee otu ahịrịokwu na-ahọrọ otu n'ime ha.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gụrụ ahịrịokwu e tinyere iji lelee na ọ na-edozi ntụkwasị n'otu ụzọ?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru mmekọrịta ọnọdụ nke A, B, na P?
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.0: Tinye otu ahịrịokwu na-ekwu na A na B dị n'otu akụkụ nke isi P nke ụlọ elu.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.1: Isi ụlọ elu P dị n'etiti A na B.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.2: Isi ụlọ elu P dị n'ahịrị AB.
n-m-h2-trig-08.s.s3.model.3: A gwara anyị na anya site n'A ruo isi ụlọ elu P bụ 20√3 m.

n-m-h2-integ-06.title: Ichọta ahịrị niile nke na-agbaba otu mpaghara na parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.topic: Mpaghara dị n'etiti parabola na ahịrị: akara na ịkewa nke dị n'elu na nke dị n'okpuru
n-m-h2-integ-06.goal: Ghọta na ị ga-ewepụ okwu dị n'okpuru n'okwu dị n'elu iji nweta mpaghara, na ikpe nke mkpọda na-adịghị mma ga-edozi n'otu ụzọ ahụ, ma chọta ahịrị niile na-emezu ọnọdụ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-06.material: E nwere parabola y=x² na ahịrị y=mx na-agafe isi (m≠0, m bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu). Eserese abụọ ahụ na-ezute na x=0 na x=m. Ka S(m) bụrụ mpaghara nke ebe e kpuchiri.
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.0: Ilele nke dị n'elu na oge, site n'iji eserese
n-m-h2-integ-06.thinking.1: Ilele ntụzịaka nke integral kpọmkwem (oke dị ala, oke dị elu) na akara
n-m-h2-integ-06.prereq.0: Ebe nzute nke parabola na ahịrị
n-m-h2-integ-06.prereq.1: Mpaghara dị n'etiti curves abụọ (okwu dị n'elu − okwu dị n'okpuru)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ okwu integral kpọmkwem ziri ezi maka S(−2) mgbe m=−2.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe m=−2, sere eserese abụọ ahụ ma buru ụzọ debe x-nhazi nke ebe nzute abụọ na eserese nke dị n'elu n'etiti ha.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.hint.1: Chetara ihe na-eme n'uru integral kpọmkwem mgbe oke dị ala karịrị oke dị elu ma ọ bụ mgbe ihe a na-ejikọta adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.a: ∫₀^{−2}(−2x−x²)dx: jikọta site na 0 ruo −2, na-ewepụ okwu dị n'okpuru n'okwu dị n'elu
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.a: Oke dị ala (0) karịrị oke dị elu (−2), yabụ akara uru na-atụgharị. Mpaghara enweghị ike ịbụ nke adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.b: ∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx: jikọta site na −2 ruo 0, na-ewepụ okwu dị n'okpuru n'okwu dị n'elu
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ụdị ziri ezi, na-esi na njedebe aka ekpe gaa njedebe aka nri ma na-ede okwu dị n'elu − okwu dị n'okpuru.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.c: ∫_{−2}^{0}(x²+2x)dx: jikọta site na −2 ruo 0, na-ewepụ okwu ahịrị n'okwu parabola
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.c: N'oge a ahịrị dị n'elu parabola. Ọ bụrụ na ị wepụ okwu dị n'elu n'okwu dị n'okpuru, uru adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.o.d: ∫₀²(−2x−x²)dx: jikọta site na 0 ruo 2, na-ewepụ okwu parabola n'okwu ahịrị
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.r.d: Mgbe m=−2, eserese abụọ ahụ na-ezute na x=0 na x=−2. Oge ahụ anọghị n'akụkụ aka nri nke x-axis.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s1.explain: Mgbe m=−2, eserese abụọ ahụ na-ezute na x=−2 na x=0, ma maka −2<x<0 ahịrị y=−2x dị n'elu parabola y=x². Yabụ S(−2)=∫_{−2}^{0}(−2x−x²)dx=4/3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.prompt: Tinye ọnụọgụ zuru ezu m abụọ dị iche nke S(m)=9/2. (−30≤m≤30, m≠0)
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.0: Mgbe m dị mma, buru ụzọ chọta S(m) dị ka okwu n'm.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.hint.1: Mgbe m adịghị mma, sere eserese ma tụnyere ma ị na-enweta otu okwu.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-abụghị efu n'ime oke.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c1: m ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu na-abụghị efu site na −30 ruo 30.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.fail.c2: S(m) abụghị 9/2. Buru ụzọ chọta S(m) dị ka okwu n'm maka m>0.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na m>0, S(m)=∫₀ᵐ(mx−x²)dx=m³/6. Ọ bụrụ na m<0, ịtụgharị uche banyere symmetry gbasara y-axis na −m=|m|, S(m)=|m|³/6. Yabụ |m|³=27, ya bụ, m=3 ma ọ bụ m=−3.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere nwa akwụkwọ chọtara otu uru na m>0 nwere ike iche na e nwere otu ahịrị ọzọ nwere otu mpaghara.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.0: Sere eserese maka m=3 na m=−3 n'otu ụgbọ elu nhazi ma lee otú ha si jikọta.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.hint.1: Chetara ihe axis nke symmetry nke parabola y=x² bụ.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, Ọ bụrụ na anyị ... ahịrị ahụ, mgbe ahụ ...
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị kwuru ihe na-eme mpaghara mgbe e tụgharịrị eserese gbasara y-axis?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru na mpaghara dị mma ọbụlagodi na akara mkpọda dị iche?
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị tụgharịa udi nke y=x² na ahịrị y=3x kpuchiri gbasara y-axis, ị na-enweta udi nke y=x² na y=−3x kpuchiri. Udi na nha bụ otu, yabụ mpaghara bụ otu, ma m=−3 bụkwa azịza.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.1: Ọbụlagodi na mkpọda adịghị mma, mpaghara dị mma. Uru zuru oke nke m na-ekpebi mpaghara, dị ka |m|³/6, yabụ m=3 na m=−3 na-enye otu mpaghara.
n-m-h2-integ-06.s.s3.model.2: Parabola ahụ na-agbadata gbasara y-axis, yabụ ịgbanwe naanị akara mkpọda ahịrị na-atụgharị udi ahụ aka ekpe gaa aka nri ma na-ahapụ nha ya n'otu ọnọdụ. Yabụ mkpọda adịghị mma −3 nwekwara ike ịbụ.

n-m-h2-trig-01.title: Ịlele azịza chọtara ebe e kpụgharịrị eserese ruo
n-m-h2-trig-01.goal: N'azịza nke na-achọta ebe a kpụgharịrị eserese ụdị y=a sin(bx−c) site na eserese y=a sin bx, chọta ma dozie ahịrị na-ezighi ezi, ma lelee uru e dozichara ozugbo.
n-m-h2-trig-01.material: Jiyun dozie otú eserese y=2sin(3x−π/2) si bụrụ ịkpụgharị nke eserese y=2sin3x, dị ka e dere n'okpuru. (π bụ pi ma akụkụ bụ n'radian. 2sin3x pụtara 2 ugboro sine nke 3x.)
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.0: Ịgbaso azịza ahịrị n'ahịrị iji chọta ahịrị na-ezighi ezi
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.1: Ịkewa ọnụọgụ nke x iji gụọ ịkpụgharị
n-m-h2-trig-01.thinking.2: Ịgbasa okwu e dozichara iji lelee
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.0: Oge na uru kacha elu na kacha nta nke y=a sin bx
n-m-h2-trig-01.prereq.1: Ịkpụgharị eserese n'ntụzịaka x pụtara ịdochi x site n'x−m
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighi ezi n'azịza Jiyun.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee ahịrị n'ahịrị ma ahịrị ọ bụla sitere n'ezie n'ahịrị tupu ya.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.hint.1: Gbasaa okwu a kewara ọzọ site n'iwu nkesa ma tụnyere ya na okwu tupu ikewa.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.1: Uru kacha ukwuu bụ 2, uru kacha nta bụkwa −2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.line.3: Ya mere eserese a bụ eserese y=2sin3x e kwagara site na π/2 n'ntụziaka x.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị nke 3 ezighị ezi. Ịgbasa 3(x−π/2) na-enye 3x−3π/2, nke dị iche na 3x−π/2. Ebe 3x−π/2=3(x−π/6), mkpọpụ ahụ bụ π/6. Ahịrị nke 4 bụ mmechi na-esote nsonaazụ na-ezighị ezi nke ahịrị nke 3, ahịrị nke 1 na nke 2 dịkwa mma.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.prompt: Dozie ahịrị na-ezighị ezi ma dee ntụziaka na ọnụọgụ ziri ezi nke mkpọpụ ahụ, ya na otu ụzọ ị siri lelee na uru ahụ ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.0: Malite site na 3x−π/2, chee ọnụọgụ ga-abịa n'ihu ọnụ ụzọ ka e mepụta x−(mkpọpụ).
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.hint.1: Gbasaa nkwupụta e dere site n'iji mkpọpụ ị chọtara ma lelee na ọ ghọrọ 3x−π/2.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.placeholder: Ọmụmaatụ: ọ bụrụ na ị mee factor 3x−π/2 dịka ..., ị na-enweta ...
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ gbasaara nkwupụta e dozitere n'onwe gị?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ nwere ike ikwu ihe mere e ji ga-eme factor site na 3?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwukwara ntụziaka mkpọpụ ahụ (n'aka nri)?
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.0: N'3x−π/2, buru ụzọ wepụ 3 dịka factor iji nweta 3(x−π/6). Ya mere y=2sin3x kwagara n'aka nri site na π/6. Nlele: ịgbasa 3(x−π/6) na-enye 3x−π/2, otu ihe ahụ na nkwupụta mbụ.
n-m-h2-trig-01.s.s2.model.1: I kwesịrị iwepụ coefficient 3 nke x dịka factor iji nweta udi x−(mkpọpụ). Ebe π/2÷3=π/6, ọ bụ mkpọpụ site na π/6 n'ntụziaka positive nke x. Itinye x=π/6 na-enye 3x−π/2=0, ya mere sin0=0, nke kwekọrọ na y=2sin3x ịbụ 0 na x=0.

n-m-h2-trig-02.title: Kedu oge kacha mkpụmkpụ nke sin²x na-agbanyeghachi?
n-m-h2-trig-02.goal: Nyochaa nkwupụta "oge nke sin x bụ 2π, ya mere sin²x nwekwara oge 2π" site n'ilele nha oge ịgbanyeghachi, ma kwuo oge positive kacha nta na ihe kpatara.
n-m-h2-trig-02.material: Seoyeon kwuru, "Oge nke sin x bụ 2π, ya mere oge nke y=sin²x bụkwa 2π," Minho kwukwara, "Nke ahụ abụghị oge kacha mkpụmkpụ." Ebe a, oge pụtara p positive kacha nta nke f(x+p)=f(x) na-ejide maka x niile. (sin²x bụ square nke sin x.)
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.0: Ịkewa oge ịgbanyeghachi na oge kacha nta
n-m-h2-trig-02.thinking.2: Ịtụle nkwupụta site n'inye ihe kpatara
n-m-h2-trig-02.prereq.0: Periodic functions na ihe oge pụtara
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta niile ziri ezi banyere f(x)=sin²x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.0: N'nkwupụta ọ bụla, tinye uru doro anya dịka 0 ma ọ bụ π/2 maka x ma tụnyere ma akụkụ abụọ hà nhata.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.hint.1: Buru ụzọ dee otu sin(x+π) si jikọta na sin x, mgbe ahụ lelee ihe na-eme mgbe ị were square.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.a: Oge nke sin x bụ 2π, ya mere oge kacha mkpụmkpụ nke sin²x na-agbanyeghachi ga-abụkwa 2π
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-ewere oge nke function mbụ dịka oge kacha mkpụmkpụ nke nke ọhụrụ. Lelee na iwere square na-ewepụ ihe ịrịba ama.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.b: Maka x niile, sin²(x+π)=sin²x, ya mere mgbe e kwagara site na π eserese na-agbanyeghachi n'otu udi
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ ikpe e mere mgbe e dere otu sin(x+π) si jikọta na sin x ma lelee nsonaazụ e weere square.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.c: Maka x niile, sin²(x+π/2)=sin²x, ya mere mgbe e kwagara site na π/2 eserese na-agbanyeghachi n'otu udi
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.c: Ị lelebeghị site n'itinye uru doro anya maka x. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, gbakọọ akụkụ abụọ na x=0.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.o.d: Maka x niile, sin²(x+2π)=sin²x, ya mere mgbe e kwagara site na 2π eserese na-agbanyeghachi n'otu udi
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.r.d: Ị hapụghị na 2π bụkwa oge ịgbanyeghachi. Ma ma ọ bụ nke kacha mkpụmkpụ ka a ga-enyocha n'iche.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s1.explain: sin(x+π)=−sin x, ya mere sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Ya mere π bụkwa oge ịgbanyeghachi, 2π, okpukpu abụọ nke π, bụkwa otu. Ma na x=0, sin²0=0, na sin²(π/2)=1, ya mere π/2 abụghị oge ịgbanyeghachi. 2π bụ oge ịgbanyeghachi ma ọ bụghị nke kacha mkpụmkpụ.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.prompt: Dee oge positive kacha nta nke y=sin²x, kọwaakwa site na ihe kpatara ihe na-efu n'nkwupụta Seoyeon. (Ihe kpatara: opekata mpe otu n'idegharị nkwupụta ma ọ bụ uru eserese)
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.0: Gbakọọ uru sin²x na x=0 na x=π/2, ma chọta oge uru ndị ahụ na-aghọ hà nhata.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chetakwa ma ị nwere ike idegharị sin²x dịka nkwupụta nwere cos2x.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.placeholder: Ọmụmaatụ: oge positive kacha nta nke y=sin²x bụ ... n'ihi na ...
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ degharịrị nkwupụta dịka sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 ma ọ bụ tinye uru x ozugbo?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na 2π bụ oge ịgbanyeghachi ma ọ bụghị nke kacha mkpụmkpụ?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ debere n'ihe okwu "kacha nta" pụtara?
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.0: sin²x=(1−cos2x)/2 oge nke cos2x bụkwa π, ya mere oge nke sin²x bụ π. 2π nke Seoyeon na-enyekwa otu uru mgbe e kwagara ruo ebe ahụ, ma ọ bụghị oge kacha nta.
n-m-h2-trig-02.s.s2.model.1: sin(x+π)=−sin x, ya mere iwere square na-enye sin²(x+π)=sin²x. Ya mere oge kacha nta bụ opekata mpe π, oghere dị n'etiti x=π/2 na 3π/2, ebe sin²x bụ 1, bụkwa π, ya mere π bụ nke kacha nta. 2π bụ oge ịgbanyeghachi, ma ọ bụghị nke kacha nta.

n-m-h2-trig-03.title: Ọ bụrụ na tan(α+β)=1, kedu α+β?
n-m-h2-trig-03.goal: Soro otu ikpe na uru tan otu ọ naanị dị ka ọ na-ekpebi akụkụ si agbanwe mgbe ozi banyere oke akụkụ bịara, kọwaakwa ihe mere.
n-m-h2-trig-03.material: Maka akụkụ α na β, tanα=1/2 na tanβ=1/3. A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu, ya mere kpee ikpe site n'iji naanị ihe a maara ruo ugbu a. (tan(α+β) bụ (tanα+tanβ)÷(1−tanα·tanβ).)
n-m-h2-trig-03.thinking.2: Iji uru trigonometric na oke akụkụ ọnụ
n-m-h2-trig-03.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti akụkụ nwere otu uru tan (oge π)
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.prompt: A na-ekpughe ozi otu otu. N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, họrọ ikpe site n'iji naanị ozi ruo ugbu a.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, buru ụzọ dee oke α+β nwere ike ịdị n'ime ya.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.hint.1: Gụọ akụkụ ole nwere uru tan 1 dị n'oke ahụ.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Numerator bụ 1/2+1/3=5/6 denominator bụkwa 1−1/6=5/6, ya mere tan(α+β)=1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Nke a na-ewere nchikota nke tans dịka tan nke nchikota. Lelee ọzọ otu e si ede denominator nke usoro mgbakwunye.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Lelee site n'udi usoro mgbakwunye ebe e ji ngwaahịa.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ị tinyere uru ndị ahụ ozugbo n'usoro ma gbakọọ numerator 5/6 na denominator 1−1/6=5/6.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.info: α na β abụọ bụ akụkụ acute (karịrị 0° ma dị ala karịa 90°).
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Nchikota nke akụkụ acute abụọ karịrị 0° ma dị ala karịa 180°. N'oke a, 45° bụ naanị akụkụ nwere uru tan 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị jiri na nchikota dị n'etiti 0° na 180° na n'ime ya e nwere kpọmkwem otu akụkụ nwere uru tan 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ị chere na α+β nwere ike karịa 180°. Chọpụta oke nchikota nke akụkụ acute abụọ.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ nwere ike ịbụ 45° ma ọ bụ 225°
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ọ bụ eziokwu na e nwere ọtụtụ akụkụ nwere otu uru tan, ma ị jighị oke e nyere.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Ọnọdụ agbanwela. tanα=1/2 na tanβ=1/3 na-anọgide otu, α bụ akụkụ n'ụzọ anọ nke atọ (karịrị 180° ma dị ala karịa 270°), β bụkwa acute.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.after: α+β karịrị 180° ma dị ala karịa 360°. N'oke a, 225° bụ naanị akụkụ nwere tan 1. Ọbụlagodi maka otu uru tan, azịza na-agbanwe mgbe oke akụkụ gbanwere.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ị lere naanị uru tan ịbụ 1 ma jiri akụkụ site na mbụ ọzọ.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ọ dị ka ị na-eche na, n'ihi na oke gbanwere, enweghị ike ikpebi ya. Gụọ akụkụ ole n'oke ọhụrụ nwere tan 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ị chọtara akụkụ nwere tan 1 n'oke ọhụrụ 180°<α+β<360°.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s1.reflect: Uru tan(α+β)=1 bụ otu, ma dabere n'ozi banyere oke akụkụ ọ ghọrọ 45° n'otu ikpe na 225° n'nke ọzọ. A naghị ekpebi akụkụ site n'uru trigonometric function naanị; a chọkwara oke akụkụ.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere ịmara tan(α+β)=1 anaghị ekpebi α+β naanị otu, na ihe ozi banyere oke akụkụ na-eme.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta ma dee akụkụ ọzọ ọ bụghị 45° nke uru tan ya bụ 1.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tụnyere ọnụọgụ akụkụ ndị a na-atụ anya n'enweghị ozi oke na nke nwere ya.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.placeholder: Ọmụmaatụ: akụkụ nwere otu uru tan bụ ... Ọ bụrụ na e nwere oke, ...
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ nyere ọmụmaatụ nke akụkụ nwere otu uru tan (45° na 225°)?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru otu oke si ebelata ndị a na-atụ anya ruo otu?
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.0: Akụkụ nwere uru tan 1 abụghị naanị 45° kama ha na-agbanyeghachi n'ọ bụla 180°, dịka 225°, ya mere a naghị ekpebi akụkụ ahụ naanị otu. Ọ bụrụ na e nwere oke, dịka acute ma ọ bụ n'ụzọ anọ nke atọ, naanị otu onye a na-atụ anya fọdụrụ n'ime ya.
n-m-h2-trig-03.s.s2.model.1: tan na-enye otu uru n'oge 180°, ya mere site n'uru 1 naanị ị pụghị ịmata ma ọ bụ 45° ka ọ bụ 225°. Ị chọrọ ịmara oke akụkụ ahụ dị n'ime ya iji họrọ otu n'ime abụọ ahụ.

n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.2: Iwulite ọtụtụ ihe atụ na-agbaso ọnọdụ
n-m-h2-trig-04.title: Ịchọta ogologo akụkụ atọ na-eme triangle obtuse
n-m-h2-trig-04.goal: Jiri iwu cosines dee ọnọdụ ka akụkụ megidere akụkụ kacha ogologo bụrụ obtuse, ma lelekwa ọnọdụ ka triangle dị n'ezie, wuekwa triangles obtuse dị iche iche.
n-m-h2-trig-04.material: Ị chọrọ ime triangle obtuse nke ogologo akụkụ atọ ya niile bụ ọnụọgụ okike. Ka c bụrụ ogologo akụkụ kacha ogologo, a na b bụrụ akụkụ abụọ ndị ọzọ, jirikwa iwu cosines nyochaa ihe ịrịba ama nke cosC=(a²+b²−c²)÷(2ab), cosine nke akụkụ C megidere c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.0: Iji ihe ịrịba ama site n'iwu cosines ịkọwa ụdị akụkụ
n-m-h2-trig-04.thinking.1: Ịlele ọnọdụ zoro ezo (ịdị nke triangle)
n-m-h2-trig-04.prereq.1: Ọnọdụ maka ịmepụta triangle site n'ogologo akụkụ atọ
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.prompt: Minsu kwuru, "Ọ bụrụ na a=3, b=4, c=9, mgbe ahụ c²=81 karịrị a²+b²=25, ya mere cosC<0, ma e nwere triangle obtuse nwere akụkụ 3, 4, 9." Kedu ka ị si ekpe nkwupụta a ikpe?
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.0: Chee ma ị nwere ike ime triangle site n'osisi atọ ogologo 3, 4, na 9.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.hint.1: Gbakọọ n'ezie uru cosC ma tụnyere ya na oke uru cosine nwere ike inwe.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.a: Ziri ezi. 9²>3²+4², ya mere akụkụ megidere akụkụ kacha ogologo bụ obtuse
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.a: Ị lere naanị ihe ịrịba ama nke uru cosine ma lelee ma triangle nwere ike ịdị n'ezie.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.b: Ezighị ezi. 3+4<9, ya mere enweghị ike ịmepụta triangle site n'akụkụ ogologo ndị a
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.b: Tupu ị chọta uru cosine, ị buru ụzọ lelee ma akụkụ atọ ahụ na-eme triangle.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.c: Ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na 9²>3²+4², akụkụ megidere akụkụ kacha ogologo bụ right angle
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.c: Ị gwakọtara ikpe right angle na ikpe obtuse angle. Maka 3, 4, 5, tụnyere 5² na 3²+4².
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.o.d: Ziri ezi. 3, 4, 9 bụ ogologo dị iche, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịbụ triangle obtuse
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo ndị dị iche enweghị mmekọrịta na ma triangle dị.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s1.explain: cosC=(9+16−81)÷24 hà −56÷24<−1, ya mere ọ pụghị ịbụ uru cosine. Nke a bụ n'ihi na 3+4<9, ya mere akụkụ atọ ahụ anaghị eme triangle. Maka obtuse angle, square nke akụkụ kacha ogologo ga-akarịrị nchikota squares nke abụọ ndị ọzọ, n'otu oge ahụ akụkụ kacha ogologo ga-adị ala karịa nchikota abụọ ndị ọzọ.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.prompt: Chọta triangles obtuse 3 dị iche nke ogologo akụkụ ha niile bụ ọnụọgụ okike 20 ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị ma tinye ogologo akụkụ atọ. (A na-ewere triangles dị iche naanị n'usoro dịka otu triangle.)
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ họrọ akụkụ kacha ogologo c, mgbe ahụ họrọ a na b n'oke ebe a+b karịrị c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.hint.1: Maka ọnụọgụ atọ ị họrọ, gbakọọ c² na a²+b² ma tụnyere ha, tụnyekwa a+b na c.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Ọnụọgụ atọ ahụ bụ ọnụọgụ okike site na 1 ruo 20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ọnụọgụ atọ ahụ ga-abụ ọnụọgụ okike site na 1 ruo 20.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Akụkụ kacha ogologo dị mkpụmkpụ karịa nchikota abụọ ndị ọzọ, ya mere a na-emepụta triangle.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Akụkụ kacha ogologo bụ opekata mpe nchikota abụọ ndị ọzọ, ya mere a naghị emepụta triangle.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Square nke akụkụ kacha ogologo karịrị nchikota squares nke abụọ ndị ọzọ, ya mere ọ bụ triangle obtuse.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Square nke akụkụ kacha ogologo adịghị karịa nchikota squares nke abụọ ndị ọzọ, ya mere ọ bụghị triangle obtuse.
n-m-h2-trig-04.s.s2.explain: (3, 4, 6) nwere 6²=36>3²+4²=25 na 3+4>6. (4, 5, 8) nwere 64>41 na 9>8, (5, 6, 10) nwekwara 100>61 na 11>10. (3, 4, 9) na-emezu ọnọdụ square ma 3+4<9, ya mere ọ bụghị triangle.

n-m-h2-trig-05.title: Gịnị ka ị chọrọ ịmata iji chọta radius nke circumscribed circle?
n-m-h2-trig-05.goal: Kewaa ma triangle ka akọwapụtara naanị otu site na ma uru ị chọrọ ka akọwapụtara naanị otu, họpụta ozi na-ekpebi radius nke circumscribed circle, kọwaakwa ihe mere.
n-m-h2-trig-05.material: N'triangle ABC, a=BC, b=CA, c=AB, A, B, C bụkwa akụkụ n'ọnụ. Ị chọrọ ịmata radius R nke circumscribed circle. A na-enye ozi ọ bụla dịka ọnụọgụ doro anya, a na-ewerekwa na triangle dị otú ahụ dị n'ezie.
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.0: Ịhọpụta ozi dị mkpa maka uru ịchọrọ
n-m-h2-trig-05.thinking.2: Ịhụ na uru nwere ike ịbụ otu ọbụlagodi ma triangles abụọ dị
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ikpe niile n'ime ndị a ebe ozi ahụ naanị na-ekpebi uru R naanị otu.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.0: N'iwu sines a/sinA=b/sinB=c/sinC=2R, dee nkwupụta ị na-enweta ma e nwere opekata mpe otu ụzọ nke akụkụ na akụkụ megidere ya.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ozi ọ bụla, lelee ma e nwere ụzọ nke akụkụ na akụkụ kwekọrọ, ọ bụrụkwa na ọ dịghị, ma a pụrụ ime otu site n'iwu cosines.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.a: Nha akụkụ atọ A, B, C
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.a: Chee eziokwu na akụkụ atọ naanị na-enye triangles yiri ibe ha dị iche iche nke nha dị iche enweghị nsọtụ.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.b: Ogologo otu akụkụ a na nha akụkụ megidere ya A
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.b: Ikpe a na-ejide na otu ụzọ site n'iwu sines (akụkụ na akụkụ megidere ya) zuru ezu iji chọta R.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.c: Ogologo akụkụ abụọ a, b na nha akụkụ A
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọbụlagodi n'ozi na-enye ohere maka triangles abụọ, ị lelere n'iche ma a kpebiri R. Lelee ma ozi a nwere ụzọ nke akụkụ na akụkụ megidere ya.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.d: Ogologo otu akụkụ a na nha otu akụkụ dị nso B
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.d: Chee eziokwu na a pụrụ ịgbanwe akụkụ fọdụrụ C n'efu, ya mere R na-agbanwekwa.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.o.e: Ogologo akụkụ abụọ a, b na nha akụkụ dị n'etiti C
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.r.e: Ị jiri eziokwu na ịchọta akụkụ nke atọ site n'iwu cosines na-emepụta ụzọ nke akụkụ na akụkụ megidere ya.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s1.explain: Maka b, R si ozugbo n'a/sinA=2R. c bụ otu na b, n'ihi na a na A bụ ụzọ kwekọrọ. Ọbụlagodi ma a pụrụ ịmepụta triangles abụọ, a/sinA bụ otu, ya mere R bụ otu uru. Maka e, chọta c site n'iwu cosines mgbe ahụ jiri c/sinC=2R. Maka a, ịmara naanị akụkụ atọ na-enye ọtụtụ triangles yiri ibe ha nke nha dị iche, ya mere a kpebighị R, ma maka d, R na-agbanwe mgbe C gbanwere.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.prompt: Nhọrọ "a, b na akụkụ A" bụ ozi nwere ike inye triangles abụọ, ma a kpebiri R naanị otu. Kọwaa ihe mere.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.hint.0: Dee iwu sines ma gụọ mkpụrụedemede ndị metụtara ịchọta R.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ịgbado ụkwụ na triangles abụọ, tụnyere ma a na A bụ otu ma ọ bụ dị iche.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ dere okwu na-edozi a/sinA=2R maka R?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na ejighị b chọta R?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ kwuru na a na A bụ otu ọbụna n'triangles abụọ?
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.model.0: Site n'iwu nke sines a/sinA=2R, R=a/(2sinA). Nke a na-eji naanị a na A ọ bụghị b, ya mere ọbụna ma e guzobere triangles abụọ, a na A bụ otu ma ya mere R bụkwa otu.
n-m-h2-trig-05.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere akụkụ a na akụkụ ya megidere A, iwu nke sines na-enye ozugbo 2R=a/sinA. Ọbụna ma akụkụ nke atọ ma ọ bụ akụkụ ndị ọzọ dị iche n'triangles abụọ ahụ, ụkpụrụ a bụ otu, ya mere R kpebiri n'otu ụzọ.

n-m-h2-trig-07.title: Inyere Harin aka n'ngwọta sin75°
n-m-h2-trig-07.goal: Chọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta enyi nke na-ejighị nke ọma usoro mgbakwunye, họrọ ihe ngosi na-egosi na nsonaazụ enweghị ike ịdị, ma dee ozi nke ga-eme ka enyi dozie n'onwe ya.
n-m-h2-trig-07.material: Harin nwara ichọta sin75° site n'idee 75°=45°+30° ma dozie ya dị ka egosiri n'okpuru. (√2 pụtara square root nke 2.) Harin bụ enyi gị.
n-m-h2-trig-07.thinking.0: Ichọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta
n-m-h2-trig-07.thinking.1: Ịhụ njehie site n'oke nke nsonaazụ
n-m-h2-trig-07.thinking.2: Idee ozi ị ga-ezigara enyi gị
n-m-h2-trig-07.prereq.0: Usoro mgbakwunye maka sine na cosine
n-m-h2-trig-07.prereq.1: Ụkpụrụ nke sin45°, sin30°, cos45°, cos30°
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ n'ngwọta Harin nke ezighị ezi.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ ahịrị ọ bụla n'usoro ma lelee ma ọ n'ezie sitere n'ahịrị gara aga.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nwalee usoro nke ahịrị ọ bụla otu n'otu site n'itinye akụkụ dị mfe dị ka A=B=30°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.line.3: Ya mere sin75° bụ ihe dị ka 1.207.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 ezighị ezi. Usoro mgbakwunye maka sine bụ sin(A+B)=sinA cosB+cosA sinB. Ahịrị 3 na 4 bụ ngụkọta na-esochi usoro na-ezighị ezi, ụkpụrụ sin45° na sin30° n'onwe ha dị mma.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.prompt: Ọbụna ma ịmaghị usoro mgbakwunye ziri ezi, kedu ihe ngosi na-agwa gị ozugbo na nsonaazụ Harin ezighị ezi?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chetara oke nke ụkpụrụ sin nwere ike iwere.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tụọ ụkpụrụ Harin dị ka decimal ma tụnyere ya na oke ahụ.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.a: 75° bụ acute angle, ya mere sin75° ga-erughị sin30°=1/2
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.a: Nke a na-ewere na sine na-ebelata naanị n'acute angles. Tụnyere ụkpụrụ sine nke 30° na 75°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.b: Ụkpụrụ sine enweghị ike karịa 1, mana nsonaazụ (√2+1)/2 buru ibu karịa 1
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.b: Ị tụnyere nsonaazụ e gbakọrọ na oke nke ụkpụrụ sine, site na −1 ruo 1 gụnyere ha.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.c: √2/2+1/2 bụ irrational, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịbụ ụkpụrụ sin75°
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.c: Nke a na-ewere na ụkpụrụ enweghị ike ịbụ ụkpụrụ sine naanị n'ihi na ọ bụ irrational. sin45°=√2/2 bụkwa irrational.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.o.d: Sine nke 45° na sine nke 30° enweghị ike ịgbakwunye ibe ha
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.r.d: Nke a na-ewere na ịgbakwunye ha n'onwe ya bụ ihe e machibidoro. Enweghị ihe kpatara na enweghị ike ịgbakwunye ha. Ị ga-ekpe ikpe site n'nsonaazụ.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s2.explain: (√2+1)/2 bụ ihe dị ka 1.207, nke buru ibu karịa 1. Ụkpụrụ sine dị n'etiti −1 na 1 gụnyere ha, ya mere ngụkọta ahụ ga-abụrịrị na ọ na-ezighị ezi ebe ụfọdụ. Ọbụna n'amaghị usoro ahụ, ị pụrụ ịhụ njehie site n'oke nke ụkpụrụ naanị. Usoro ziri ezi bụ sin75°=sin45°cos30°+cos45°sin30°.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.prompt: Dee ozi ị ga-ezigara Harin. Tinye ① akụkụ nke ngwọta bụ nsogbu na ② otu ụzọ Harin nwere ike isi lelee n'onwe ya, mana ③ ede ụkpụrụ sin75° e mechara.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.hint.0: Malite site n'ichọta otu ihe Harin mere nke ọma ma kwenye ya.
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.hint.1: Mgbe ahụ dee otu omume Harin nwere ike ịnwale ozugbo (ilele oke nke ụkpụrụ, itinye akụkụ dị mfe, wdg).
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwenyere ihe Harin mere nke ọma (ịkewa n'45° na 30°)?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ọ̀ doro anya omume Harin kwesịrị ịnwale?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ị̀ zere inye ụkpụrụ e mechara?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.model.0: Ịkewa ya n'45°+30° bụ echiche dị mma. Ma usoro mgbakwunye n'ahịrị 2 bụ nsogbu. Ị nwetara ihe dị ka 1.2, mana ụkpụrụ sine enweghị ike karịa 1, ya mere lelee nke ahụ. Gịnị mere na ị anwalaghị ma usoro ahụ ziri ezi site n'itinye ụkpụrụ dị ka A=B=30°?
n-m-h2-trig-07.s.s3.model.1: Ị mere nke ọma ịkewa 75° n'45° na 30°. Mana usoro na-asị sin(A+B) hà nhata sinA+sinB dị ka ihe dị egwu. Nsonaazụ ekwesịghị ịbụ nke ka 1, ya mere biko lelee ọzọ usoro mgbakwunye maka sine n'akwụkwọ gị.

n-m-h2-trig-09.thinking.0: Ichọta ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta
n-m-h2-trig-09.title: Ilele ngwọta kacha ukwuu n'oge e nyere
n-m-h2-trig-09.goal: Chọta na ngwọta jiri njikọta nke trigonometric functions ịnweta kacha ukwuu ejighị oke nke x, wee lelee ngwụcha nke oge ahụ ichọta kacha ukwuu ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-trig-09.material: Hyunwoo chọtara kacha ukwuu nke y=3sinx+4cosx maka 0≤x≤π/6 dị ka egosiri n'okpuru. (Akụkụ dị n'radians. α bụ acute angle nwere cosα=3/5 na sinα=4/5, α bụkwa ihe dị ka 0.93.)
n-m-h2-trig-09.thinking.1: Ilele ma kacha ukwuu ahụ n'ezie na-apụta n'ime oge ahụ
n-m-h2-trig-09.thinking.2: Ịgbakọ ụkpụrụ n'ngwụcha nke oge ahụ
n-m-h2-trig-09.prereq.1: Omume ịbawanye na ibelata nke sine function
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ n'ngwọta Hyunwoo nke ezighị ezi.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.hint.0: Lelee n'ahịrịokwu n'ọnọdụ ole kacha ukwuu n'ahịrị 2 sitere.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ka kacha ukwuu bụrụ 5, ịchọrọ x nke sin(x+α) bụ 1. Chee echiche ma x ahụ dị n'oge nke nsogbu ahụ.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.line.1: Ọ bụrụ na x bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie ọ bụla, kacha ukwuu nke sin(x+α) bụ 1, ya mere kacha ukwuu nke y bụ 5.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.line.2: Ya mere kacha ukwuu n'0≤x≤π/6 bụkwa 5.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.line.3: Nke a bụ n'ihi na sin(x+α)=1 nwere ike ime n'ime oge ahụ kwa.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 ezighị ezi. 5 n'ahịrị 2 bụ kacha ukwuu mgbe x bụ ọnụọgụ n'ezie ọ bụla. Ka sin(x+α)=1, anyị chọrọ x=π/2−α (ihe dị ka 0.64), nke buru ibu karịa π/6 (ihe dị ka 0.52), ya mere ọ dị n'èzí oge ahụ. Ahịrị 4 bụ ihe kpatara ezighị ezi maka ahịrị 3.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.prompt: Chọta kacha ukwuu nke y n'0≤x≤π/6, dekwa ihe mere 5 Hyunwoo enweghị ike ịpụta n'oge a.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.hint.0: Chọta x nke sin(x+α)=1 ma tụnyere ya na oge nke nsogbu ahụ.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ka x+α si agbanwe n'oge ahụ (ma ọ na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata) ma kpebie ebe kacha ukwuu na-apụta.
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.placeholder: dịka. x nke sin(x+α)=1 bụ ... ya mere kacha ukwuu bụ ...
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị lelere ma x na-enye max ọ̀ dị n’ime interval?
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị gbakọrọ uru n’ọnụ njedebe interval ozugbo?
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ị kwuru otú x+α si agbanwe n’ime interval?
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.model.0: x nke sin(x+α)=1 bụ π/2−α (ihe dịka 0.64), nke karịrị π/6 (ihe dịka 0.52), ya mere ọ dị n’èzí interval. N’ime interval y na-abawanye, ya mere max dị na x=π/6, ọ bụkwa 3·1/2+4·√3/2=3/2+2√3 (ihe dịka 4.96).
n-m-h2-trig-09.s.s2.model.1: x+α na-esi na α (ihe dịka 0.93) ruo π/6+α (ihe dịka 1.45), na-anọghị karịa π/2, ya mere ọ na-abawanye mgbe niile. Max dị na njedebe x=π/6, ebe y=(3+4√3)/2≈4.96. Iji nweta 5, x ga-adị n’èzí interval, ya mere 5 agaghị ekwe omume.

n-m-h2-integ-02.prereq.0: Integral na-enweghị oke nke ọrụ polynomial
n-m-h2-integ-02.title: Ilele ngwọta Jimin maka derivative e nyere dịka ngwaahịa
n-m-h2-integ-02.topic: Indefinite integrals: ijikọta ngwaahịa na constant of integration
n-m-h2-integ-02.goal: Chọta ahịrị na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta nke weghachiri function mbụ site na derivative e nyere dịka ngwaahịa, ma dozie ya nke ọma site n'ilele na ịdị iche nke nsonaazụ na-eweghachi gị.
n-m-h2-integ-02.material: Nke a bụ ngwọta Jimin maka ịchọta uru f(1) mgbe f'(x)=(x+1)(x+2) na f(0)=2. (A na-agụ f' dịka "f prime," C bụkwa constant of integration.)
n-m-h2-integ-02.thinking.0: Ịlele ma ahịrị ọ bụla bụ otu nkwupụta na ahịrị tupu ya
n-m-h2-integ-02.thinking.1: Ịnwale iwu na nkwupụta dị mfe
n-m-h2-integ-02.prereq.1: Ikpebi constant of integration site n'ọnọdụ mmalite
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrị mbụ na-ezighị ezi n'ngwọta Jimin.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nwalee ma nkwupụta tupu na mgbe mgbanwe ọ bụla bụ otu n'ezie site n'iji otu ụzọ ahụ na nkwupụta dị mfe nke ukwuu.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.hint.1: Lelee ma ịdị iche nsonaazụ ahịrị ọ bụla n'ihe gbasara x na-enye azụ integrand nke ahịrị tupu ya.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 bụ nke mbụ na-ezighị ezi. Indefinite integral nke ngwaahịa adịghị hà ngwaahịa nke indefinite integrals dị iche. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ∫x·x dx=x³/3, ma ∫x dx × ∫x dx=x⁴/4. Mgbe ọ bụ ngwaahịa, ị ga-ebu ụzọ gbasaa ya. Ebe (x+1)(x+2)=x²+3x+2, f(x)=x³/3+3x²/2+2x+C, f(0)=2 na-enye C=2, f(1)=1/3+3/2+2+2=35/6.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.prompt: Mgbe ị gụsịrị ngwọta, kedu nlele kacha dị ozugbo iji jide njehie dị otú a n'onwe gị?
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.hint.0: Chee ma nlele ọ bụla nwere ike ijide ngwọta na-ezighị ezi, ma họpụta nlele ọ bụla na-apụta ziri ezi mgbe niile ọbụlagodi maka ngwọta na-ezighị ezi.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chetakwa mmekọrịta dị n'etiti indefinite integrals na ịdị iche.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.a: Tinye f(0)=2 n'f(x) ị chọtara ma lelee na ị na-enweta 2 n'ezie
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.a: Ebe a kpebiri constant of integration C site n'ọnọdụ a, ọ na-apụta ziri ezi mgbe niile. Nlele a anaghị ejide njehie n'ijikọta ngwaahịa.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.b: Mee f(x) ị chọtara ka ọ dị iche n'ihe gbasara x ma lelee na f'(x)=(x+1)(x+2)
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.b: Nlele a na-eji eziokwu na ịdị iche nke nsonaazụ integral ga-eweghachi nkwupụta mbụ.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.c: Lelee na constant of integration C jikọtara n'nsonaazụ ahụ, ahapụghịkwa ya
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.c: E tinyere C. Nsogbu nke ngwọta a abụghị constant ahụ kama ụzọ e si ejikọta.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.o.d: Gbakọọ uru f(1) ọzọ otu ugboro site na calculator ma lelee na ị na-enweta otu uru
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.r.d: Ịgbakọ otu nkwupụta ọzọ na-enye otu uru; ọ naghị elele ma nkwupụta n'onwe ya ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s2.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị mee f(x)=(x²/2+x)(x²/2+2x)+C ị chọtara ka ọ dị iche, ị naghị enweta (x+1)(x+2), n'ihi iwu ngwaahịa nke ịdị iche. Ilele ma ịdị iche na-eweghachi gị n'derivative mbụ bụ ụzọ kacha dị ozugbo ilele indefinite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.prompt: Chọta uru f(1) site n'ngwọta ziri ezi, gosikwa site n'otu nkwupụta dị mfe na ahịrị nke abụọ nke Jimin adịghị eguzosi.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ọ bụrụ na ọ siri ike ijikọta ngwaahịa dịka ọ dị, chee udi ị ga-eme ka ngwaahịa ahụ ghọọ ka ị nwee ike ijikọta okwu otu otu.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.hint.1: Jiri ụzọ Jimin na ngwaahịa dị mfe nke ukwuu dịka x×x ma tụnyere ya na integral ziri ezi.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Buru ụzọ, ọ bụrụ na ị ..., mgbe ahụ f(1)=... . Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ...
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: N'nkwupụta dị mfe (dịka x×x), ị̀ gosiri site n'usoro na mgbakọ abụọ ahụ na-enye nsonaazụ dị iche?
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mgbe ị chọtara azịza, ị̀ lelere na ịdị iche na-eweghachi gị n'derivative?
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.model.0: Gbasaa (x+1)(x+2) ka ọ bụrụ x²+3x+2 ma jikọta iji nweta f(x)=x³/3+3x²/2+2x+C. Ebe f(0)=2, C=2, ya mere f(1)=35/6. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ∫x·x dx bụ x³/3, ma ∫x dx × ∫x dx bụ x⁴/4, ya mere integral nke ngwaahịa adịghị hà ngwaahịa nke integrals.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.model.1: f(1)=35/6. Ị ga-ebu ụzọ gbasaa ngwaahịa ahụ ma jikọta okwu otu otu. Ihe mere i kwesịghị imụba integrals dị iche bụ na maka x na x, otu akụkụ na-enye x³/3 nke ọzọ na-enye x⁴/4, nke dị iche.
n-m-h2-integ-02.s.s3.model.2: Ịgbasa na ijikọta x²+3x+2 na-enye x³/3+(3/2)x²+2x+C. Ebe C=2, f(1)=35/6. Iji ngwaahịa nke integrals dochie integral nke ngwaahịa na-agbanwe degree ugbu a, ya mere ọ na-ezighị ezi (dịka, x·x).

n-m-h2-integ-05.thinking.2: Iwu ọtụtụ ihe atụ na-emezu ọnọdụ ndị ahụ
n-m-h2-integ-05.title: Anyị ọ̀ nwere ike ịchọta ọnọdụ site na acceleration naanị?
n-m-h2-integ-05.topic: Indefinite integrals na constants of integration: site na acceleration ruo ọnọdụ
n-m-h2-integ-05.goal: Kpee ikpe na mgbe ọ bụla ị na-ejikọta site na acceleration ruo ọsọ na site na ọsọ ruo ọnọdụ, otu constant of integration na-apụta, ya mere a chọrọ ozi abụọ iji doo ọnọdụ anya, ma wue mmegharị dị iche iche na-enye otu ọnọdụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.material: Acceleration nke ebe P na-aga n'ahịrị ọnụọgụ n'oge t (sekọnd) bụ a(t)=6t−4. Anyị chọrọ ịmata ọnọdụ P na t=3. (Ijikọta acceleration na-enye ọsọ, ijikọta ọsọ na-enyekwa ọnọdụ.)
n-m-h2-integ-05.thinking.0: Ịkewa ozi dị mkpa na ozi amaralarị
n-m-h2-integ-05.thinking.1: Ịkọwa ihe constant of integration pụtara
n-m-h2-integ-05.prereq.0: Indefinite integrals na constants of integration
n-m-h2-integ-05.prereq.1: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọsọ, ngwa ngwa, na ọnọdụ
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.prompt: Iji kpebie ọnọdụ P na t=3, kedu n'ime ozi ọzọ ndị a ka anyị kwesịrị ịmata?
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.hint.0: Dee ugboro ole ị ga-ejikọta site na ngwa ngwa ruo ọnọdụ, na ihe kwụsiri ike kedu na-apụta oge ọ bụla.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.hint.1: Gụọ ole n'ime ihe kwụsiri ike ndị ahụ ozi dị n'nhọrọ ọ bụla nwere ike ikpebi. Ozi a maralarị site na ngwa ngwa a(t) abụghị ozi ọhụrụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.a: Ọsọ na t=0 na ngwa ngwa na t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.a: A kpebiri ihe kwụsiri ike nke ijikọta maka ọsọ, ma nke maka ọnọdụ fọdụrụ. A maralarị ngwa ngwa na t=3 site n'a(t).
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.b: Ọnọdụ na t=0 na ngwa ngwa na t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.b: A kpebiri ihe kwụsiri ike nke ijikọta maka ọnọdụ, ma nke maka ọsọ fọdụrụ. A maralarị ngwa ngwa na t=3 site n'a(t).
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.c: Ngwa ngwa na t=1 na ngwa ngwa na t=3
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.c: Enwere ike ịgbakọ uru abụọ ahụ site n'a(t), yabụ ọ nweghị ozi ọhụrụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.o.d: Ọsọ na t=0 na ọnọdụ na t=0
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ ozi na-ekpebi nke ọ bụla n'ime ihe kwụsiri ike abụọ nke ijikọta ugboro abụọ na-eweta.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s1.explain: Ijikọta a(t) na-enye v(t)=3t²−4t+C₁, ma ijikọta ọzọ na-enye x(t)=t³−2t²+C₁t+C₂. Naanị mgbe a kpebiri ihe kwụsiri ike abụọ nke ijikọta C₁ (ọsọ mbụ) na C₂ (ọnọdụ mbụ) ka e kpebiri ọnọdụ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka v₀ bụrụ ọsọ na t=0 na x₀ bụrụ ọnọdụ. Tinye ụzọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (v₀, x₀) atọ dị iche nke ọnọdụ na t=3 bụ 10. (−20≤v₀≤20, −20≤x₀≤20)
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.hint.0: Jikọta ugboro abụọ ichọta x(t), wee tinye t=3 ma dee ya dị ka okwu n'v₀ na x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma ịhọrọ otu v₀ nke na-emezu okwu ahụ na-ekpebi x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Ha bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu n'ime oke.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.fail.c1: v₀ na x₀ ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu site na −20 ruo 20.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Ọnọdụ na t=3 abụghị 10. Tinye t=3 n'x(t)=t³−2t²+v₀t+x₀.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s2.explain: x(3)=27−18+3v₀+x₀=9+3v₀+x₀, yabụ x(3)=10 mgbe 3v₀+x₀=1. E nwere (v₀, x₀) na-enweghị njedebe na-emezu nha a. Ya bụ, ọbụlagodi na otu ọnọdụ na t=3, e nwere ọtụtụ mmegharị nwere ọsọ mbụ na ọnọdụ mbụ dị iche.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.prompt: Kọwaa ihe mere ịmara naanị otu ọnọdụ anaghị ekwe ka ị mara ma ọsọ mbụ ma ọnọdụ mbụ, ma dee ihe mere a chọrọ ozi abụọ iji kpebie mmegharị ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.hint.0: Gụọ ugboro ole ị jikọtara iji nweta ọnọdụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.hint.1: Lelee ma ụzọ ndị ị mere na mbụ niile na-erute otu ọnọdụ, ma kwuo ihe dị iche na ha.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.placeholder: dịka ọmụmaatụ, Ọ bụrụ na ị jikọta ... mgbe ahụ ... na-apụta, yabụ ...
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị kwuru na ijikọta ugboro abụọ na-emepụta ihe kwụsiri ike abụọ?
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị kwuru na ọ bụrụ na e nwere naanị otu nha dị ka ọnọdụ, (v₀, x₀) anaghị ekpebi n'otu ụzọ?
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.0: Ebe anyị na-ejikọta ugboro abụọ site na ngwa ngwa ruo ọnọdụ, otu ihe kwụsiri ike nke ijikọta na-apụta n'ọsọ ma otu n'ọnọdụ. Ọnọdụ na t=3 na-enye naanị otu nha, dị ka 3v₀+x₀=1, yabụ a kpebighị v₀ na x₀ n'otu ụzọ ma ọtụtụ ụzọ ga-ekwe omume. Ị ga-amata ma ọsọ mbụ ma ọnọdụ mbụ.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.1: Anyị amaghị ihe kwụsiri ike nke ijikọta 2 ahụ, ma ọnọdụ na t=3 na-enye naanị otu nha. Yabụ e nwere nchikota ọsọ mbụ na ọnọdụ mbụ na-enweghị njedebe. Ebe e nwere ihe kwụsiri ike 2, ị chọrọ ozi 2.
n-m-h2-integ-05.s.s3.model.2: Ijikọta ugboro abụọ na-ahapụ ọsọ mbụ na ọnọdụ mbụ nke ọ bụla dị ka ihe kwụsiri ike. Otu uru ọnọdụ bụ naanị otu nha na-ejikọta abụọ ahụ, yabụ ọtụtụ mmegharị nwere ike iru otu ọnọdụ.

n-m-h2-integ-01.title: Uru definite integral na mpaghara dị n’okpuru eserese hà nhata?
n-m-h2-integ-01.topic: Definite integral na mpaghara: mpaghara nwere akara
n-m-h2-integ-01.goal: Ghọta na definite integral bụ “mpaghara nwere akara,” na-agụ akụkụ dị n’okpuru x-axis dịka nke na-adịghị mma. Mepụta ọnọdụ ebe definite integral bụ 0 ma mpaghara abụghị 0, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya na otu esi achọta mpaghara.
n-m-h2-integ-01.material: E nwere eserese f(x)=x²−2x, x-axis na oge 0≤x≤3. Hajun kwuru, “∫₀³f(x)dx=0, ya mere mpaghara dị n’etiti eserese na x-axis bụkwa 0.” Seoa kwuru, “Echeghị m na mpaghara bụ 0.” (∫₀³ bụ definite integral site na 0 ruo 3.)
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.1: Ikewa eserese n’akụkụ dị n’elu na n’okpuru x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.thinking.2: Ịmata ọdịiche uru definite integral na mpaghara
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.0: Ịgbakọ definite integral nke ọrụ polynomial
n-m-h2-integ-01.prereq.1: Ebe eserese ọrụ dị n’akụkụ x-axis
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ mkpebi ziri ezi gbasara mpaghara dị n’etiti eserese na x-axis n’oge a.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.0: See eserese f(x)=x²−2x, kaa ebe ọ dị n’elu na ebe ọ dị n’okpuru x-axis n’ime oge ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.hint.1: Chọta x-coordinate ebe eserese na-ezute x-axis, kewaa oge ahụ n’ebe ndị ahụ, gbakọọ definite integral nke akụkụ nke ọ bụla iche, tụnyere akara ha.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.a: Mpaghara bụ 0: n’ihi na uru definite integral bụ mpaghara dị n’etiti eserese na x-axis.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.a: I were uru definite integral na mpaghara dịka otu ihe. A na-agụ akụkụ dị n’okpuru x-axis dịka nke na-adịghị mma n’ime definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.b: Mpaghara bụ 0: n’ihi na eserese na-ezute x-axis n’otu isi n’ime oge ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.b: Isi ebe eserese na-ezute x-axis bụ naanị otu isi, ọ naghị eme ka mpaghara bụrụ 0. Ụdị dị n’akụkụ abụọ nke isi ahụ nwere mpaghara.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.c: Mpaghara abụghị 0: n’ihi na akụkụ elu na nke ala nwere akara dị iche, ha na-ewepụ ibe ha.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.c: I chebara etu uru dị mma na nke na-adịghị mma si kagbuo ibe ha n’ime definite integral.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.o.d: Enweghị ike ịma: n’ihi na uru definite integral naanị anaghị agwa ụdị eserese.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.r.d: E nyere f(x) ebe a, ya mere anyị nwere ike lelee ụdị eserese ahụ ozugbo.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x²−2x=x(x−2) dị n’okpuru x-axis mgbe 0≤x≤2, ya mere ∫₀²f=−4/3. Ọ dị n’elu mgbe 2≤x≤3, ya mere ∫₂³f=4/3. Ha jikọtara bụrụ 0, ma mpaghara bụ 4/3+4/3=8/3. Definite integral bụ “mpaghara nwere akara,” na-agụ akụkụ dị n’okpuru x-axis dịka nke na-adịghị mma.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.prompt: Maka f(x)=x(x−a), tinye ụzọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma 2 dị iche iche (a,b) nke definite integral ∫₀ᵇf(x)dx=0. (1≤a≤20, 1≤b≤20.)
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.0: Gbasaa ∫₀ᵇx(x−a)dx, dee ya dịka okwu a na b.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.hint.1: Chọta mmekọrịta a na b ga-eme ka okwu ahụ bụrụ 0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.ok.c1: a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu dị mma n’ime oke ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.fail.c1: a na b ga-abụrịrị ọnụọgụ zuru ezu sitere na 1 ruo 20.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s2.explain: ∫₀ᵇx(x−a)dx=b³/3−ab²/2=b²(2b−3a)/6, ya mere ọ bụ 0 mgbe 2b=3a. Mgbe ahụ b=1.5a karịrị a; oge [0,b] nwere akụkụ dị n’okpuru x-axis (0<x<a) na nke dị n’elu (a<x<b). Ya mere definite integral bụ 0, ma mpaghara abụghị 0.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.prompt: Họrọ otu ụzọ abụọ i mepụtara, kọwaa ihe mere definite integral ji bụrụ 0 ma mpaghara abụghị, na otu esi achọta mpaghara n’oge ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.0: Jiri otu n'ụzọ ndị ị mere na mbụ, gbakọọ definite integrals nke akụkụ dị n'okpuru axis x na nke dị n'elu ya n'iche, ma lelee ihe ịrịba ama.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.hint.1: Chetakwa na mpaghara, dịka ogologo, enweghị ike ịbụ negative, ma chee otu e kwesịrị isi jikwaa akụkụ dị n'okpuru.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, Definite integral ... n'ihi na akụkụ ... , na mpaghara ...
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru otu e si agụ akụkụ dị n'okpuru axis x n'ime definite integral?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na ebe mpaghara enweghị ike ịbụ negative, ị kewara oge ebe ihe ịrịba ama na-agbanwe?
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.0: Definite integral nke akụkụ dị n'okpuru axis x bụ negative nke akụkụ dị n'elu bụkwa positive, ya mere mgbe a gbakwunyere ha na-ewepụ ibe ha ma nye 0. Maka mpaghara, a ga-agụkwa akụkụ dị n'okpuru dịka positive, ya mere kewaa oge n'ebe eserese na-ezute axis x, chọta uru nke ọ bụla, gbakwunyekwa uru zuru ezu ha.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.1: Definite integral bụ mpaghara nwere ihe ịrịba ama, ya mere uru dị n'elu na uru dị n'okpuru (negative) na-agbakwunye ruo 0. Mpaghara n'ezie na-agụ abụọ dịka positive, ya mere chọta ha n'iche site n'ịkewa ya n'[0,a] na [a,b], mgbe ahụ gbakwunye ha.
n-m-h2-integ-01.s.s3.model.2: Ọ bụrụ na ị kewaa oge ahụ n'abụọ n'ebe eserese na-ezute axis x, otu definite integral bụ positive nke ọzọ bụkwa negative. Ọbụlagodi mgbe nchikota ha bụ 0, mpaghara bụ |akụkụ negative|+|akụkụ positive|, nke karịrị 0.

n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.2: Ịgbakọ definite integral nke ọrụ polynomial
n-m-h2-integ-04.title: Ịchọta ọnọdụ maka local minimum value nke function e kọwapụtara site na definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-04.topic: Ịdị iche na uru oke nke functions e kọwapụtara site na definite integrals
n-m-h2-integ-04.goal: Jiri eziokwu na ịbawanye na ibelata na uru oke nke function F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt e kọwapụtara site na definite integral na-ekpebi site n'ihe ịrịba ama nke f(x), iji wue ọmụmaatụ ebe local minimum value bụ positive ma chọta ọnọdụ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-04.material: f(t)=(t−a)(t−b) (a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nwere 0<a<b) na F(x)=∫₀ˣ f(t)dt. (∫₀ˣ bụ definite integral site na 0 ruo x.)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.0: Ịgụ ịbawanye na ibelata site na F'(x)=f(x)
n-m-h2-integ-04.thinking.1: Ịkewa ebe uru oke dị na nha ya
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.0: Ịdị iche nke function e kọwapụtara site na definite integral
n-m-h2-integ-04.prereq.1: Ịbawanye, ibelata, na uru oke nke cubic functions
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.prompt: Maka x>0, n'x kedu F(x) nwere ike inwe uru oke?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.0: Chetakwa function ị na-enweta mgbe ị mere function e kọwapụtara site na definite integral ka ọ dị iche.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ọ bụrụ na ị nyochaa ihe ịrịba ama nke F' n'oke x ọ bụla, ị nwere ike ịmata ebe F na-abawanye na ebe ọ na-ebelata.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.a: X ebe f(x) nwere uru oke: F nwere uru oke n'otu ebe ahụ dịka f
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.a: Ịbawanye na ibelata nke F na-ekpebi site n'ihe ịrịba ama nke f, ọ bụghị site n'uru f. Ebe uru oke nke f dị enweghị mmekọrịta na uru oke nke F.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.b: X ebe f(x)=0 ma ihe ịrịba ama f(x) na-agbanwe n'akụkụ ọ bụla
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.b: Ị jiri eziokwu na ebe F'(x)=f(x), uru oke na-eme ebe ihe ịrịba ama F' na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.c: X ebe F(x)=0: uru oke na-eme ebe eserese na-agafe axis x
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.c: Ebe F bụ 0 na ebe uru oke na-eme bụ ihe dị iche.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.o.d: x=0: uru F na-amalite ịgbanwe n'ebe ijikọta na-amalite
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.r.d: F(0)=0 bụ naanị uru, x=0 abụghịkwa ebe ịbawanye na ibelata na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s1.explain: Ebe F'(x)=f(x)=(x−a)(x−b), F na-abawanye maka x<a, na-ebelata maka a<x<b, ma na-abawanye maka x>b. Ya mere F nwere local maximum na x=a na local minimum na x=b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.prompt: N'etiti ụzọ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu (a, b) nwere 0<a<b≤20, tinye ụzọ atọ dị iche nke local minimum value nke F(x) bụ positive.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kpebie x ebe F nwere local minimum ya, mgbe ahụ kwuo uru F n'x ahụ n'okwu a na b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.hint.1: Gbasaa ma gbakọọ ∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt ma chọpụta ọnọdụ ka ihe ịrịba ama bụrụ positive.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a na b bụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nwere 0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a na b ga-abụ ọnụọgụ zuru ezu nwere 0<a<b≤20.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Local minimum value abụghị positive. Kwuo uru F n'x ebe local minimum na-eme n'okwu a na b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s2.explain: Local minimum na-eme na x=b, F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t²−(a+b)t+ab)dt=b³/3−(a+b)b²/2+ab²=b²(3a−b)/6. Ebe b²>0, local minimum value bụ positive mgbe 3a−b>0, ya bụ, b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.prompt: Dee mmekọrịta dị n'etiti b na a n'ụzọ ndị ị chọtara, kọwaakwa ihe mere a chọrọ mmekọrịta ahụ site n'ịgbakọ local minimum value.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kpebie ma local minimum dị na a ka ọ bụ na b, mgbe ahụ gbasaa ma gbakọọ definite integral ruo x ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.hint.1: N'nkwupụta ị gbakọrọ, kewaa ihe ndị bụ positive mgbe niile na ndị ihe ịrịba ama ha nwere ike ịgbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.placeholder: dịka, b bụ ... karịa ... nke a. Local minimum value bụ ..., ya mere ...
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ buru ụzọ kpebie x ebe local minimum na-eme ma mgbe ahụ gbakọọ uru ya?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru nke ihe na-ekpebi ihe ịrịba ama nke local minimum value?
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.0: b ga-erughị okpukpu 3 nke a. Local minimum na-eme na x=b, F(b)=b²(3a−b)/6, ebe b² bụ positive mgbe niile, 3a−b ga-abụ positive. Ya mere b<3a.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.1: Mgbe b<3a, local minimum value bụ positive. Ịgbakọ F(b)=∫₀ᵇ(t−a)(t−b)dt na-enye b²(3a−b)/6, ihe ịrịba ama ya na-ekpebikwa site na 3a−b.
n-m-h2-integ-04.s.s3.model.2: Ọ zuru ezu na 3a>b. Chọta uru F(b)=b^2(3a-b)/6 n'x=b, ebe local minimum na-eme, ma chọta ọnọdụ ka ọ bụrụ positive: 3a-b>0.

n-m-h2-integ-03.title: Ọ bụrụ na ọ laghachiri ebe ọ malitere, ọ̀ bụ na ọ gaghị?
n-m-h2-integ-03.topic: Ọsọ na ogologo: mgbanwe ọnọdụ na ogologo e gara
n-m-h2-integ-03.goal: Ghọta, site n'ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe ọ bụla a kpughere ozi, na definite integral nke ọsọ bụ mgbanwe ọnọdụ ma dị iche na ogologo e gara, kọwaakwa otu esi achọta ogologo ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-03.material: A na-ekpughe ozi banyere ebe P na-aga n'ahịrị ọnụọgụ otu otu. Mgbanwe ọnọdụ bụ integral nke ọsọ, ogologo e gara bụkwa ngụkọta ogologo niile e jikọtara n'ezie.
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.1: Ịkewa mgbanwe ọnọdụ na ogologo e gara
n-m-h2-integ-03.thinking.2: Ịkewa oge ebe ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ na-agbanwe
n-m-h2-integ-03.prereq.0: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọsọ na ọnọdụ (mgbanwe ọnọdụ = definite integral nke ọsọ)
n-m-h2-integ-03.prereq.1: Inyocha ihe ịrịba ama nke quadratic function
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ikpe site n'iji naanị ozi e kpughere.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.0: Mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara, chee ma "mgbanwe ọnọdụ" na "ogologo e jikọtara" pụtara otu ihe.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.hint.1: Chee otu ngagharị nke ebe ahụ si dị iche ebe ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Anyị chọtara mgbanwe ọnọdụ nke ebe P, nke malitere na t=0, ruo t=6, ọ bụkwa 0. Ya bụ, na t=6, P nọ n'ebe ọ malitere.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Site n'ozi a naanị, anyị nwere ike ikwu na ogologo P gara bụ 0?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Mgbanwe ọnọdụ bụ uru nwere ntụziaka (ọ nwere ihe ịrịba ama), ya mere ọ nwere ike ịbụ 0 ọbụlagodi mgbe ebe ahụ pụrụ laghachikwa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Anyị nwere ike ikwu ya: ọnọdụ bụ otu, ya mere ogologo e gara bụkwa 0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ị lere mgbanwe ọnọdụ na ogologo e gara dịka otu ihe. Ọbụlagodi ma ọ gaa laghachi, mgbanwe ahụ bụ 0.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Anyị enweghị ike ikwu ya: ọ bụrụ na ọ gaa laghachi, ogologo abụghị 0 ọbụlagodi na mgbanwe bụ 0
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ị chere otu mgbanwe nke 0 anaghị apụta naanị "ọ nweghị ebe ọ gara."
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Anyị nwere ike ikwu ya: ọ bụrụ na definite integral bụ 0, ọsọ ga-abụ 0 mgbe niile
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ọbụlagodi na definite integral bụ 0, e nwere ike inwe oge ebe ọsọ bụ positive agwakọtara na oge ebe ọ bụ negative.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: N'oge ole P na-agbanwe ntụziaka ngagharị ya?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Mgbe ọsọ bụ negative ọ na-aga n'otu ntụziaka, mgbe ọ bụ positive ọ na-aga n'ntụziaka megidere. Ntụziaka na-agbanwe na t=4, ebe ihe ịrịba ama na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: t=2: eserese v(t) dị ala kacha ebe ahụ, ya mere ntụziaka na-agbanwe
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ebe v(t) nwere minimum bụ ebe ọsọ kacha ukwuu, ọ bụghị ebe ntụziaka na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: t=4: v(t)=0 ma ihe ịrịba ama na-agbanwe n'akụkụ ọ bụla ya
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ị lelere na maka v(t)=t(t−4), ọ bụ negative maka 0<t<4 ma bụrụ positive maka t>4.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ọ naghị agbanwe ntụziaka: oge ọsọ bụ 0 abụghị mgbanwe ntụziaka
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ọsọ bụ 0 ma ihe ịrịba ama na-agbanwe, ntụziaka na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Anyị chọtara mgbanwe ọnọdụ maka oge ọ bụla: −32/3 site na 0 ruo 4, na +32/3 site na 4 ruo 6.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kedu ogologo P gara n'ezie site na t=0 ruo 6?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.after: A na-achọta ogologo e gara site n'ịkewa oge ebe ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ na-agbanwe ma gbakwunye nha (uru zuru ezu) nke mgbanwe n'oge ọ bụla. Ya bụ, ∫₀⁶|v(t)|dt=64/3.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Mgbe ị gbakwunyere ha, mmegharị abụọ n'ntụziaka megidere na-ewepụ ibe ha. Nke a bụ mgbanwe ọnọdụ.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 32/3: nha nke otu n'ime mgbanwe abụọ ahụ
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Oge ọlaghachi bụkwa akụkụ nke ogologo e jikọtara n'ezie.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 64/3: nchikota nke nha nke mgbanwe abụọ ahụ
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ị gbakwunyere ogologo niile e jikọtara, n'agbanyeghị ntụziaka.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ ọ dị ka ogologo ga-abụ 0 ebe P laghachiri n'ebe ọ malitere, ma mgbe anyị lere ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ, e nwere oge ọ na-apụ na oge ọ na-alọghachi. Mgbanwe ọnọdụ nwere ihe ịrịba ama ma na-ewepụ onwe ya, ma ogologo e gara anaghị ewepụ onwe ya.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.prompt: Dee ihe mere ogologo e gara adịghị 0 ọbụlagodi na P nọ n'ebe ọ malitere na t=6, kọwaakwa otu esi achọta ogologo e gara.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.hint.0: Jikọta eziokwu na P nọ n'ebe ọ malitere na t=6 na ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ tupu na mgbe t=4, ma kọwaa n'okwu otu P si gaa.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tụnyere ma ọ bụ mgbanwe ọnọdụ ka ọ bụ ogologo e gara na-ewepụ onwe ya.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, N'ihi na P ..., ogologo bụ ...
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ kwuru otu mgbanwe ọnọdụ na ogologo e gara si dị iche?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị̀ kwuru na ị kewara oge ebe ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ na-agbanwe?
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.model.0: P gara n'otu ntụziaka ruo t=4 ma laghachi n'ntụziaka megidere ruo ebe ọ malitere. Mgbanwe ndị ahụ na-ewepụ onwe ha ruo 0, ma ụzọ e jikọtara ka fọdụrụ. Ya mere ị ga-ekewa oge ebe ihe ịrịba ama ọsọ na-agbanwe ma gbakwunye uru zuru ezu nke mgbanwe n'oge ọ bụla.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe ọsọ bụ negative ọ na-aga n'ihu, mgbe ahụ mgbe ọsọ ghọrọ positive ọ na-agbanwe ntụziaka ma laghachi. Mgbanwe ọnọdụ bụ 0 n'ihi ihe ịrịba ama, ma a na-achọta ogologo site n'ịgbakọ oge abụọ ahụ n'iche ma gbakwunye ha dịka uru positive.
n-m-h2-integ-03.s.s2.model.2: Mmegharị ịga na ịlọghachi nwere ihe ịrịba ama megidere, ya mere ha na-ewepụ onwe ha n'definite integral. Ogologo bụ integral nke |v(t)|, ya mere kewaa ebe ihe ịrịba ama na-agbanwe ma gbakwunye.

n-m-h2-integ-10.thinking.0: Ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe ọ bụla ozi ọhụrụ pụtara
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ikpe site n'iji naanị ozi e kpughere.
n-m-h2-integ-10.title: Mpaghara e tụrụ atụmatụ site na rectangles ọ̀ karịrị ma ọ bụ dị ala karịa nke n'ezie?
n-m-h2-integ-10.topic: Ihe definite integral pụtara: ịtụ atụmatụ mpaghara site na rectangles
n-m-h2-integ-10.goal: Ghọta, site n'ịgbanwe ikpe gị mgbe a na-ekpughe ozi, na ma uru e tụrụ atụmatụ site na rectangles karịrị ma ọ bụ dị ala karịa mpaghara n'ezie na-adabere ma function na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata.
n-m-h2-integ-10.material: Anyị na-eji rectangles tụọ atụmatụ mpaghara A nke ọdịdị (0≤x≤1) nke curve y=x², axis x, na ahịrị x=1 gbara. Kewaa oge ahụ n'akụkụ n nha nha ma wue rectangle n'akụkụ ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ịdị elu bụ uru e tụrụ n'njedebe aka ekpe nke akụkụ ọ bụla, ọ bụ "left sum," ọ bụrụkwa na ọ bụ uru e tụrụ n'njedebe aka nri, ọ bụ "right sum."
n-m-h2-integ-10.thinking.1: Ijikọta ebe e tụrụ ịdị elu na ma curve na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata
n-m-h2-integ-10.thinking.2: Inyocha ma atụmatụ ndị ahụ gbara uru n'ezie n'elu na n'okpuru
n-m-h2-integ-10.prereq.0: Ihe definite integral pụtara dịka mpaghara
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.hint.0: Maka akụkụ ọ bụla, seta ma tụnyere ma akụkụ elu nke rectangle dị n'elu ma ọ bụ n'okpuru curve ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.hint.1: N'ebe e tụrụ ịdị elu (njedebe aka ekpe, njedebe aka nri), tụnyere ma ịdị elu nke curve bụ nke kacha ala ma ọ bụ nke kacha elu n'ime akụkụ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Gịnị ka anyị nwere ike ikwu banyere mpaghara A n'ezie?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Curve a na-ebili elu n'aka nri, ya mere left sum dị ala karịa uru n'ezie, right sum karịkwa uru n'ezie. Mpaghara A n'ezie dị n'etiti uru abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: A dị n'etiti 0.125 na 0.625: left sum adịghị zuru, right sum na-agafe
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ị jiri eziokwu na ebe curve na-ebili n'aka nri, n'akụkụ ọ bụla ịdị elu n'njedebe aka ekpe bụ nke kacha ala, ịdị elu n'njedebe aka nri bụkwa nke kacha elu.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A bụ 0.375: n'ihi na nkezi uru abụọ ahụ bụ mgbe niile mpaghara n'ezie
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Enweghị nkwa na nkezi hà mpaghara n'ezie. Ọ na-adabere n'udi curve ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: A karịrị 0.625: n'ihi na rectangles na-ejupụta naanị n'okpuru curve
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Rectangles nke right sum na-apụta n'elu curve. Ọ bụ left sum na-ejupụta naanị n'okpuru curve.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Mgbe anyị bawanyere ruo n=4, left sum ghọrọ 0.21875 right sum ghọkwara 0.46875.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Gịnị na-eme n'etiti sums abụọ ahụ na mpaghara A n'ezie ma anyị abawanye n ọzọ?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Ka n na-abawanye, obosara na-ebelata ọdịiche dị n'etiti sums abụọ ahụ na-ebelatakwa. Ya mere a pụrụ ichee definite integral dịka uru e pịrị n'etiti sums abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sums abụọ ahụ na-abịaru A nso, A na-anọgidekwa n'etiti uru abụọ ahụ
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ị kwenyesiri ike na sums abụọ ahụ na-esi ike ma na-agbaba A n'elu na n'okpuru.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Left sum na-ebelata right sum na-abawanyekwa, na-esite na A pụọ
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Site na n=2 ruo 4, left sum mụbara right sum belatakwara.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Oge ụfọdụ sums abụọ ahụ na-agafe ibe ha, A na-adakwa n'èzí ha
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ọ bụrụhaala na curve na-aga n'ihu na-ebili, left sum dị ala mgbe niile, right sum karịkwa mgbe niile, ya mere A dị n'etiti uru abụọ ahụ.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Oge a, anyị tụrụ atụmatụ curve y=1−x² (0≤x≤1) n'otu ụzọ ahụ na n=2, left sum bụ 0.875, right sum bụ 0.375, mpaghara n'ezie bụkwa ihe dị ka 0.667.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Gịnị mere left sum ji karịa mpaghara n'ezie maka curve a?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Ụzọ atụmatụ na-aga, karịa ma ọ bụ dị ala, dabere n'ebe ị tụrụ ịdị elu na-adabere ma curve na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata. Maka curve na-ebelata, ụzọ ahụ na-agbanwe.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ọ bụ njehie mgbakọ: n'ihi na left sum na-apụta dị ala karịa mpaghara n'ezie mgbe niile
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ịpụta dị ala mgbe niile bụ eziokwu naanị mgbe curve na-ebili.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Curve na-agbada, ya mere njedebe aka ekpe bụ nke kacha elu ma rectangles na-agafe curve
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ị chere otu left sum si abụ nke karịrị ma ọ bụ dị ala dabere ma curve na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Curve nwere akụkụ na-agbada n'okpuru axis x, ya mere ihe ịrịba ama agbanwere
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: N'0≤x≤1, 1−x² bụ opekata mpe 0, ya mere ọ naghị agbada n'okpuru axis x.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s1.reflect: Na mbụ iwu na left sum dị obere right sum buru ibu dị ka ọ na-adị mgbe niile, ma mgbe curve gbadara, ọ gbanwere. Ma atụmatụ karịrị ma ọ bụ dị ala karịa uru n'ezie na-ekpebi site na ma curve na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọnọdụ curve (function) ga-emezu ka anyị kwuo na left sum bụ mgbe niile obere ma ọ bụ hà mpaghara n'ezie, ma nye otu ọmụmaatụ mgbe ọnọdụ ahụ na-adịghị.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.hint.0: Kọwaa ihe mere left sum ji dị obere site n'iji ebe e tụrụ ịdị elu na ịdị elu nke curve.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.hint.1: Lelee ma ihe kpatara ahụ na-arụkwa ọrụ mgbe curve na-agbada.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.placeholder: dịka, Naanị mgbe curve ... Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ...
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị̀ jikọtara ebe e tụrụ ịdị elu na ma curve na-abawanye ma ọ bụ na-ebelata?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: N'ọmụmaatụ ebe ọnọdụ ahụ na-ada, ị̀ kwuru n'ụzọ ole atụmatụ na-ejehie?
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.model.0: Curve ga-aga n'ihu na-abawanye n'oge ahụ ka left sum bụrụ obere ma ọ bụ hà mpaghara n'ezie. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, maka curve na-ebelata dịka y=1−x², njedebe aka ekpe bụ nke kacha elu, ya mere left sum karịrị mpaghara n'ezie.
n-m-h2-integ-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọ na-ejide naanị n'oge ebe function na-ebili. Maka curve na-agbada, dịka ọmụmaatụ y=4−x², ọ bụ ihe megidere: left sum na-agafe right sum adịghị zuru.
